  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';

    // 3D Tilt effect
    const card = document.getElementById('loginCard');
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
      const rotateX = (y / rect.height) * -8;
      const rotateY = (x / rect.width) * 8;
      card.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      card.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)';
    });

    // Generate floating particles
    function createParticles() {
      const container = document.getElementById('particles');
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const p = document.createElement('div');
        p.className = 'particle';
        p.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
        p.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 10 + 10) + 's';
        p.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 10) + 's';
        p.style.width = (Math.random() * 4 + 2) + 'px';
        p.style.height = p.style.width;
        container.appendChild(p);
      }
    }
    createParticles();

    // Toggle password visibility
    function togglePassword() {
      const input = document.getElementById('adminPassword');
      const icon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
      }
    }

    // Toast
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      const icons = { success: 'bi-check-circle-fill', error: 'bi-x-circle-fill', warning: 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill' };
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="toast-icon"><i class="bi ${icons[type] || icons.success}"></i></div>
        <span style="color: var(--gray-700);">${message}</span>
      `;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 4000);
    }

    // Login handler
    async function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('adminEmail').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('adminPassword').value;

      if (!email || !password) {
        showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
        return false;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Authenticating...';

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/admin/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        if (data.success) {
          localStorage.setItem('adminToken', data.token);
          if (document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked) {
            localStorage.setItem('adminEmail', email);
          }
          showToast('Welcome back, Admin!', 'success');
          setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = 'admin.html';
          }, 800);
        } else {
          showToast(data.error || 'Invalid credentials', 'error');
          btn.classList.remove('loading');
          btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-right"></i> Sign In Securely';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Connection failed. Please try again.', 'error');
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-right"></i> Sign In Securely';
      }
      return false;
    }

    // Pre-fill remembered email
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('adminEmail');
      if (saved) document.getElementById('adminEmail').value = saved;
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      <div class="topbar"><div class="page-title">Orphaned Deposits (Trapped Funds)</div></div>

      <div class="card-modern" style="max-width:900px;margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div class="card-title-modern"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> What are orphaned deposits?</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-600);line-height:1.6;">
          When admin deletes a user's bank account (because the BVN was fake), the <strong>old Flutterwave virtual account still exists</strong> on Flutterwave's side. If anyone — the banned user themselves, or someone who still has the old account number saved in their bank app — sends money to it, Yenllet's webhook receives the deposit but cannot credit anyone (because no user owns that account_number anymore).<br><br>
          Instead of letting those funds disappear silently, Yenllet logs each one here. Review each deposit and decide what to do manually: refund the sender via bank transfer, keep the funds in escrow, or contact Flutterwave support to reverse the transaction.
        </div>
      </div>

  <script>
    // ✅ API base URL — empty string means same-origin (works on Vercel/Render).
    // Required for the vendor/FAQ/push functions that use `fetch(API + '/api/...')`.
    const API = '';
    let adminToken = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
    let allPricing = [];
    let allUsers = [];
    let allTransactions = [];
    let allAds = [];
    let allReviews = [];
    let selectedUserId = null;
    let walletActionType = 'credit';
    let currentPricingFilter = 'airtime';

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      if (!adminToken) { window.location.href = 'admin-login.html'; return; }
      loadDashboardData();
      loadSettings();
    });

    async function api(endpoint, options = {}) {
      showLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, { ...options, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken, ...options.headers } });
        // ✅ Detect HTML responses (404 page from Vercel) and show a clear error
        // instead of cryptic 'Unexpected token <' from res.json() failing.
        const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
        if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          if (res.status === 404) {
            throw new Error('Endpoint not found (' + endpoint + '). Deploy the latest server.js — the route is missing on the live server.');
          }
          throw new Error('Server returned non-JSON response (HTTP ' + res.status + '). The server.js on Vercel is out of date — please redeploy.');
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Request failed');
        return data;
      } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, 'error'); throw err; }
      finally { showLoading(false); }
    }

    // ✅ Toggle sidebar on mobile (hamburger menu)
    function toggleSidebar() {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
      if (sidebar.classList.contains('mobile-open')) {
        sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
        overlay.classList.remove('active');
      } else {
        sidebar.classList.add('mobile-open');
        overlay.classList.add('active');
      }
    }

    function switchTab(tab) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[id^="tab-"]').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
      document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).style.display = 'block';
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${tab}"]`).classList.add('active');
      if (tab === 'users') loadUsers();
      if (tab === 'kyc-verify') loadKycVerificationTab();
      if (tab === 'orphaned-deposits') loadOrphanedDeposits();
      if (tab === 'webhook-logs') { loadWebhookConfig(); loadWebhookLogs(); }
      if (tab === 'transactions') loadAllTransactions();
      if (tab === 'pricing') loadPricing();
      if (tab === 'resellers') loadResellers();
      if (tab === 'vendors') loadVendors();
      if (tab === 'vendor-targets') loadVendorTargets();
      if (tab === 'vendor-withdrawals') loadVendorWithdrawals();
      if (tab === 'gift-banners') loadGiftBanners();
      if (tab === 'promo-cards') loadPromoCards();
      if (tab === 'faq') loadFaqList();
      if (tab === 'ads') loadAds();
      if (tab === 'leaderboard') loadAdminLeaderboard();
      if (tab === 'schedules') loadAllSchedules();
      if (tab === 'notif-log') loadNotifLog();
      if (tab === 'health-check') loadHealthCheck();
      if (tab === 'reviews') loadReviews();
      // ✅ Close sidebar on mobile when a tab is clicked
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open');
        document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.remove('active');
      }
    }

    async function loadDashboardData() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/dashboard');
        document.getElementById('statUsers').textContent = data.stats.totalUsers;
        document.getElementById('statTransactions').textContent = data.stats.totalTransactions;
        document.getElementById('statRevenue').textContent = '₦' + (data.stats.totalRevenue || 0).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('statBanned').textContent = data.stats.bannedUsers || 0;
        const txnData = await api('/api/admin/transactions');
        allTransactions = txnData.transactions || [];
        document.getElementById('recentTxnTable').innerHTML = allTransactions.slice(0, 10).map(t => `<tr><td>#${t.id}</td><td>${t.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-info">${t.type}</span></td><td>${t.service || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(t.total||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${t.status==='success'?'success':t.status==='pending'?'warning':'danger'}">${t.status}</span></td><td>${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-receipt"></i><p>No transactions</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadUsers() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/users');
        allUsers = data.users || [];
        renderUsersTable(allUsers);
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    function renderUsersTable(users) {
      document.getElementById('usersTable').innerHTML = users.map(u => `<tr>
        <td><a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="openUserDetails(${u.id})" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:none;">${u.fullname}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${u.email}</small></a></td>
        <td>${u.phone || '-'}</td>
        <td>₦${parseFloat(u.wallet_balance||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
        <td>₦${parseFloat(u.cashback_balance||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
        <td><span class="badge badge-${u.kyc_status==='approved'?'success':'warning'}">${u.kyc_status}</span></td>
        <td><span class="badge badge-${u.is_banned?'danger':'success'}">${u.is_banned?'Banned':'Active'}</span></td>
        <td>
          <button class="action-btn edit" onclick="openUserDetails(${u.id})" title="View Details"><i class="bi bi-person-vcard"></i></button>
          <button class="action-btn" style="border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary);" onclick="openWalletModal(${u.id})" title="Wallet / Cashback"><i class="bi bi-wallet2"></i></button>
          <button class="action-btn edit" onclick="openEditUserModal(${u.id})" title="Edit Profile"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button>
          <button class="action-btn stop" onclick="resetUserPin(${u.id})" title="Reset PIN"><i class="bi bi-key-fill"></i></button>
          <button class="action-btn email" onclick="toggleEmail(${u.id})" title="Toggle Email Notifications"><i class="bi ${u.email_visible ? 'bi-envelope-open-fill' : 'bi-envelope-slash-fill'}"></i></button>
          ${u.is_banned ? `<button class="action-btn approve" onclick="unbanUser(${u.id})" title="Unban"><i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i></button>` : `<button class="action-btn danger" onclick="banUser(${u.id})" title="Ban"><i class="bi bi-slash-circle"></i></button>`}
          <button class="action-btn danger" onclick="openDeleteAccountModal(${u.id}, '${(u.fullname || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${u.account_number || ''}', '${u.kyc_status || 'pending'}')" title="Delete Bank Account + Blacklist BVN"><i class="bi bi-trash-fill"></i></button>
        </td>
      </tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-people"></i><p>No users</p></div></td></tr>';
    }

    // ✅ Live user search (debounced). Type 2+ chars → API returns matches.
    let searchTimer = null;
    function searchUsers() {
      const q = document.getElementById('userSearchInput').value.trim();
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      if (q.length < 2) {
        renderUsersTable(allUsers);
        return;
      }
      searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          const data = await api('/api/admin/users/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q));
          renderUsersTable(data.users || []);
        } catch (err) {}
      }, 350);
    }

    // ✅ exportUsersCsv is defined below (after loadAllTransactions) — it uses fetch + Blob download
    // so we can attach the Authorization header.

    async function toggleEmail(id) {
      try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/toggle-email`, { method: 'POST' }); showToast('Email preference updated', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    // ===================== KYC VERIFICATION CONTROL =====================
    //
    // loadKycVerificationTab() — orchestrates: loads toggle + balance + pending list.
    // saveKycForceVerify() — saves the toggle (force_verify ON/OFF).
    // loadCkBalance() — fetches CheckMyNinBvn wallet balance.
    // loadKycPending() — fetches list of users with pending kyc_status.
    // verifyKycUser(userId) — admin taps Verify, server runs CheckMyNinBvn for that user.

    async function loadKycVerificationTab() {
      // 1. Load toggle setting
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/kyc-settings');
        const settings = data.settings || { force_verify: false };
        document.getElementById('kycForceVerify').value = settings.force_verify ? 'true' : 'false';
      } catch (err) { /* toast already shown by api() */ }

      // 2. Load CheckMyNinBvn balance
      await loadCkBalance();

      // 3. Load pending list
      await loadKycPending();

      // 4. Load blacklist
      await loadBlacklist();
    }

    async function saveKycForceVerify() {
      const forceVerify = document.getElementById('kycForceVerify').value === 'true';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/kyc-settings', {
          method: 'PUT',
          body: JSON.stringify({ force_verify: forceVerify })
        });
        showToast(data.message || 'Toggle saved', 'success');
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadCkBalance() {
      const display = document.getElementById('ckBalanceDisplay');
      const msg = document.getElementById('ckBalanceMsg');
      display.textContent = 'Loading…';
      display.style.color = 'var(--gray-500)';
      msg.textContent = '';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/checkmyninbvn/balance');
        if (data.success) {
          const bal = parseFloat(data.balance || 0);
          const currency = data.currency || 'NGN';
          const symbol = currency === 'NGN' ? '₦' : (currency + ' ');
          display.textContent = symbol + bal.toLocaleString();
          // Color-code: green if > ₦500, yellow if ₦100-₦500, red if < ₦100
          if (bal >= 500) { display.style.color = 'var(--success)'; }
          else if (bal >= 100) { display.style.color = 'var(--warning)'; }
          else { display.style.color = 'var(--danger)'; }
          msg.textContent = `Fetched from ${data.endpoint_used}. Last updated: ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`;
        } else if (data.configured === false) {
          display.textContent = '—';
          display.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
          msg.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i> ' + (data.message || 'API key not configured');
          msg.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
        } else {
          display.textContent = '—';
          display.style.color = 'var(--gray-500)';
          msg.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill"></i> ' + (data.message || 'Could not fetch balance');
          msg.style.color = 'var(--gray-500)';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        display.textContent = '—';
        display.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
        msg.textContent = 'Failed to fetch balance: ' + err.message;
        msg.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
      }
    }

    async function loadKycPending() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('kycPendingTable');
      const countBadge = document.getElementById('kycPendingCount');
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i><p>Loading…</p></div></td></tr>';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/kyc/pending');
        const list = data.pending || [];
        countBadge.textContent = list.length;
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--success);font-size:42px;"></i><p>No pending verifications</p><small style="color:var(--gray-400);">All users with bank accounts have been verified.</small></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(u => {
          const bvn = u.kyc_bvn ? `${u.kyc_bvn.substring(0,4)}***${u.kyc_bvn.substring(7)}` : '<span style="color:var(--gray-400)">—</span>';
          const nin = u.kyc_nin ? `${u.kyc_nin.substring(0,4)}***${u.kyc_nin.substring(7)}` : '<span style="color:var(--gray-400)">—</span>';
          const submitted = u.kyc_submitted_at ? new Date(u.kyc_submitted_at).toLocaleDateString() : '—';
          return `<tr>
            <td><strong>${u.fullname || '—'}</strong><br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${u.email || ''}</small></td>
            <td>${u.phone || '—'}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;">${bvn}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;">${nin}</td>
            <td><strong>${u.account_number || '—'}</strong><br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${u.bank_name || ''}</small></td>
            <td>${submitted}</td>
            <td><button class="btn-modern btn-primary-modern" onclick="verifyKycUser(${u.id})" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px;"><i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> Verify</button></td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color:var(--danger);font-size:42px;"></i><p>Failed to load pending list</p><small>' + err.message + '</small></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

    async function verifyKycUser(userId) {
      if (!confirm('Run CheckMyNinBvn verification for this user now? This will deduct ~₦50-₦100 from your CheckMyNinBvn wallet.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/kyc/verify/' + userId, { method: 'POST' });
        if (data.already_verified) {
          showToast(data.message || 'Already verified', 'info');
        } else {
          let msg = data.message || 'User verified successfully!';
          if (data.user && data.user.verified_name) {
            msg += '\nVerified name: ' + data.user.verified_name;
          }
          showToast(msg, 'success');
        }
        // Reload the pending list
        await loadKycPending();
        // Also refresh balance since we just spent credits
        await loadCkBalance();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Verification failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // ===================== BVN/NIN BLACKLIST =====================

    async function loadBlacklist() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('blacklistTable');
      const countBadge = document.getElementById('blacklistCount');
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i><p>Loading…</p></div></td></tr>';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/bvn-blacklist');
        const list = data.blacklist || [];
        countBadge.textContent = list.length;
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-shield-check" style="color:var(--success);font-size:42px;"></i><p>No blacklisted IDs</p><small style="color:var(--gray-400);">When you delete a user\'s account with blacklist enabled, the BVN/NIN will appear here.</small></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(b => {
          const idVal = String(b.id_value || '');
          const masked = idVal.length === 11 ? `${idVal.substring(0,4)}***${idVal.substring(7)}` : idVal;
          const date = b.blocked_at ? new Date(b.blocked_at).toLocaleDateString() : '—';
          const typeBadge = b.id_type === 'BVN'
            ? '<span class="badge badge-info">BVN</span>'
            : '<span class="badge badge-warning">NIN</span>';
          return `<tr>
            <td>${typeBadge}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:600;">${masked}</td>
            <td style="max-width:280px;font-size:12px;">${(b.reason || '—').replace(/</g,'&lt;')}</td>
            <td>${b.user_fullname ? `<strong>${b.user_fullname}</strong>` : '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);">—</span>'}${b.user_email ? `<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400);">${b.user_email}</small>` : ''}</td>
            <td>${b.admin_email || '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);">—</span>'}</td>
            <td>${date}</td>
            <td><button class="action-btn approve" onclick="removeBlacklist(${b.id})" title="Remove from blacklist"><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i></button></td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color:var(--danger);font-size:42px;"></i><p>Failed to load blacklist</p><small>' + err.message + '</small></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

    async function removeBlacklist(blacklistId) {
      if (!confirm('Remove this BVN/NIN from the blacklist?\n\nUsers will be able to generate accounts with this ID again.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/bvn-blacklist/' + blacklistId, { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast(data.message || 'Removed from blacklist', 'success');
        await loadBlacklist();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // ===================== ORPHANED DEPOSITS (trapped funds) =====================

    async function loadOrphanedDeposits() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('orphanedDepositsTable');
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i><p>Loading…</p></div></td></tr>';
      // Reset stat cards
      document.getElementById('orpTotalAmount').textContent = '₦0';
      document.getElementById('orpUnreviewedAmount').textContent = '₦0';
      document.getElementById('orpTotalCount').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('orpUnreviewedCount').textContent = '0';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/orphaned-deposits');
        const list = data.deposits || [];
        const stats = data.stats || {};
        // Update stat cards
        document.getElementById('orpTotalAmount').textContent = '₦' + parseFloat(stats.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('orpUnreviewedAmount').textContent = '₦' + parseFloat(stats.unreviewed_amount || 0).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('orpTotalCount').textContent = stats.total_count || 0;
        document.getElementById('orpUnreviewedCount').textContent = stats.unreviewed_count || 0;
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--success);font-size:42px;"></i><p>No orphaned deposits</p><small style="color:var(--gray-400);">When someone sends money to a deleted user\'s old Flutterwave account, the deposit will appear here with the original owner\'s name.</small></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(d => {
          const date = d.received_at ? new Date(d.received_at).toLocaleString() : '—';
          const amount = '₦' + parseFloat(d.amount || 0).toLocaleString();
          const sender = d.sender_name || d.sender_account_number || '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);">Unknown</span>';
          const reviewedBadge = d.reviewed
            ? '<span class="badge badge-success">Reviewed</span>'
            : '<span class="badge badge-warning">Pending</span>';
          const actionBtn = d.reviewed
            ? `<button class="action-btn" onclick="viewOrphanedDeposit(${d.id})" title="View details"><i class="bi bi-eye"></i></button>`
            : `<button class="action-btn approve" onclick="reviewOrphanedDeposit(${d.id})" title="Mark as reviewed"><i class="bi bi-check2-all"></i></button>`;

          // ✅ Original Owner column — shows the banned user who USED to own this account
          let originalOwnerHtml = '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);">—</span>';
          if (d.original_user_fullname) {
            const bannedBadge = d.original_user_is_banned ? '<span class="badge badge-danger" style="margin-left:4px;font-size:9px;">BANNED</span>' : '';
            const maskedId = d.original_bvn_or_nin ? `${d.original_bvn_or_nin.substring(0,4)}***${d.original_bvn_or_nin.substring(7)}` : '—';
            originalOwnerHtml = `
              <div style="font-size:12px;">
                <strong>${d.original_user_fullname}</strong>${bannedBadge}<br>
                <small style="color:var(--gray-500);">${d.original_user_email || ''}</small><br>
                <small style="color:var(--gray-500);">📞 ${d.original_user_phone || '—'}</small><br>
                <small style="color:var(--gray-500);font-family:monospace;">${d.original_id_type || 'ID'}: ${maskedId}</small>
              </div>`;
          }

          return `<tr>
            <td style="font-size:12px;">${date}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:600;">${d.account_number || '—'}</td>
            <td style="font-size:12px;">${d.bank_name || '—'}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--success);">${amount}</td>
            <td style="font-size:12px;">${sender}</td>
            <td>${originalOwnerHtml}</td>
            <td>${reviewedBadge}</td>
            <td>${actionBtn}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color:var(--danger);font-size:42px;"></i><p>Failed to load orphaned deposits</p><small>' + err.message + '</small></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

    async function reviewOrphanedDeposit(depositId) {
      const note = prompt('Mark this deposit as reviewed.\n\nOptional note (e.g. "Refunded sender via bank transfer on 2024-01-15"):');
      if (note === null) return; // user cancelled
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/orphaned-deposits/' + depositId + '/review', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ note })
        });
        showToast(data.message || 'Marked as reviewed', 'success');
        await loadOrphanedDeposits();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    function viewOrphanedDeposit(depositId) {
      alert('This deposit is already marked as reviewed.\n\nTo view full details (raw Flutterwave payload), check the server logs or query the orphaned_deposits table directly in your Postgres database.');
    }

    // ===================== WEBHOOK LOGS (Flutterwave diagnostic) =====================

    async function loadWebhookConfig() {
      const box = document.getElementById('webhookConfigBox');
      box.innerHTML = 'Loading config...';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/webhook-config');
        const c = data.config;
        let html = '';

        // FLW_SECRET_HASH
        const hashOk = c.FLW_SECRET_HASH.set;
        html += `<div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;background:${hashOk ? '#d1fae5' : '#fee2e2'};border-left:4px solid ${hashOk ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'};">
          <strong style="color:${hashOk ? '#065f46' : '#991b1b'};">${hashOk ? '✅' : '❌'} FLW_SECRET_HASH:</strong>
          <span style="font-family:monospace;margin-left:8px;">${c.FLW_SECRET_HASH.preview || 'NOT SET'}</span>
          <br><small style="color:#475569;">${c.FLW_SECRET_HASH.purpose}</small>
        </div>`;

        // ROUTER_SECRET
        const routerOk = c.ROUTER_SECRET.set;
        html += `<div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;background:${routerOk ? '#d1fae5' : '#f1f5f9'};border-left:4px solid ${routerOk ? '#10b981' : '#cbd5e1'};">
          <strong style="color:${routerOk ? '#065f46' : '#475569'};">${routerOk ? '✅' : '⚪'} ROUTER_SECRET:</strong>
          <span style="font-family:monospace;margin-left:8px;">${c.ROUTER_SECRET.preview || 'NOT SET (optional)'}</span>
          <br><small style="color:#64748b;">${c.ROUTER_SECRET.purpose}</small>
        </div>`;

        // FLW_SECRET_KEY
        const keyOk = c.FLW_SECRET_KEY.set;
        const keyPreview = c.FLW_SECRET_KEY.preview || 'NOT SET';
        const isSandbox = keyPreview.includes('SANDBOX');
        html += `<div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;background:${keyOk && !isSandbox ? '#d1fae5' : (isSandbox ? '#fef3c7' : '#fee2e2')};border-left:4px solid ${keyOk && !isSandbox ? '#10b981' : (isSandbox ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444')};">
          <strong style="color:${keyOk && !isSandbox ? '#065f46' : (isSandbox ? '#92400e' : '#991b1b')};">${keyOk && !isSandbox ? '✅' : (isSandbox ? '⚠️' : '❌')} FLW_SECRET_KEY:</strong>
          <span style="font-family:monospace;margin-left:8px;">${keyPreview}</span>
          <br><small style="color:#475569;">${c.FLW_SECRET_KEY.purpose}</small>
        </div>`;

        // Webhook URL
        html += `<div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:14px;background:#dbeafe;border-left:4px solid #2563eb;">
          <strong style="color:#1e3a8a;">🔗 Expected webhook URL on Flutterwave dashboard:</strong>
          <br><code style="background:white;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;word-break:break-all;">${c.webhook_url_should_be}</code>
        </div>`;

        // Setup instructions
        html += `<div style="padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;">
          <strong style="color:#0f172a;">📋 Setup Instructions:</strong>
          <ol style="margin:8px 0 0 20px;padding:0;font-size:12px;color:#475569;line-height:1.7;">`;
        c.setup_instructions.forEach(step => { html += `<li>${step}</li>`; });
        html += `</ol>
        </div>`;

        // Critical warning if hash not set
        if (!hashOk) {
          html = `<div style="padding:14px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:14px;background:#fef2f2;border:2px solid #fecaca;color:#991b1b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;">
            <strong><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i> CRITICAL ISSUE DETECTED:</strong> FLW_SECRET_HASH is not set on Vercel. This is why your wallet funding via bank transfer is NOT working. Flutterwave IS sending webhooks but Yenllet is rejecting them silently. Follow the setup instructions below to fix this.
          </div>` + html;
        }

        box.innerHTML = html;
      } catch (err) {
        box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ef4444;">Failed to load config: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      }
    }

    async function loadWebhookLogs() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('webhookLogsTable');
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i><p>Loading…</p></div></td></tr>';
      // Reset stat cards
      document.getElementById('whTotalCount').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('whVerifiedCount').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('whRejectedCount').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('whProcessedCount').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('whLastReceived').textContent = '—';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/webhook-logs');
        const list = data.logs || [];
        const stats = data.stats || {};
        // Update stat cards
        document.getElementById('whTotalCount').textContent = stats.total_count || 0;
        document.getElementById('whVerifiedCount').textContent = stats.verified_count || 0;
        document.getElementById('whRejectedCount').textContent = stats.rejected_count || 0;
        document.getElementById('whProcessedCount').textContent = stats.processed_count || 0;
        if (stats.last_received_at) {
          const d = new Date(stats.last_received_at);
          document.getElementById('whLastReceived').innerHTML = d.toLocaleDateString() + '<br><small style="font-size:11px;">' + d.toLocaleTimeString() + '</small>';
        } else {
          document.getElementById('whLastReceived').innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-size:12px;">Never</span>';
        }

        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle" style="color:#ef4444;font-size:42px;"></i><p style="color:#ef4444;">No webhooks received yet</p><small style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">Flutterwave is NOT sending webhooks to Yenllet. This means either:<br>1. The webhook URL is not set on Flutterwave dashboard → Settings → Webhooks, OR<br>2. The webhook URL is set wrong (should be: https://yenllet.name.ng/api/wallet/webhook), OR<br>3. You haven\'t done a bank transfer to a virtual account yet.<br><br>Fix: log in to Flutterwave dashboard → Settings → Webhooks → set URL to https://yenllet.name.ng/api/wallet/webhook + set a secret hash → copy that hash to Vercel as FLW_SECRET_HASH env var → redeploy.</small></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }

        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(l => {
          const date = l.received_at ? new Date(l.received_at).toLocaleString() : '—';
          const event = l.event_name || '—';
          const acct = l.account_number || '—';
          const amount = l.amount ? '₦' + parseFloat(l.amount).toLocaleString() : '—';
          const sigMatch = l.signature_match || l.router_secret_match;
          const sigBadge = sigMatch
            ? '<span class="badge badge-success">✓ Valid</span>'
            : '<span class="badge badge-danger">✗ Mismatch</span>';
          let statusBadge, reasonHtml;
          if (l.processed) {
            statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-success">Processed</span>';
            reasonHtml = '<span style="color:#059669;font-size:11px;">Wallet credited successfully</span>';
          } else if (l.reject_reason) {
            statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-danger">Rejected</span>';
            reasonHtml = '<span style="color:#dc2626;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;display:block;max-width:300px;">' + (l.reject_reason || '').replace(/</g, '&lt;') + '</span>';
          } else {
            statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-warning">Pending</span>';
            reasonHtml = '<span style="color:#d97706;font-size:11px;">Signature valid but not yet processed</span>';
          }
          return `<tr>
            <td style="font-size:11px;">${date}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">${event}</td>
            <td style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;">${acct}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--success);font-size:12px;">${amount}</td>
            <td>${sigBadge}</td>
            <td>${statusBadge}</td>
            <td>${reasonHtml}<br><button class="action-btn" style="margin-top:4px;" onclick="viewWebhookLog(${l.id})" title="View raw payload"><i class="bi bi-eye"></i></button></td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color:#ef4444;font-size:42px;"></i><p>Failed to load webhook logs</p><small>' + err.message + '</small></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

    async function viewWebhookLog(logId) {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/webhook-logs/' + logId);
        const log = data.log;
        const payload = JSON.stringify(log.raw_payload, null, 2);
        const info = `Event: ${log.event_name || '—'}
Account: ${log.account_number || '—'}
Amount: ${log.amount ? '₦' + parseFloat(log.amount).toLocaleString() : '—'}
Tx Ref: ${log.tx_ref || '—'}
FLW Tx ID: ${log.flw_tx_id || '—'}
Signature Match: ${log.signature_match ? 'YES' : 'NO'}
Router Secret Match: ${log.router_secret_match ? 'YES' : 'NO'}
Processed: ${log.processed ? 'YES' : 'NO'}
IP: ${log.ip_address || '—'}
Received: ${log.received_at ? new Date(log.received_at).toLocaleString() : '—'}

Reject Reason: ${log.reject_reason || '(none)'}

--- RAW PAYLOAD ---
${payload}`;
        // Show in a new window since alert() truncates long text
        const w = window.open('', '_blank');
        w.document.write('<pre style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;padding:20px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word;">' + info.replace(/</g, '&lt;') + '</pre>');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    async function clearWebhookLogs() {
      if (!confirm('Delete ALL webhook logs? This cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/webhook-logs', { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast(data.message || 'Cleared', 'success');
        await loadWebhookLogs();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    async function loadAllTransactions() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/transactions');
        allTransactions = data.transactions || [];
        document.getElementById('allTxnTable').innerHTML = allTransactions.map(t => {
          const statusBadge = t.status === 'success' ? 'success' : t.status === 'pending' ? 'warning' : t.status === 'refunded' ? 'info' : 'danger';
          // ✅ Refund button — only show for successful debit/purchase transactions (not for credit/refund/credit types)
          const canRefund = (t.status === 'success' || t.status === 'failed') && t.type !== 'refund' && t.type !== 'credit' && parseFloat(t.total || 0) > 0;
          const refundBtn = canRefund
            ? `<button class="action-btn stop" onclick="refundTransaction(${t.id})" title="Refund to user wallet"><i class="bi bi-cash-refund"></i></button>`
            : '';
          // ✅ Resend receipt button — only for successful purchase transactions
          const canResend = t.status === 'success' && t.type !== 'refund' && t.type !== 'credit';
          const resendBtn = canResend
            ? `<button class="action-btn email" onclick="resendTransactionReceipt(${t.id})" title="Resend email receipt"><i class="bi bi-send"></i></button>`
            : '';
          const actionsHtml = (refundBtn || resendBtn) ? `<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;">${refundBtn}${resendBtn}</div>` : '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);font-size:11px;">—</span>';
          return `<tr><td>#${t.id}</td><td>${t.fullname || 'Unknown'}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400);font-size:11px;">${t.recipient || ''}</small></td><td><span class="badge badge-info">${t.type}</span></td><td>${t.service || '-'}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400);font-size:11px;">${t.provider || ''}</small></td><td>₦${parseFloat(t.total||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${statusBadge}">${t.status}</span></td><td>${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400);font-size:11px;">${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleTimeString()}</small></td><td>${actionsHtml}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-receipt"></i><p>No transactions</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    // ✅ Trigger CSV download — fetch with auth header, convert to blob, trigger download
    async function exportUsersCsv() {
      try {
        showToast('Generating CSV... please wait', 'success');
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/users/export.csv', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken } });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Export failed (HTTP ' + res.status + ')');
        const blob = await res.blob();
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `yenllet-users-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        showToast('CSV downloaded!', 'success');
      } catch (err) { showToast('CSV export failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }

    async function exportTxnsCsv() {
      try {
        showToast('Generating CSV... please wait (up to 5,000 transactions)', 'success');
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/transactions/export.csv', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken } });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Export failed (HTTP ' + res.status + ')');
        const blob = await res.blob();
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `yenllet-transactions-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        showToast('CSV downloaded!', 'success');
      } catch (err) { showToast('CSV export failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ Refund a transaction — credits the user's wallet + creates a new 'refund' transaction
    async function refundTransaction(txnId) {
      const reason = prompt(`Refund transaction #${txnId}?\n\nEnter the reason (the user will receive this via notification + email):`);
      if (reason === null) return;
      if (!reason.trim()) return showToast('A reason is required', 'error');
      if (!confirm(`CONFIRM: This will credit the transaction amount back to the user's wallet.\n\nOriginal transaction #${txnId} will be marked as 'refunded' and a new refund transaction will be created.\n\nProceed?`)) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/transactions/${txnId}/refund`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason }) });
        showToast(data.message || 'Transaction refunded', 'success');
        loadAllTransactions();
      } catch (err) { showToast('Refund failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ Resend email receipt for a transaction
    async function resendTransactionReceipt(txnId) {
      if (!confirm(`Resend the email receipt for transaction #${txnId} to the user?`)) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/transactions/${txnId}/resend-receipt`, { method: 'POST' });
        showToast(data.message || 'Receipt resent', 'success');
      } catch (err) { showToast('Resend failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ Reset user's transaction PIN to 1234 (or custom)
    async function resetUserPin(userId) {
      const pin = prompt(`Reset this user's transaction PIN.\n\nEnter a new 4-digit PIN (or leave blank for default "1234"):`);
      if (pin === null) return;
      const newPin = (pin || '').trim() || '1234';
      if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(newPin)) return showToast('PIN must be exactly 4 digits', 'error');
      if (!confirm(`Reset PIN to ${newPin}?\n\nThe user will be notified via notification + email and told to change it immediately.`)) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/users/${userId}/reset-pin`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ newPin }) });
        showToast(data.message || `PIN reset to ${newPin}`, 'success');
      } catch (err) { showToast('Reset failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ Open Edit User Profile modal — pre-fill with user's current details
    function openEditUserModal(userId) {
      const u = allUsers.find(x => x.id === userId);
      if (!u) return showToast('User not in cache. Refreshing...', 'error');
      selectedUserId = userId;
      document.getElementById('editFullname').value = u.fullname || '';
      document.getElementById('editPhone').value = u.phone || '';
      document.getElementById('editEmail').value = u.email || '';
      document.getElementById('editUserModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    async function saveUserProfile() {
      const fullname = document.getElementById('editFullname').value.trim();
      const phone = document.getElementById('editPhone').value.trim();
      const email = document.getElementById('editEmail').value.trim();
      if (!fullname || !phone || !email) return showToast('All fields are required', 'error');
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/users/${selectedUserId}/profile`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ fullname, phone, email }) });
        showToast('Profile updated! User notified via notification + email.', 'success');
        closeModal('editUserModal'); loadUsers();
      } catch (err) { showToast('Update failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
    }
