    // ===================== NOTIFICATION LOG =====================
    async function loadNotifLog() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('notifLogTable');
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i><p>Loading...</p></div></td></tr>';
      document.getElementById('nlTotal').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('nlRead').textContent = '0';
      document.getElementById('nlUnread').textContent = '0';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/notifications/log?limit=500');
        const list = data.notifications || [];
        let readCount = 0, unreadCount = 0;
        list.forEach(n => { if (n.is_read) readCount++; else unreadCount++; });
        document.getElementById('nlTotal').textContent = list.length;
        document.getElementById('nlRead').textContent = readCount;
        document.getElementById('nlUnread').textContent = unreadCount;
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-megaphone"></i><p>No notifications sent yet</p><small style="color:var(--gray-400);">Push notifications and broadcasts will appear here.</small></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(n => {
          const date = n.created_at ? new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString() : '—';
          const recipient = n.user_name ? `${n.user_name}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400);font-size:11px;">${n.user_email || ''}</small>` : '<span style="color:var(--gray-400);">All users</span>';
          const typeBadge = n.type === 'security' ? 'danger' : n.type === 'admin' ? 'info' : n.type === 'broadcast' || n.type === 'push' ? 'warning' : 'secondary';
          const readBadge = n.is_read ? '<span class="badge badge-success">Read</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-warning">Unread</span>';
          return `<tr>
            <td style="font-size:11px;">${date}</td>
            <td style="font-size:12px;">${recipient}</td>
            <td style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;">${n.title || '—'}</td>
            <td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-600);max-width:300px;">${(n.message || '').replace(/</g, '&lt;').substring(0, 120)}${n.message && n.message.length > 120 ? '...' : ''}</td>
            <td><span class="badge badge-${typeBadge}" style="font-size:10px;">${n.type || 'info'}</span></td>
            <td>${readBadge}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color:var(--danger);font-size:42px;"></i><p>Failed to load notification log</p><small>${err.message}</small></div></td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // ===================== API HEALTH CHECK =====================
    async function loadHealthCheck() {
      // Reset to "checking" state
      // ✅ FIX: Same lowercase convention as the forEach below — was using different
      // casing for the IDs which caused 'Cannot read properties of null' on the
      // first getElementById('hcClubkonnectStatus') (HTML is lowercase).
      ['Clubkonnect', 'Flutterwave', 'Checkmyninbvn', 'Resend'].forEach(name => {
        const el = document.getElementById('hc' + name + 'Status');
        if (el) { el.textContent = 'Checking...'; el.style.color = 'var(--gray-500)'; }
      });
      document.getElementById('healthCheckDetails').innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Checking all APIs... please wait (this can take 5-10 seconds for live pings).';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/health-check');
        const s = data.status;
        const details = [];
        // ✅ For each service: update its stat card with the live status + populate details block
        const services = [
          { key: 'clubkonnect', name: 'ClubKonnect', desc: 'Airtime / Data / TV / Electricity' },
          { key: 'flutterwave', name: 'Flutterwave', desc: 'Payments + Virtual Accounts' },
          { key: 'checkmyninbvn', name: 'CheckMyNinBvn', desc: 'BVN / NIN Verification' },
          { key: 'resend', name: 'Resend', desc: 'Transactional Emails' }
        ];
        services.forEach(svc => {
          const svcData = s[svc.key];
          // ✅ FIX: Use lowercase first-letter + lowercase rest for the ID suffix.
          // The HTML IDs are hcCardClubkonnect, hcCardFlutterwave, hcCardCheckmyninbvn, hcCardResend
          // — all lowercase (no camelCase). Without toLowerCase(), JS computes 'hcCardClubKonnect'
          // (capital K) which doesn't exist in the DOM → card is null → querySelector crashes.
          const idSuffix = svc.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + svc.name.slice(1).toLowerCase();
          const cardId = 'hcCard' + idSuffix;
          const statusEl = document.getElementById('hc' + idSuffix + 'Status');
          // ✅ Defensive: if the card element doesn't exist (template mismatch), skip silently
          const card = document.getElementById(cardId);
          if (!card || !statusEl) {
            console.warn('Health check card not found:', cardId);
            details.push(`<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);color:var(--gray-600);"><strong>${svc.name}</strong> — UI card not found (id=${cardId}). Service status: ${svcData.status || 'unknown'}</div>`);
            return;
          }
          const icon = card.querySelector('.stat-icon');
          if (!icon) return;
          // Reset icon background by status
          let iconBg, iconColor, statusText, statusColor;
          if (!svcData.configured) {
            iconBg = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#fee2e2,#fecaca);'; iconColor = 'var(--danger)';
            statusText = '⚠ Not configured'; statusColor = 'var(--danger)';
          } else if (svcData.status === 'up') {
            iconBg = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#d1fae5,#a7f3d0);'; iconColor = 'var(--success)';
            const latencyInfo = svcData.latency_ms !== null && svcData.latency_ms > 0 ? ` • ${svcData.latency_ms}ms` : '';
            statusText = `✓ Up${latencyInfo}`; statusColor = 'var(--success)';
          } else if (svcData.status === 'degraded') {
            iconBg = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#fef3c7,#fde68a);'; iconColor = 'var(--warning)';
            statusText = '⚠ Degraded'; statusColor = 'var(--warning)';
          } else {
            iconBg = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#fee2e2,#fecaca);'; iconColor = 'var(--danger)';
            statusText = '✗ Down'; statusColor = 'var(--danger)';
          }
          icon.style.background = iconBg;
          icon.style.color = iconColor;
          statusEl.textContent = statusText;
          statusEl.style.color = statusColor;

          // Add detail row
          let detailHtml = `<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);">
            <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--dark);">${svc.name} <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--gray-500);font-size:12px;">— ${svc.desc}</span></div>
            <div style="margin-top:4px;">Configured: <strong style="color:${svcData.configured?'var(--success)':'var(--danger)'}">${svcData.configured ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</strong> &nbsp;•&nbsp; Status: <strong style="color:${statusColor}">${statusText}</strong></div>`;
          if (svcData.latency_ms !== null && svcData.latency_ms > 0) detailHtml += `<div style="margin-top:2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);">Latency: <strong>${svcData.latency_ms} ms</strong></div>`;
          if (svcData.balance !== null && svcData.balance !== undefined) detailHtml += `<div style="margin-top:2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);">Wallet Balance: <strong>₦${parseFloat(svcData.balance).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>`;
          if (svcData.error) detailHtml += `<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;color:var(--danger);"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i> ${svcData.error}</div>`;
          detailHtml += `</div>`;
          details.push(detailHtml);
        });
        details.push(`<div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500);">Last checked: ${new Date(s.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</div>`);
        document.getElementById('healthCheckDetails').innerHTML = details.join('');
      } catch (err) {
        document.getElementById('healthCheckDetails').innerHTML = `<div style="padding:20px;background:#fee2e2;border-radius:10px;color:var(--danger);"><i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill"></i> Health check failed: ${err.message}<br><small>Make sure the latest server.js is deployed.</small></div>`;
      }
    }

    async function loadPricing() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/pricing');
        allPricing = data.pricing || [];
        filterPricing(currentPricingFilter, null);
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    let currentDataNetwork = 'all';
    let currentDataSubCat = 'all';

    function filterPricing(service, btn) {
      currentPricingFilter = service;
      document.querySelectorAll('#tab-pricing > .card-modern > .tabs-modern > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      const subTabsEl = document.getElementById('dataSubTabs');
      subTabsEl.style.display = (service === 'data') ? 'block' : 'none';
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function filterDataCategory(network, btn) {
      currentDataNetwork = network;
      document.querySelectorAll('#dataSubTabs > div:first-child > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function filterDataSubCat(cat, btn) {
      currentDataSubCat = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll('#dataSubTabs > div:last-child > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function renderPricingTable() {
      let filtered = allPricing.filter(p => p.service === currentPricingFilter);
      if (currentPricingFilter === 'data') {
        if (currentDataNetwork !== 'all') filtered = filtered.filter(p => p.provider === currentDataNetwork);
        if (currentDataSubCat !== 'all') filtered = filtered.filter(p => (p.category || 'general') === currentDataSubCat);
      }
      document.getElementById('pricingTable').innerHTML = filtered.map(p => {
        const profit = parseFloat(p.selling_price||0) - parseFloat(p.amount||0);
        const profitColor = profit > 0 ? 'color:var(--success)' : 'color:var(--danger)';
        return `<tr><td><span class="badge badge-info">${p.service}</span></td><td><strong>${p.provider}</strong></td><td>${p.plan || '-'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-secondary">${p.category || '-'}</span></td><td>${p.validity || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(p.amount||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><strong style="color:var(--primary)">₦${parseFloat(p.selling_price||0).toLocaleString()}</strong></td><td style="${profitColor}"><strong>+₦${profit.toLocaleString()}</strong></td><td>${p.cashback_percent || 0}%</td><td><span class="badge badge-${p.is_active?'success':'secondary'}">${p.is_active?'Active':'Inactive'}</span></td><td><button class="action-btn edit" onclick="editPricing(${p.id})"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deletePricing(${p.id})"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button></td></tr>`;
      }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="11"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-tags"></i><p>No pricing found</p></div></td></tr>';
    }

    function openPricingModal() {
      document.getElementById('pricingModalTitle').textContent = 'Add Pricing';
      document.getElementById('priceId').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceService').value = currentPricingFilter;
      document.getElementById('priceProvider').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pricePlan').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceValidity').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceCategory').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceAmount').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceCashback').value = '0';
      document.getElementById('priceActive').value = 'true';
      toggleAirtimePricing();
      document.getElementById('pricingModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function editPricing(id) {
      const p = allPricing.find(x => x.id === id);
      if (!p) return;
      document.getElementById('pricingModalTitle').textContent = 'Edit Pricing';
      document.getElementById('priceId').value = p.id;
      document.getElementById('priceService').value = p.service;
      document.getElementById('priceProvider').value = p.provider || '';
      document.getElementById('pricePlan').value = p.plan || '';
      document.getElementById('priceValidity').value = p.validity || '';
      document.getElementById('priceCategory').value = p.category || '';
      document.getElementById('priceAmount').value = p.amount;
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = p.selling_price;
      document.getElementById('priceCashback').value = p.cashback_percent || 0;
      document.getElementById('priceActive').value = p.is_active ? 'true' : 'false';
      toggleAirtimePricing();
      document.getElementById('pricingModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function toggleAirtimePricing() {
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      const isAirtime = service === 'airtime';
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').disabled = isAirtime;
      if (isAirtime) syncAirtimeSellingPrice();
    }

    function syncAirtimeSellingPrice() {
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      if (service === 'airtime') {
        document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = document.getElementById('priceAmount').value;
      }
    }

    async function savePricing() {
      const id = document.getElementById('priceId').value;
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      const body = {
        service: service,
        provider: document.getElementById('priceProvider').value,
        plan: document.getElementById('pricePlan').value || null,
        validity: document.getElementById('priceValidity').value || null,
        category: document.getElementById('priceCategory').value || 'general',
        amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceAmount').value),
        sellingPrice: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceSelling').value),
        cashbackPercent: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceCashback').value),
        isActive: document.getElementById('priceActive').value === 'true'
      };
      if (id) body.id = parseInt(id);
      if (!body.provider || isNaN(body.amount)) return showToast('Fill required fields', 'error');
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/pricing', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
        showToast('Pricing saved successfully', 'success');
        closeModal('pricingModal');
        loadPricing();
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function deletePricing(id) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this pricing?')) return;
      try { await api(`/api/admin/pricing/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); showToast('Pricing deleted', 'success'); loadPricing(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadResellers() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/resellers');
        const resellers = data.resellers || [];
        document.getElementById('resellersTable').innerHTML = resellers.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.fullname || '-'}</td><td>${r.email || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(r.monthly_fee||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${r.discount_percent || 0}%</td><td>${r.expires_at ? new Date(r.expires_at).toLocaleDateString() : '-'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${r.status==='active'?'success':r.status==='expired'?'danger':'secondary'}">${r.status}</span></td><td><button class="action-btn approve" onclick="toggleReseller(${r.id}, 'active')" title="Activate"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="toggleReseller(${r.id}, 'expired')" title="Expire"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-shop"></i><p>No resellers yet</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function toggleReseller(id, status) {
      try { await api(`/api/admin/resellers/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ status }) }); showToast(`Reseller ${status}`, 'success'); loadResellers(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadAds() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/ads');
        allAds = data.ads || [];
        document.getElementById('adsTable').innerHTML = allAds.map(a => {
          let actions = '';
          if (a.status === 'pending') {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn approve" onclick="approveAd(${a.id})" title="Approve"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="rejectAd(${a.id})" title="Reject"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>`;
          } else if (a.status === 'approved') {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn stop" onclick="stopAd(${a.id})" title="Stop Running Ad"><i class="bi bi-pause-circle"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deleteAd(${a.id})" title="Delete"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>`;
          } else {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deleteAd(${a.id})" title="Delete"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>`;
          }
          return `<tr><td>#${a.id}</td><td>${a.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td>${a.title}</td><td>${a.topic || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(a.total_amount||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${a.status==='approved'?'success':a.status==='stopped'?'warning':a.status==='rejected'?'danger':'secondary'}">${a.status}</span></td><td>${actions}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-badge-ad"></i><p>No ads</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function approveAd(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/approve`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad approved', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function rejectAd(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/reject`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad rejected', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function stopAd(id) { if (!confirm('Stop this running ad? Users will no longer see it.')) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/stop`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad stopped', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function deleteAd(id) { if (!confirm('Permanently delete this ad?')) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); showToast('Ad deleted', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }

    async function loadReviews() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/reviews');
        allReviews = data.reviews || [];
        document.getElementById('reviewsTable').innerHTML = allReviews.map(r => `<tr><td>#${r.id}</td><td>${r.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td>${'★'.repeat(r.rating)}${'☆'.repeat(5-r.rating)}</td><td>${r.comment || '-'}</td><td>${new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="5"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-star"></i><p>No reviews</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function sendBroadcast() {
      const type = document.getElementById('broadcastType').value;
      const title = document.getElementById('broadcastTitle').value;
      const message = document.getElementById('broadcastMessage').value;
      if (!title || !message) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');

      // ✅ Read image (file upload OR URL)
      let imageUrl = document.getElementById('broadcastImageUrl').value.trim();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('broadcastImageFile');
      if (fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        const file = fileInput.files[0];
        if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) return showToast('Image too large (max 2MB)', 'error');
        imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read image file'));
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
      }

      try {
        const payload = { type, title, message, target: 'all' };
        if (imageUrl) payload.imageUrl = imageUrl;
        await api('/api/admin/broadcast', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Broadcast sent', 'success');
        document.getElementById('broadcastTitle').value = '';
        document.getElementById('broadcastMessage').value = '';
        document.getElementById('broadcastImageUrl').value = '';
        if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/settings');
        const settings = {};
        data.settings.forEach(s => settings[s.key] = s.value);

        if (settings.welcome_bonus) {
          document.getElementById('wbEnabled').value = settings.welcome_bonus.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('wbAmount').value = settings.welcome_bonus.amount;
        }
        if (settings.referral_reward) {
          document.getElementById('rrEnabled').value = settings.referral_reward.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('rrAmount').value = settings.referral_reward.amount;
        }
        if (settings.spin_settings) {
          document.getElementById('spEnabled').value = settings.spin_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          const rewards = settings.spin_settings.rewards;
          const moneyR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'money') || {};
          const cashR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'cashback') || {};
          const dataR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'data') || {};
          document.getElementById('spMoney').value = moneyR.value || 0;
          document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value = moneyR.chance || 0;
          document.getElementById('spCashback').value = cashR.value || 0;
          document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value = cashR.chance || 0;
          document.getElementById('spData').value = dataR.value || '';
          document.getElementById('spDataChance').value = dataR.chance || 0;
        }
        if (settings.withdrawal_settings) {
          document.getElementById('minWithdrawal').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.min;
          document.getElementById('maxWithdrawal').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.max;
          document.getElementById('withdrawalFee').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.fee;
        }
        if (settings.kyc_settings) {
          document.getElementById('kycEnabled').value = settings.kyc_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('kycFee').value = settings.kyc_settings.fee || 0;
        }
        if (settings.charge_fee_settings) {
          document.getElementById('cfEnabled').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('cfType').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.type || 'percentage';
          document.getElementById('cfValue').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.value || 0;
        }
        if (settings.deposit_fee_note) {
          const n = settings.deposit_fee_note;
          document.getElementById('dfnEnabled').value = n.enabled !== false ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('dfnTitle').value = n.title || 'Flutterwave Processing Fee';
          document.getElementById('dfnBody').value = n.body || '';
          document.getElementById('dfnExample').value = n.example || '';
        }
        if (settings.reseller_settings) {
          document.getElementById('rsMonthlyFee').value = settings.reseller_settings.monthly_fee || 5000;
          document.getElementById('rsDiscount').value = settings.reseller_settings.discount_percent || 10;
          document.getElementById('rsEnabled').value = settings.reseller_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
        }
        if (settings.vendor_settings) {
          const vs = settings.vendor_settings;
          if (document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent')) {
            // ✅ BUG FIX: Use ?? (nullish coalescing) instead of || (OR) so that
            // an admin setting cashback/discount to 0 is preserved on reload.
            // `||` treated 0 as falsy → reloaded form reverted to defaults 5/2.
            // `??` only falls back to the default if value is null/undefined.
            document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent').value = vs.vendor_discount_percent ?? 5;
            document.getElementById('vendorCashbackPercent').value = vs.vendor_cashback_percent ?? 2;
            document.getElementById('vendorEnabled').value = vs.vendor_enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
            document.getElementById('vendorPortalOpen').value = vs.vendor_portal_open !== false ? 'true' : 'false';
            // ✅ Load admin-set minimum withdrawal (default ₦100 if not set yet)
            if (document.getElementById('vendorMinWithdrawal')) {
              document.getElementById('vendorMinWithdrawal').value = vs.vendor_min_withdrawal || 100;
            }
          }
        }
        // ✅ Load support contact (separate endpoint, returns the parsed object)
        loadSupportContact();

        // ✅ Load social media links (official Yenllet accounts shown on index.html footer)
        if (settings.social_links) {
          const s = settings.social_links;
          if (document.getElementById('socialFacebook')) document.getElementById('socialFacebook').value = s.facebook || '';
          if (document.getElementById('socialTwitter'))  document.getElementById('socialTwitter').value  = s.twitter  || '';
          if (document.getElementById('socialTiktok'))  document.getElementById('socialTiktok').value  = s.tiktok   || '';
          if (document.getElementById('socialLinkedin')) document.getElementById('socialLinkedin').value = s.linkedin || '';
          if (document.getElementById('socialInstagram')) document.getElementById('socialInstagram').value = s.instagram || '';
          if (document.getElementById('socialYoutube'))  document.getElementById('socialYoutube').value  = s.youtube  || '';
        }

        // ✅ Load Loyalty Tiers settings — the `loyalty_settings` row is a JSONB
        // value returned alongside all other admin_settings. Falls back to defaults
        // if missing so the form is usable on first load (before admin saves once).
        if (settings.loyalty_settings) {
          renderLoyaltySettingsForm(settings.loyalty_settings);
        } else {
          renderLoyaltySettingsForm(getDefaultLoyaltySettings());
        }

        // ✅ Load Streak Rewards settings — same pattern as loyalty above.
        if (settings.streak_settings) {
          renderStreakSettingsForm(settings.streak_settings);
        } else {
          renderStreakSettingsForm(getDefaultStreakSettings());
        }
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function saveSetting(key) {
      let value = {};
      if (key === 'welcome_bonus') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('wbEnabled').value === 'true', amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('wbAmount').value) };
      } else if (key === 'referral_reward') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('rrEnabled').value === 'true', amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrAmount').value) };
      } else if (key === 'spin_settings') {
        const noneChance = 100 - (parseInt(document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value) + parseInt(document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value) + parseInt(document.getElementById('spDataChance').value));
        value = {
          enabled: document.getElementById('spEnabled').value === 'true',
          rewards: [
            { type: 'money', value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('spMoney').value), chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value) },
            { type: 'cashback', value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('spCashback').value), chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value) },
            { type: 'data', value: document.getElementById('spData').value, chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spDataChance').value) },
            { type: 'none', value: 0, chance: noneChance > 0 ? noneChance : 0 }
          ]
        };
      } else if (key === 'withdrawal_settings') {
        value = { min: parseFloat(document.getElementById('minWithdrawal').value), max: parseFloat(document.getElementById('maxWithdrawal').value), fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('withdrawalFee').value) };
      } else if (key === 'kyc_settings') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('kycEnabled').value === 'true', fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('kycFee').value) };
      } else if (key === 'charge_fee_settings') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('cfEnabled').value === 'true', type: document.getElementById('cfType').value, value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('cfValue').value) };
      } else if (key === 'reseller_settings') {
        value = { monthly_fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rsMonthlyFee').value), discount_percent: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rsDiscount').value), enabled: document.getElementById('rsEnabled').value === 'true' };
      } else if (key === 'social_links') {
        // ✅ Save official social media links — shown as icons in index.html footer
        value = {
          facebook:  document.getElementById('socialFacebook').value.trim(),
          twitter:   document.getElementById('socialTwitter').value.trim(),
          tiktok:    document.getElementById('socialTiktok').value.trim(),
          linkedin:  document.getElementById('socialLinkedin').value.trim(),
          instagram: document.getElementById('socialInstagram').value.trim(),
          youtube:   document.getElementById('socialYoutube').value.trim()
        };
      }

      try {
        await api('/api/admin/settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ key, value }) });
        showToast('Settings saved successfully', 'success');
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    // ✅ Save Deposit Fee Note via the dedicated PUT /api/admin/deposit-fee-note endpoint.
    // This note is shown on the dashboard next to the account number + inside the
    // Fund modal, telling users that bank transfers incur a Flutterwave processing fee.
    async function saveDepositFeeNote() {
      try {
        const payload = {
          enabled: document.getElementById('dfnEnabled').value === 'true',
          title: document.getElementById('dfnTitle').value.trim() || 'Flutterwave Processing Fee',
          body: document.getElementById('dfnBody').value.trim(),
          example: document.getElementById('dfnExample').value.trim()
        };
        await api('/api/admin/deposit-fee-note', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Deposit fee note saved successfully', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed to save deposit fee note: ' + (err.message || ''), 'error');
      }
    }

    // ===================== SUPPORT CONTACT (banned-user phone number) =====================

    async function loadSupportContact() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/support-contact');
        const s = data.support || {};
        document.getElementById('supportPhone').value = s.phone || '';
        document.getElementById('supportWhatsapp').value = s.whatsapp || '';
        document.getElementById('supportEmail').value = s.email || '';
        document.getElementById('supportHours').value = s.hours || '24/7';
        // ✅ Update preview
        const preview = document.getElementById('supportContactPreview');
        if (preview) {
          const whatsappIntl = (s.whatsapp || s.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/^0/, '234').replace(/^234234/, '234');
          preview.innerHTML = `<strong>Banned users will see:</strong><br>
            📞 Phone: <strong>${s.phone || '—'}</strong> &nbsp;|&nbsp;
            <a href="tel:${s.phone || ''}" style="color:var(--primary);">Call</a> &nbsp;|&nbsp;
            <a href="https://wa.me/${whatsappIntl}" target="_blank" style="color:#10b981;">WhatsApp</a>
            ${s.email ? '&nbsp;|&nbsp; <a href="mailto:' + s.email + '" style="color:var(--gray-600,#475569);">Email</a>' : ''}
            <br><small style="color:var(--gray-400,#94a3b8);">Hours: ${s.hours || '24/7'}</small>`;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Endpoint might not be deployed yet — silently fall back to defaults
        console.warn('Support contact endpoint not available yet:', err.message);
      }
    }

    async function saveSupportContact() {
      const phone = document.getElementById('supportPhone').value.trim();
      const whatsapp = document.getElementById('supportWhatsapp').value.trim() || phone;
      const email = document.getElementById('supportEmail').value.trim();
      const hours = document.getElementById('supportHours').value.trim() || '24/7';
      if (!phone) return showToast('Please enter a support phone number', 'error');
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/support-contact', {
          method: 'PUT',
          body: JSON.stringify({ phone, whatsapp, email, hours })
        });
        showToast(data.message || 'Support contact saved', 'success');
        await loadSupportContact();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    function openWalletModal(userId) {
      selectedUserId = userId;
      walletActionType = 'credit';
      document.getElementById('walletAmount').value = '';
      document.getElementById('walletReason').value = '';
      document.getElementById('creditBtn').style.opacity = '1';
      document.getElementById('debitBtn').style.opacity = '0.5';
      document.getElementById('cashbackBtn').style.opacity = '0.5';
      document.getElementById('cashbackWarning').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('walletAmountWrap').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('walletModal').classList.add('active');
    }
    function setWalletAction(type) {
      walletActionType = type;
      document.getElementById('creditBtn').style.opacity = type === 'credit' ? '1' : '0.5';
      document.getElementById('debitBtn').style.opacity = type === 'debit' ? '1' : '0.5';
      document.getElementById('cashbackBtn').style.opacity = type === 'cashback' ? '1' : '0.5';
      // Show warning + hide amount field for cashback mode (amount is auto-detected)
      document.getElementById('cashbackWarning').style.display = type === 'cashback' ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('walletAmountWrap').style.display = type === 'cashback' ? 'none' : 'block';
    }
    async function executeWalletAction() {
      const reason = document.getElementById('walletReason').value;
      if (!reason || !reason.trim()) return showToast('A reason is required (the user will receive it)', 'error');

      if (walletActionType === 'cashback') {
        // ✅ Remove entire cashback balance via /api/admin/users/:id/remove-cashback
        if (!confirm('Are you sure? This will RESET the user\'s cashback balance to ₦0. Their wallet balance will NOT be affected. The user will be notified via notification + email.')) return;
        try {
          const data = await api(`/api/admin/users/${selectedUserId}/remove-cashback`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason }) });
          showToast(data.message || 'Cashback removed', 'success');
          closeModal('walletModal'); loadUsers();
        } catch (err) {}
        return;
      }

      const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('walletAmount').value);
      if (!amount || amount <= 0) return showToast('Enter valid amount', 'error');
      try {
        const endpoint = walletActionType === 'credit' ? '/api/admin/wallet/credit' : '/api/admin/wallet/debit';
        await api(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ userId: selectedUserId, amount, reason }) });
        showToast(`Wallet ${walletActionType}ed`, 'success'); closeModal('walletModal'); loadUsers();
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function syncClubKonnect() {
    if (!confirm('This will fetch the LATEST plans and prices directly from ClubKonnect API.\n\n- New plans will be added with 15% markup\n- Existing plans: base price updated, YOUR selling price preserved\n\nContinue?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Syncing from ClubKonnect... (10-20 seconds)', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/sync-clubkonnect', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Sync complete!', 'success');
      loadPricing();
      setTimeout(() => { filterPricing('data', null); }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Sync failed: ' + (err.message || 'Check ClubKonnect API credentials'), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function seedPlans() {
    if (!confirm('This will insert all 122 ClubKonnect data plans (MTN, Glo, Airtel, 9mobile) with categories.\n\nThis may take 10-20 seconds. Continue?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Seeding 122 plans... please wait (10-20 seconds)', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/seed-plans', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Plans seeded successfully!', 'success');
      loadPricing();
      setTimeout(() => { filterPricing('data', null); }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Seed failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  // ✅ Backfill ck_plan_code for plans that came in via "Sync from ClubKonnect"
  // (those plans have null ck_plan_code because CK's API doesn't always return
  // PRODUCT_CODE in a field we know how to read). This pattern-matches existing
  // plan names against the canonical CK codes from CK's docs.
  async function backfillCkCodes() {
    if (!confirm('This will pattern-match existing data plans and fill in their ClubKonnect product codes (ck_plan_code).\n\nUse this if you previously clicked "Sync from ClubKonnect" and data purchases are failing with "missing ck_plan_code".\n\nContinue?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Backfilling CK codes... please wait', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/backfill-ck-codes', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Backfill complete!', 'success');
      loadPricing();
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Backfill failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  // ===================== BULK RECALCULATE PRICING =====================
  // ✅ Open the modal — pre-fills with current default profit values
  function openRecalcPricingModal() {
    document.getElementById('recalcDataProfit').value = '35';
    document.getElementById('recalcTvProfit').value = '60';
    document.getElementById('recalcPricingModal').classList.add('active');
  }

  // ✅ Execute: calls /api/admin/recalculate-pricing with the chosen profit values
  async function executeRecalcPricing() {
    const dataProfit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('recalcDataProfit').value);
    const tvProfit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('recalcTvProfit').value);
    if (isNaN(dataProfit) || dataProfit < 0) return showToast('Enter valid data profit (₦)', 'error');
    if (isNaN(tvProfit) || tvProfit < 0) return showToast('Enter valid TV profit (₦)', 'error');
    if (!confirm(`Update ALL active data + TV prices?\n\n• Data plans: selling price = base + ₦${dataProfit} (you earn ₦${dataProfit} per sale)\n• TV plans: selling price = base + ₦${tvProfit} (you earn ₦${tvProfit} per sale)\n\nAirtime, electricity, bet, and education plans are NOT touched.\nManual edits to cashback/validity/category/ck_plan_code are preserved.\n\nProceed?`)) return;
    try {
      showToast('Recalculating prices... please wait', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/recalculate-pricing', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ dataProfit, tvProfit })
      });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Prices updated!', 'success');
      closeModal('recalcPricingModal');
      loadPricing();
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Recalc failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  // ✅ Dedupe pricing table — removes duplicate (service, provider, plan) rows,
  // keeping only the oldest entry (lowest id). Use after "Sync from ClubKonnect"
  // runs multiple times, or when you see the same plan appearing twice in the
  // Pricing tab.
  async function dedupePricing() {
    if (!confirm('Remove duplicate pricing rows?\n\nThis deletes any rows that share the same (service, provider, plan) — keeping only the OLDEST entry (lowest ID).\n\nUse this if you see the same plan appearing twice in the Pricing tab (often happens after running "Sync from ClubKonnect" multiple times).\n\nThis cannot be undone. Proceed?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Deduplicating pricing table... please wait', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/dedupe-pricing', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Dedupe complete', 'success');
      loadPricing();
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Dedupe failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  // ✅ Activate ALL pricing rows in one click — fixes the issue where plans
  // are marked inactive (is_active = FALSE) and don't show up on the user
  // dashboard. After clicking, all plans become visible to users immediately.
  async function activateAllPricing() {
    if (!confirm('Activate ALL pricing plans?\n\nThis sets is_active = TRUE on every pricing row in the database. Use this if users are seeing "No plans available" when clicking on a provider (Glo, MTN, DStv, etc.) in the purchase modals.\n\nProceed?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Activating all pricing rows...', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/activate-all-pricing', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'All plans activated', 'success');
      loadPricing();
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Activate failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function banUser(id) { const reason = prompt('Ban reason:'); if (!reason) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/ban`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason }) }); showToast('User banned', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function unbanUser(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/unban`, { method: 'POST' }); showToast('User unbanned', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {} }

    // ===================== DELETE BANK ACCOUNT + BLACKLIST BVN/NIN =====================
    let deleteAccountUserId = null;
    function openDeleteAccountModal(userId, userName, accountNumber, kycStatus) {
      deleteAccountUserId = userId;
      document.getElementById('delAcctUserName').textContent = userName || '—';
      document.getElementById('delAcctUserAcct').textContent = accountNumber || '(no account)';
      document.getElementById('delAcctUserKyc').textContent = kycStatus || 'pending';
      document.getElementById('delAcctReason').value = '';
      document.getElementById('delAcctBlacklist').value = 'true';
      document.getElementById('delAcctBanUser').value = 'true';
      document.getElementById('deleteAccountModal').classList.add('active');
    }
    async function executeDeleteAccount() {
      const reason = document.getElementById('delAcctReason').value.trim();
      const blacklistId = document.getElementById('delAcctBlacklist').value === 'true';
      const banUser = document.getElementById('delAcctBanUser').value === 'true';
      if (!reason) return showToast('Please enter a reason — the user will receive it.', 'error');
      const bullets = ['• Delete the user\'s bank account + BVN/NIN from Yenllet'];
      if (blacklistId) bullets.push('• Blacklist the BVN/NIN (cannot be used again on Yenllet)');
      if (banUser) bullets.push('• BAN the user (they can no longer log in to Yenllet)');
      bullets.push('• Send a notification + email to the user');
      bullets.push('• The user\'s wallet balance is NOT affected');
      bullets.push('• The old Flutterwave virtual account still exists on Flutterwave\'s side (Flutterwave does not allow deletion). Any money sent to it will appear in the "Orphaned Deposits" tab.');
      const confirmMsg = `Are you sure?\n\nThis will:\n${bullets.join('\n')}\n\nProceed?`;
      if (!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/users/${deleteAccountUserId}/delete-account`, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ reason, blacklist_id: blacklistId, ban_user: banUser })
        });
        showToast(data.message || 'Account deleted', 'success');
        closeModal('deleteAccountModal');
        loadUsers();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Delete failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); }
    function showToast(msg, type = 'success') { const toast = document.getElementById('toast'); toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type==='success'?'check-circle-fill':'x-circle-fill'}"></i> ${msg}`; toast.className = 'toast-modern ' + type + ' show'; setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500); }
    function showLoading(show) { document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.toggle('active', show); }
    function adminLogout() { localStorage.removeItem('adminToken'); window.location.href = 'admin-login.html'; }

When users apply from their dashboard, they will appear here for approval.</p>'; return; }

              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;">
                <span style="padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${v.vendor_status==='approved'?'#d1fae5':v.vendor_status==='pending'?'#fef3c7':'#fee2e2'};color:${v.vendor_status==='approved'?'#059669':v.vendor_status==='pending'?'#d97706':'#dc2626'};">${v.vendor_status.toUpperCase()}</span>
