    // ✅ Render the quick-add chips on FAQ tab open
    function renderQuickFaqButtons() {
      const container = document.getElementById('quickFaqButtons');
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = '';
      COMMON_FAQS.forEach((faq, idx) => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);background:white;color:var(--gray-700);border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;';
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-plus-circle" style="margin-right:4px;color:var(--primary);"></i>' + (faq.q.length > 50 ? faq.q.substring(0, 50) + '...' : faq.q);
        btn.onmouseenter = () => { btn.style.background = 'var(--primary-light)'; btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--primary)'; btn.style.color = 'var(--primary)'; };
        btn.onmouseleave = () => { btn.style.background = 'white'; btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--gray-200)'; btn.style.color = 'var(--gray-700)'; };
        btn.onclick = () => {
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value = faq.q;
          document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value = faq.a;
          // Scroll the form into view
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').focus();
          showToast('Loaded! Review and tap "Add FAQ" below to save.', 'success');
        };
        container.appendChild(btn);
      });
    }

    function clearFaqForm() {
      document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value = '';
      document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value = '';
      document.getElementById('faqQuestion').focus();
    }

    // ✅ Bulk insert all 12 common FAQs at once. Skips duplicates (matches by question text).
    async function addAllCommonFaqs() {
      if (!confirm('This will save all 12 common Yenllet FAQs to your database. Continue?')) return;
      let added = 0, failed = 0;
      showLoading(true);
      // Fetch existing FAQs first so we don't double-insert
      let existing = [];
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/faq');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) existing = data.questions.map(q => q.question.trim().toLowerCase());
      } catch(e) {}

      for (const faq of COMMON_FAQS) {
        if (existing.includes(faq.q.trim().toLowerCase())) continue; // skip duplicates
        try {
          await api('/api/admin/faq', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ question: faq.q, answer: faq.a }) });
          added++;
          // Tiny delay so we don't hammer the database
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150));
        } catch(e) {
          failed++;
        }
      }
      showLoading(false);
      if (added > 0) showToast(`Added ${added} FAQs successfully!${failed > 0 ? ' (' + failed + ' failed)' : ''}`, 'success');
      else if (failed === 0 && added === 0) showToast('All 12 FAQs already exist — nothing to add.', 'success');
      else showToast(`Failed to add FAQs. Is server.js deployed?`, 'error');
      loadFaqList();
    }

    // ==================== PUSH NOTIFICATION SENDER ====================
    async function sendPushToAll() {
      const title = document.getElementById('pushTitle').value.trim();
      const body = document.getElementById('pushBody').value.trim();
      if (!title || !body) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');
      if (!confirm('Send push notification to ALL users with push_enabled=true?\n\nThis cannot be undone.')) return;

      // ✅ Read image (file upload OR URL)
      let imageUrl = document.getElementById('pushImageUrl').value.trim();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('pushImageFile');
      if (fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        const file = fileInput.files[0];
        if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) return showToast('Image too large (max 2MB)', 'error');
        imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read image file'));
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
      }

      try {
        const payload = { title, body };
        if (imageUrl) payload.imageUrl = imageUrl;
        const data = await api('/api/admin/push-notification', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        const count = data.stats?.successCount || 0;
        const failed = data.stats?.failureCount || 0;
        showToast(`Push sent to ${count} device${count===1?'':'s'}${failed>0?` (${failed} failed)`:''}!`, count > 0 ? 'success' : 'error');
        if (count > 0) {
          document.getElementById('pushTitle').value = '';
          document.getElementById('pushBody').value = '';
          document.getElementById('pushImageUrl').value = '';
          if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
        }
      } catch(e) { showToast('Push failed: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR SETTINGS ====================
    // ✅ FIX: vendorEnabled and vendorPortalOpen are <select> elements, not checkboxes.
    // Use .value === 'true' instead of .checked (which is always undefined on selects)
    async function saveVendorSettings() {
      const discount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent').value) || 0;
      const cashback = parseFloat(document.getElementById('vendorCashbackPercent').value) || 0;
      const enabled = document.getElementById('vendorEnabled').value === 'true';
      const portalOpen = document.getElementById('vendorPortalOpen').value === 'true';
      // ✅ Admin-set minimum withdrawal (default ₦100 if left blank or invalid)
      const minWithdrawal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('vendorMinWithdrawal').value) || 100;
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/vendor-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({
          vendorDiscountPercent: discount,
          vendorCashbackPercent: cashback,
          vendorEnabled: enabled,
          vendorPortalOpen: portalOpen,
          vendorMinWithdrawal: minWithdrawal
        }) });
        showToast('Vendor settings saved! New vendors will use these rates.', 'success');
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to save vendor settings', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== LOYALTY TIERS + STREAK REWARDS ====================
    //
    // Both cards live in the Settings tab. The loyalty_settings and
    // streak_settings rows in admin_settings are JSONB blobs that hold an
    // `enabled` flag + an array of tier/streak configs. We render them as
    // dynamic rows (admin can add/remove). On save we validate client-side
    // (basic sanitisation) and PUT to the dedicated endpoints, which re-sort
    // and re-validate on the server side.

    // ✅ Default loyalty tiers — match the seed in server.js's initDatabase().
    function getDefaultLoyaltySettings() {
      return {
        enabled: true,
        tiers: [
          { name: 'Bronze',   min_spend: 0,     cashback_boost: 0, perk: 'Default tier — no extra perks' },
          { name: 'Silver',   min_spend: 5000,  cashback_boost: 1, perk: '+1% extra cashback on every purchase' },
          { name: 'Gold',     min_spend: 20000, cashback_boost: 2, perk: '+2% extra cashback + 1 free Spin & Earn spin per week' },
          { name: 'Platinum', min_spend: 50000, cashback_boost: 3, perk: '+3% extra cashback + free ₦500 monthly bonus' }
        ]
      };
    }

    // ✅ Default streak rewards — match the seed in server.js's initDatabase().
    function getDefaultStreakSettings() {
      return {
        enabled: true,
        rewards: [
          { days: 7,   bonus: 50 },
          { days: 30,  bonus: 500 },
          { days: 100, bonus: 2000 }
        ]
      };
    }

    // ✅ Build the HTML for one loyalty tier row (used for both initial load
    // and the "Add Tier" button). The row uses CSS classes (not IDs) so we
    // can have N of them and read them back via querySelectorAll.
    function buildLoyaltyTierRowHtml(t) {
      const tt = t || {};
      const name   = (tt.name || '').toString().replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      const min    = parseFloat(tt.min_spend || 0) || 0;
      const boost  = parseFloat(tt.cashback_boost || 0) || 0;
      const perk   = (tt.perk || '').toString().replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      return `
        <div class="loyalty-tier-row" style="background:var(--gray-50,#f8fafc);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <strong style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text);"><i class="bi bi-award"></i> Tier</strong>
            <button class="btn-modern" style="background:var(--danger,#ef4444);color:white;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="removeLoyaltyTierRow(this)"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i> Remove</button>
          </div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <div><label class="form-label-modern">Tier Name</label><input type="text" class="form-input-modern loyalty-tier-name" placeholder="e.g. Bronze" value="${name}" maxlength="50"></div>
            <div><label class="form-label-modern">Min Spend (₦)</label><input type="number" class="form-input-modern loyalty-tier-min" placeholder="0" min="0" value="${min}"></div>
            <div><label class="form-label-modern">Cashback Boost (%)</label><input type="number" class="form-input-modern loyalty-tier-boost" placeholder="0" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${boost}"></div>
          </div>
          <div><label class="form-label-modern">Perk Description</label><input type="text" class="form-input-modern loyalty-tier-perk" placeholder="e.g. +1% extra cashback on every purchase" value="${perk}" maxlength="200" style="width:100%;"></div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    // ✅ Render the whole loyalty form from a settings object — replaces all
    // rows in #loyaltyTiersList and sets the master toggle.
    function renderLoyaltySettingsForm(s) {
      if (!document.getElementById('loyaltyTiersList')) return; // settings tab not loaded yet
      const cfg = s || getDefaultLoyaltySettings();
      document.getElementById('loyaltyEnabled').value = (cfg.enabled !== false) ? 'true' : 'false';
      const list = document.getElementById('loyaltyTiersList');
      const tiers = Array.isArray(cfg.tiers) && cfg.tiers.length > 0 ? cfg.tiers : getDefaultLoyaltySettings().tiers;
      list.innerHTML = tiers.map(t => buildLoyaltyTierRowHtml(t)).join('');
    }

    function addLoyaltyTierRow() {
      const list = document.getElementById('loyaltyTiersList');
      if (!list) return;
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.innerHTML = buildLoyaltyTierRowHtml({ name: '', min_spend: 0, cashback_boost: 0, perk: '' });
      list.appendChild(wrap.firstElementChild);
    }

    function removeLoyaltyTierRow(btn) {
      if (!confirm('Remove this tier? Save to apply.')) return;
      const row = btn.closest('.loyalty-tier-row');
      if (row) row.remove();
    }

    // ✅ Read all visible loyalty tier rows from the DOM, validate, then PUT
    // to /api/admin/loyalty-settings. Server re-sorts by min_spend asc.
    async function saveLoyaltySettings() {
      try {
        const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#loyaltyTiersList .loyalty-tier-row');
        if (rows.length === 0) return showToast('Add at least one tier before saving', 'error');
        const tiers = [];
        rows.forEach((row, idx) => {
          const name  = row.querySelector('.loyalty-tier-name').value.trim();
          const min   = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.loyalty-tier-min').value) || 0;
          const boost = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.loyalty-tier-boost').value) || 0;
          const perk  = row.querySelector('.loyalty-tier-perk').value.trim();
          if (!name) throw new Error('Tier #' + (idx + 1) + ' is missing a name');
          if (boost < 0 || boost > 100) throw new Error('Tier "' + name + '" boost must be 0-100%');
          tiers.push({ name, min_spend: min, cashback_boost: boost, perk });
        });
        const payload = {
          enabled: document.getElementById('loyaltyEnabled').value === 'true',
          tiers
        };
        await api('/api/admin/loyalty-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Loyalty settings saved! Tiers re-sorted by min spend.', 'success');
        // Re-render so the visible order matches what the server stored.
        try {
          const data = await api('/api/admin/loyalty-settings');
          if (data && data.settings) renderLoyaltySettingsForm(data.settings);
        } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('Failed to save loyalty settings: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error');
      }
    }

    // ✅ Build HTML for one streak reward row.
    function buildStreakRewardRowHtml(r) {
      const rr = r || {};
      const days  = parseInt(rr.days || 0) || 0;
      const bonus = parseFloat(rr.bonus || 0) || 0;
      return `
        <div class="streak-reward-row" style="background:var(--gray-50,#f8fafc);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <strong style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text);"><i class="bi bi-fire"></i> Streak Reward</strong>
            <button class="btn-modern" style="background:var(--danger,#ef4444);color:white;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="removeStreakRewardRow(this)"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i> Remove</button>
          </div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;">
            <div><label class="form-label-modern">Streak Length (days)</label><input type="number" class="form-input-modern streak-reward-days" placeholder="7" min="1" value="${days}"></div>
            <div><label class="form-label-modern">Bonus Amount (₦)</label><input type="number" class="form-input-modern streak-reward-bonus" placeholder="50" min="0" value="${bonus}"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderStreakSettingsForm(s) {
      if (!document.getElementById('streakRewardsList')) return; // settings tab not loaded yet
      const cfg = s || getDefaultStreakSettings();
      document.getElementById('streakEnabled').value = (cfg.enabled !== false) ? 'true' : 'false';
      const list = document.getElementById('streakRewardsList');
      const rewards = Array.isArray(cfg.rewards) && cfg.rewards.length > 0 ? cfg.rewards : getDefaultStreakSettings().rewards;
      list.innerHTML = rewards.map(r => buildStreakRewardRowHtml(r)).join('');
    }

    function addStreakRewardRow() {
      const list = document.getElementById('streakRewardsList');
      if (!list) return;
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.innerHTML = buildStreakRewardRowHtml({ days: 7, bonus: 50 });
      list.appendChild(wrap.firstElementChild);
    }

    function removeStreakRewardRow(btn) {
      if (!confirm('Remove this streak reward? Save to apply.')) return;
      const row = btn.closest('.streak-reward-row');
      if (row) row.remove();
    }

    async function saveStreakSettings() {
      try {
        const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#streakRewardsList .streak-reward-row');
        if (rows.length === 0) return showToast('Add at least one streak reward before saving', 'error');
        const rewards = [];
        rows.forEach((row, idx) => {
          const days  = parseInt(row.querySelector('.streak-reward-days').value) || 0;
          const bonus = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.streak-reward-bonus').value) || 0;
          if (days < 1) throw new Error('Streak reward #' + (idx + 1) + ': days must be at least 1');
          if (bonus < 0) throw new Error('Streak reward #' + (idx + 1) + ': bonus cannot be negative');
          rewards.push({ days, bonus });
        });
        const payload = {
          enabled: document.getElementById('streakEnabled').value === 'true',
          rewards
        };
        await api('/api/admin/streak-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Streak settings saved! Rewards re-sorted by days ascending.', 'success');
        try {
          const data = await api('/api/admin/streak-settings');
          if (data && data.settings) renderStreakSettingsForm(data.settings);
        } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('Failed to save streak settings: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error');
      }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR WEEKLY TARGETS ====================
    async function loadVendorTargets() {
      // ✅ Try to load settings; if endpoint is missing (404), fall back to defaults
      // so the form is still usable. This prevents the whole tab from breaking
      // when the user hasn't deployed the latest server.js yet.
      let s = { enabled: false, bonus_amount: 1000, referrals_needed: 10, active_users_needed: 5, transactions_per_user: 1, reset_day: 1 };
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-settings');
        if (data && data.settings) s = data.settings;
      } catch (e) {
        // Endpoint not deployed yet — show a warning toast, but continue with defaults
        showToast('Vendor target settings endpoint not deployed. Update server.js to enable loading/saving.', 'error');
      }
      try {
        if (document.getElementById('vtEnabled')) {
          document.getElementById('vtEnabled').value = (s.enabled !== false).toString();
          document.getElementById('vtBonus').value = s.bonus_amount || 1000;
          document.getElementById('vtReferrals').value = s.referrals_needed || 10;
          document.getElementById('vtActiveUsers').value = s.active_users_needed || 5;
          document.getElementById('vtTxnsPerUser').value = s.transactions_per_user || 1;
          document.getElementById('vtResetDay').value = String(s.reset_day || 1);
          const days = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
          document.getElementById('vtResetDayDisplay').textContent = days[s.reset_day || 1];
        }
      } catch(e) { console.warn('vendor-target-settings load failed:', e.message); }

      try {
        const progData = await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-progress');
        const el = document.getElementById('vendorTargetList');
        const list = progData.progress || [];
        if (list.length === 0) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;"><i class="bi bi-people" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No active vendors yet.</p>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(v => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
              <strong>${v.fullname}</strong>
              ${v.claimed_this_week ? '<span class="badge badge-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i> Claimed</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-warning">In Progress</span>'}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);">Referrals: <strong>${v.referral_count}/${v.referrals_needed}</strong> &nbsp;•&nbsp; Active Users: <strong>${v.active_users_count}/${v.active_users_needed}</strong></div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('vendorTargetList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Progress endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function saveVendorTargetSettings() {
      const payload = {
        enabled: document.getElementById('vtEnabled').value === 'true',
        bonus_amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('vtBonus').value) || 0,
        referrals_needed: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtReferrals').value) || 0,
        active_users_needed: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtActiveUsers').value) || 0,
        transactions_per_user: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtTxnsPerUser').value) || 1,
        reset_day: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtResetDay').value)
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Vendor target settings saved!', 'success');
        loadVendorTargets();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to save target settings', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR WITHDRAWALS ====================
    async function loadVendorWithdrawals() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals');
        const list = data.withdrawals || [];
        const stats = data.stats || { pending: 0, approved: 0, rejected: 0 };
        document.getElementById('wdPending').textContent = stats.pending || 0;
        document.getElementById('wdApproved').textContent = stats.approved || 0;
        document.getElementById('wdRejected').textContent = stats.rejected || 0;
        const el = document.getElementById('withdrawalList');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No withdrawal requests yet. When vendors request a withdrawal from their dashboard, it will appear here for approval.</p>';
          return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(w => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${w.vendor_name || 'Unknown Vendor'}</div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> ${w.vendor_email || '-'}</div>
                <div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">Amount: <strong style="color:var(--primary);">₦${parseFloat(w.amount||0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">Requested: ${new Date(w.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                ${w.reason ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">Note: ${w.reason}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;">
                <span style="padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${w.status==='approved'?'#d1fae5':w.status==='pending'?'#fef3c7':'#fee2e2'};color:${w.status==='approved'?'#059669':w.status==='pending'?'#d97706':'#dc2626'};">${w.status.toUpperCase()}</span>
                ${w.status==='pending' ? `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;"><button onclick="approveVendorWithdrawal(${w.id})" style="background:#10b981;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> Approve → Wallet</button><button onclick="rejectVendorWithdrawal(${w.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i> Reject</button></div>` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('withdrawalList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Withdrawal endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function approveVendorWithdrawal(id) {
      if (!confirm('Approve this withdrawal? The amount will be credited to the vendor\'s Yenllet wallet immediately. This cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals/${id}/approve`, { method: 'POST' });
        showToast(data.message || 'Withdrawal approved — wallet credited', 'success');
        loadVendorWithdrawals();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to approve: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    async function rejectVendorWithdrawal(id) {
      const reason = prompt('Reason for rejection (optional):');
      if (reason === null) return;
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals/${id}/reject`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason || 'Rejected by admin' }) });
        showToast('Withdrawal rejected', 'success');
        loadVendorWithdrawals();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to reject', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== GIFT BANNERS ====================
    function openGiftBannerModal() {
      // Clear form
      ['giftBannerFile','gbImageUrl','gbTitle','gbDescription','gbLinkTarget','gbStartDate','gbEndDate'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = '';
      });
      const cashEl = document.getElementById('gbCashback'); if (cashEl) cashEl.value = 500;
      const maxEl = document.getElementById('gbMaxClaims'); if (maxEl) maxEl.value = 100;
      const linkEl = document.getElementById('gbLinkType'); if (linkEl) linkEl.value = 'none';
      const restEl = document.getElementById('gbRestrictedService'); if (restEl) restEl.value = '';
      document.getElementById('giftBannerModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    async function createGiftBanner() {
      const title = document.getElementById('gbTitle').value.trim();
      if (!title) return showToast('Banner title is required', 'error');
      const cashback = parseFloat(document.getElementById('gbCashback').value) || 0;
      if (cashback < 50) return showToast('Cashback reward must be at least ₦50', 'error');
      let imageUrl = document.getElementById('gbImageUrl').value.trim();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('giftBannerFile');
      if (!imageUrl && fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        // Read file as base64 data URL
        imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read file'));
          reader.readAsDataURL(fileInput.files[0]);
        });
      }
      // ✅ Field names MUST match server.js /api/admin/gift-banners endpoint
      // Server expects: title, description, bannerImage, linkType, linkUrl,
      // internalSection, cashbackAmount, restrictedService, maxClaims, endDate
      const linkType = document.getElementById('gbLinkType').value;
      const linkTarget = document.getElementById('gbLinkTarget').value.trim();
      const payload = {
        title,
        description: document.getElementById('gbDescription').value.trim(),
        bannerImage: imageUrl,                                          // was image_url
        cashbackAmount: cashback,                                       // was cashback_amount
        maxClaims: parseInt(document.getElementById('gbMaxClaims').value) || 100,  // was max_claims
        linkType: linkType,                                             // was link_type
        linkUrl: linkType === 'url' ? linkTarget : null,                // was link_target
        internalSection: linkType === 'service' ? linkTarget : null,    // server uses internalSection for service links
        restrictedService: document.getElementById('gbRestrictedService').value || null,  // was restricted_service
        endDate: document.getElementById('gbEndDate').value || null     // was end_date (server doesn't use start_date - defaults to NOW())
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/gift-banners', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Gift banner created! It is now live for users.', 'success');
        closeModal('giftBannerModal');
        loadGiftBanners();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to create banner: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    async function loadGiftBanners() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/gift-banners');
        const list = data.banners || [];
        const el = document.getElementById('giftBannerList');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-megaphone" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No gift banners yet. Click "Create Gift Banner" above to set one up.</p>';
          return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(b => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;">
              ${b.banner_image ? `<img src="${b.banner_image}" alt="${b.title}" style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;">` : '<div style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dbeafe,#e0e7ff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="bi bi-megaphone" style="font-size:30px;color:var(--primary);"></i></div>'}
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${b.title}</div>
                ${b.description ? `<div style="font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">${b.description}</div>` : ''}
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);margin-top:8px;">
                  Cashback: <strong style="color:var(--success);">₦${parseFloat(b.cashback_amount||0).toLocaleString()}</strong>
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp; Claims: <strong>${b.claims_count||0}/${b.max_claims||'∞'}</strong>
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp; <span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${b.is_active?'#d1fae5':'#f1f5f9'};color:${b.is_active?'#059669':'#64748b'};">${b.is_active?'ACTIVE':'INACTIVE'}</span>
                </div>
                ${b.restricted_service ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#92400e;margin-top:4px;"><i class="bi bi-lock-fill"></i> Requires: ${b.restricted_service}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;">
                <button onclick="toggleGiftBanner(${b.id}, ${!b.is_active})" style="background:${b.is_active?'#f59e0b':'#10b981'};color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">${b.is_active?'Deactivate':'Activate'}</button>
                <button onclick="deleteGiftBanner(${b.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('giftBannerList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Gift banner endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function toggleGiftBanner(id, makeActive) {
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/gift-banners/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: makeActive }) });
        showToast('Banner ' + (makeActive ? 'activated' : 'deactivated'), 'success');
        loadGiftBanners();

    }

      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/gift-banners/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast('Gift banner deleted', 'success');
        loadGiftBanners();

    }

    // ==================== PROMO CARDS ====================
    // ✅ Open the Create Promo Card modal — clear form + load pricing data for dropdowns
    let allPromoCards = [];
    let promoCardPricingCache = null;

    function openPromoCardModal() {
      // Clear form
      ['promoCardFile','pcImageUrl','pcTitle','pcSubtitle','pcDisplayText'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) {
          if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' && el.type === 'file') el.value = '';
          else el.value = '';
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('pcService').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pcProvider').innerHTML = '<option value="">— Select service first —</option>';
      document.getElementById('pcProvider').disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('pcPlan').innerHTML = '<option value="">— Any plan —</option>';
      document.getElementById('pcPlan').disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('pcSortOrder').value = '0';
      document.getElementById('promoCardModalTitle').textContent = 'Create Promo Card';
      document.getElementById('promoCardModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    // ✅ When admin selects a service (data/tv/electricity/etc), populate the
    // Provider dropdown from the pricing table (distinct providers for that service)
    async function loadPromoCardProviders() {
      const service = document.getElementById('pcService').value;
      const providerSel = document.getElementById('pcProvider');
      const planSel = document.getElementById('pcPlan');
      providerSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Loading providers... —</option>';
      providerSel.disabled = true;
      planSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Any plan —</option>';
      planSel.disabled = true;
      if (!service) {
        providerSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Select service first —</option>';
        return;
      }
      try {
        // Use the existing /api/admin/pricing endpoint + filter client-side
        if (!promoCardPricingCache) {
          const data = await api('/api/admin/pricing');
          promoCardPricingCache = data.pricing || [];
        }
        const providers = [...new Set(promoCardPricingCache.filter(p => p.service === service && p.is_active).map(p => p.provider))].sort();
        if (providers.length === 0) {
          providerSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— No providers configured —</option>';
          showToast('No ' + service + ' providers found in pricing. Add some in the Pricing tab first.', 'error');
          return;
        }
        providerSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Select provider —</option>' + providers.map(p => `<option value="${p}">${p}</option>`).join('');
        providerSel.disabled = false;
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to load providers: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ When admin selects a provider, populate the Plan dropdown from the pricing table
    async function loadPromoCardPlans() {
      const service = document.getElementById('pcService').value;
      const provider = document.getElementById('pcProvider').value;
      const planSel = document.getElementById('pcPlan');
      planSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Any plan —</option>';
      planSel.disabled = true;
      if (!service || !provider || !promoCardPricingCache) return;
      // For services that don't have plans (airtime, bet, electricity), keep it disabled
      const hasPlans = ['data', 'tv', 'education'].includes(service);
      if (!hasPlans) {
        planSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— N/A for this service —</option>';
        return;
      }
      const plans = promoCardPricingCache.filter(p => p.service === service && p.provider === provider && p.is_active && p.plan);
      if (plans.length === 0) {
        planSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— No plans configured —</option>';
        showToast('No plans found for ' + provider + ' ' + service + '. Add some in Pricing tab.', 'error');
        return;
      }
      planSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Any plan —</option>' + plans.map(p => `<option value="${p.plan}">${p.plan} — ₦${parseFloat(p.selling_price||0).toLocaleString()}${p.validity ? ' (' + p.validity + ')' : ''}</option>`).join('');
      planSel.disabled = false;
    }

    // ✅ Save (create) the promo card
    async function savePromoCard() {
      const title = document.getElementById('pcTitle').value.trim();
      if (!title) return showToast('Title is required', 'error');
      const service = document.getElementById('pcService').value;
      if (!service) return showToast('Service is required', 'error');
      const provider = document.getElementById('pcProvider').value;
      const plan = document.getElementById('pcPlan').value;
      const subtitle = document.getElementById('pcSubtitle').value.trim();
      const displayText = document.getElementById('pcDisplayText').value.trim();
      const sortOrder = parseInt(document.getElementById('pcSortOrder').value) || 0;

      // Resolve image (file upload OR URL)
      let imageUrl = document.getElementById('pcImageUrl').value.trim();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('promoCardFile');
      if (!imageUrl && fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        const file = fileInput.files[0];
        if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) return showToast('Image too large (max 2MB)', 'error');
        imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read file'));
          reader.readAsDataURL(fileInput.files[0]);
        });
      }
      if (!imageUrl) return showToast('Image (upload or URL) is required', 'error');

      const payload = {
        title, subtitle, imageUrl, service,
        provider: provider || null,
        plan: plan || null,
        displayText: displayText || null,
        sortOrder
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/promo-cards', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Promo card created! It will appear on user dashboards immediately.', 'success');
        closeModal('promoCardModal');
        loadPromoCards();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to create promo card: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ Load all promo cards (active + inactive) for admin view
    async function loadPromoCards() {
      // Refresh cache so newly-added pricing rows show up
      promoCardPricingCache = null;
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/pricing');
        promoCardPricingCache = data.pricing || [];
      } catch(e) { /* non-fatal */ }

      const el = document.getElementById('promoCardList');
      el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Loading promo cards...</p>';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/promo-cards');
        allPromoCards = data.cards || [];
        if (allPromoCards.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-card-image" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No promo cards yet. Click "Create Promo Card" above to add one.</p>';
          return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = allPromoCards.map(c => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;">
              <img src="${c.image_url}" alt="${c.title}" style="width:90px;height:90px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--gray-200);" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${c.title}</div>
                ${c.subtitle ? `<div style="font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">${c.subtitle}</div>` : ''}
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);margin-top:8px;">
                  <span class="badge badge-info">${c.service}</span>
                  ${c.provider ? `<span class="badge badge-secondary" style="margin-left:4px;">${c.provider}</span>` : ''}
                  ${c.plan ? `<span class="badge badge-warning" style="margin-left:4px;">${c.plan}</span>` : ''}
                  ${c.display_text ? `<span class="badge badge-success" style="margin-left:4px;">Button: "${c.display_text}"</span>` : ''}
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp;
                  <span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${c.is_active?'#d1fae5':'#f1f5f9'};color:${c.is_active?'#059669':'#64748b'};">${c.is_active?'ACTIVE':'INACTIVE'}</span>
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp; Sort: ${c.sort_order || 0}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;">
                <button onclick="togglePromoCard(${c.id}, ${!c.is_active})" style="background:${c.is_active?'#f59e0b':'#10b981'};color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">${c.is_active?'Deactivate':'Activate'}</button>
                <button onclick="deletePromoCard(${c.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Promo card endpoint not available yet. Did you deploy the latest server.js?</p>';
      }
    }

    async function togglePromoCard(id, makeActive) {
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/promo-cards/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ isActive: makeActive }) });
        showToast('Promo card ' + (makeActive ? 'activated' : 'deactivated'), 'success');
        loadPromoCards();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to toggle promo card', 'error'); }
    }

    async function deletePromoCard(id) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this promo card? This cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/promo-cards/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast('Promo card deleted', 'success');
        loadPromoCards();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to delete promo card', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== LEADERBOARD PRIZE SETTINGS ====================
    // ✅ Load prize settings from /api/admin/leaderboard-prizes (falls back to defaults if not set)
    async function loadLeaderboardPrizes() {
      let settings = { first_prize: 10000, second_prize: 5000, third_prize: 3000, consolation_prize: 500, data_gift_gb: 1, min_referrals: 1, min_transactions_per_referral: 5 };
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/leaderboard-prizes');
        if (data && data.settings) settings = { ...settings, ...data.settings };
      } catch(e) { /* endpoint may not exist yet — use defaults */ }
      try {
        document.getElementById('lbFirstPrize').value = settings.first_prize || 10000;
        document.getElementById('lbSecondPrize').value = settings.second_prize || 5000;
        document.getElementById('lbThirdPrize').value = settings.third_prize || 3000;
        document.getElementById('lbConsolationPrize').value = settings.consolation_prize || 500;
        document.getElementById('lbDataGiftGb').value = settings.data_gift_gb || 1;
        document.getElementById('lbMinReferrals').value = settings.min_referrals || 1;
        // ✅ NEW: Min transactions per referred user (strict mode)
        document.getElementById('lbMinTxnsPerReferral').value = settings.min_transactions_per_referral || 5;
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    async function saveLeaderboardPrizes() {
      const payload = {
        first_prize: parseFloat(document.getElementById('lbFirstPrize').value) || 0,
        second_prize: parseFloat(document.getElementById('lbSecondPrize').value) || 0,
        third_prize: parseFloat(document.getElementById('lbThirdPrize').value) || 0,
        consolation_prize: parseFloat(document.getElementById('lbConsolationPrize').value) || 0,
        data_gift_gb: parseFloat(document.getElementById('lbDataGiftGb').value) || 0,
        min_referrals: parseInt(document.getElementById('lbMinReferrals').value) || 1,
        min_transactions_per_referral: parseInt(document.getElementById('lbMinTxnsPerReferral').value) || 5
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/leaderboard-prizes', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Leaderboard prize settings saved! Vendors will see the new amounts on their dashboard.', 'success');
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to save prize settings. Is server.js deployed?', 'error'); }
    }

    // ✅ ONE-CLICK prize distribution — credits all top 20 winners automatically
    // Fetches the leaderboard, then for each winner:
    //   - 1st place: first_prize to wallet
    //   - 2nd place: second_prize to wallet
    //   - 3rd place: third_prize to wallet
    //   - 4th-10th: consolation_prize to cashback_balance
    //   - 11th-20th: data_gift_gb GB data (if CK_USER_ID is configured)
    async function distributeMonthlyPrizes() {
      if (!confirm('This will AUTOMATICALLY credit the prizes to all top 20 vendors for this month.\n\nThis CANNOT be undone. Make sure you have reviewed the standings first.\n\nContinue?')) return;
      const resultBox = document.getElementById('lbDistributionResult');
      resultBox.style.display = 'block';
      resultBox.style.background = '#fef3c7';
      resultBox.style.color = '#92400e';
      resultBox.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Distributing prizes... please wait';
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/leaderboard/distribute-prizes', { method: 'POST' });
        const s = data.summary || {};
        resultBox.style.background = '#d1fae5';
        resultBox.style.color = '#065f46';
        resultBox.innerHTML = `
          <strong><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i> Prizes Distributed Successfully!</strong><br><br>
          <strong>1st Place:</strong> ${s.first_name || 'N/A'} — ₦${(s.first_prize||0).toLocaleString()} to wallet<br>
          <strong>2nd Place:</strong> ${s.second_name || 'N/A'} — ₦${(s.second_prize||0).toLocaleString()} to wallet<br>
          <strong>3rd Place:</strong> ${s.third_name || 'N/A'} — ₦${(s.third_prize||0).toLocaleString()} to wallet<br>
          <strong>4th-10th:</strong> ${s.consolation_count || 0} vendors — ₦${(s.consolation_prize||0).toLocaleString()} cashback each<br>
          <strong>11th-20th:</strong> ${s.data_gift_count || 0} vendors — ${s.data_gift_gb || 1}GB data each<br><br>
          <small>All winners have been notified via push notification + email.</small>
        `;
        showToast(`Prizes distributed to ${data.winners ? data.winners.length : 0} vendors!`, 'success');
        loadAdminLeaderboard(); // refresh the leaderboard view
      } catch(e) {
        resultBox.style.background = '#fee2e2';
        resultBox.style.color = '#991b1b';
        resultBox.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill"></i> Failed to distribute prizes: ' + (e.message || 'Unknown error') + '. Make sure server.js is deployed.';
        showToast('Distribution failed', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ==================== LEADERBOARD (admin view) ====================
    async function loadAdminLeaderboard() {
      // ✅ Load prize settings in parallel with the leaderboard
      loadLeaderboardPrizes();
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/leaderboard');
        const el = document.getElementById('leaderboardList');
        if (data.month) document.getElementById('leaderboardMonth').textContent = data.month;
        const list = data.leaderboard || [];
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-trophy" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No vendor activity yet this month. As vendors refer users, they will appear here.</p>';
          return;
        }
        const medals = ['🥇','🥈','🥉'];
        el.innerHTML = list.map((v, i) => `
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;background:${i < 3 ? '#fef3c7' : '#f9fafb'};border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800;width:40px;text-align:center;">${i < 3 ? medals[i] : (i+1)}</div>
            <div style="flex:1;">
              <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;">${v.fullname || 'Unknown Vendor'}</div>
              <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);margin-top:2px;">${v.referral_count} referrals • ₦${parseFloat(v.total_earnings||0).toLocaleString()} earned</div>
            </div>
            ${i < 3 ? `<i class="bi bi-trophy-fill" style="font-size:24px;color:${i===0?'#f59e0b':i===1?'#9ca3af':'#d97706'};"></i>` : ''}
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Leaderboard endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    // ==================== ALL SCHEDULES (admin oversight) ====================
    async function loadAllSchedules() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/scheduled-purchases');
        const list = data.schedules || [];
        const stats = data.stats || { active: 0, paused: 0, dueThisWeek: 0 };
        document.getElementById('schedActive').textContent = stats.active || 0;
        document.getElementById('schedPaused').textContent = stats.paused || 0;
        document.getElementById('schedDueThisWeek').textContent = stats.dueThisWeek || 0;
        const tbody = document.getElementById('schedulesTable');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i><p>No schedules created by users yet</p></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(s => `
          <tr>
            <td>${s.user_name || 'Unknown'}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${s.user_email || ''}</small></td>
            <td><span class="badge badge-info">${s.service}</span></td>
            <td>${s.provider || '-'}</td>
            <td>${s.recipient}</td>
            <td>${s.frequency}</td>
            <td>${new Date(s.next_run_date).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${s.is_active ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-secondary'}">${s.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Paused'}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('schedulesTable').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle"></i><p>Schedules endpoint not available yet</p></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

            <li><strong>User API Key</strong> — <code>yl_xxxxxxxx</code> — Generated from Profile &rarr; Developer API Key. Uses standard pricing.</li>
            <li><strong>Reseller API Key</strong> — <code>ylrsk_xxxxxxxx</code> — Generated from Profile &rarr; Reseller Program &rarr; Generate API Key. Uses discounted reseller pricing (requires active reseller subscription).</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <h4>Headers for every request:</h4>
        <div class="code-block">
          <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
          <pre>headers: {
  "x-api-key": "yl_your_api_key_here",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}</pre>
        </div>

      <!-- Getting API Key -->
      <div class="card" id="getting-api-key">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-magic"></i> Getting Your API Key</h2>
        <h3>User API Key (Standard)</h3>
        <ol>
          <li>Create a free account at <a href="https://yenllet.name.ng/register.html" style="color:var(--primary);">yenllet.name.ng/register.html</a></li>
          <li>Log in and go to <strong>Profile &rarr; Developer API Key</strong></li>
          <li>Click <strong>"Generate New Key"</strong></li>
          <li>Copy the generated key — it looks like <code>yl_a1b2c3d4e5f6...</code></li>
        </ol>
        <h3>Reseller API Key (Discounted)</h3>
        <ol>
          <li>Subscribe to the Reseller Program (₦5,000/month) from your dashboard</li>
          <li>Go to <strong>Profile &rarr; Reseller Program &rarr; Generate API Key</strong></li>
          <li>Copy the generated key — it looks like <code>ylrsk_a1b2c3d4e5f6...</code></li>
          <li>Reseller keys get the discount percentage applied to all purchases automatically</li>
        </ol>
        <div class="alert alert-warning">
          <strong>Important:</strong> Keep your API key secret. Never expose it in client-side code. Always use a backend server to make API calls. If your key is compromised, delete it immediately from your dashboard and generate a new one.
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- How Transactions Work -->
      <div class="card" id="how-transactions-work">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-receipt"></i> How Transactions Work</h2>
        <p>When you make a purchase request via the API (e.g., Buy Data), the following steps happen:</p>
        <ol>
          <li>The API deducts the exact selling price from your Yenllet wallet balance</li>
          <li>If you're a reseller, the discount is automatically applied before deduction</li>
          <li>The API routes the request to the network provider (ClubKonnect)</li>
          <li>If successful, it returns a success response with the Transaction ID</li>
          <li>If the provider fails, the funds are <strong>automatically refunded</strong> to your wallet</li>
          <li>You receive an email receipt for every successful transaction</li>
        </ol>
        <div class="alert alert-danger">
          <strong>Required:</strong> A 4-digit Transaction PIN is required for all purchase endpoints. This is the same PIN you set in your Yenllet dashboard (Profile &rarr; Transaction PIN). If you haven't set a PIN yet, do so before using the API.
        </div>
      </div>

        <!-- Next.js -->
        <div id="nextjs" class="tab-content" style="display:none;">
          <h4>Next.js API Route (app/api/buy-data/route.js)</h4>
          <div class="code-block">
            <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
            <pre>import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export async function POST(request) {
  const body = await request.json();

  const res = await fetch('https://yenllet.name.ng/api/v1/data', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'x-api-key': process.env.YENLLET_API_KEY, // Store in .env
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      provider: body.provider,
      phone: body.phone,
      plan: body.plan,
      pin: body.pin
    })
  });

  const data = await res.json();
  return NextResponse.json(data);
}</pre>
          </div>
        </div>

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, [
  CURLOPT_URL =&gt; "https://yenllet.name.ng/api/v1/airtime",
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER =&gt; true,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST =&gt; "POST",
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS =&gt; json_encode([
    'provider' =&gt; 'mtn',
    'phone' =&gt; '08012345678',
    'amount' =&gt; 500,
    'pin' =&gt; '1234'
  ]),
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER =&gt; [
    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "x-api-key: yl_your_api_key_here"
  ],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);
curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
?&gt;</pre>

      <!-- Errors -->
      <div class="card" id="errors">
        <h2><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i> Error Codes & Handling</h2>
        <p>All errors return a JSON response with <code>success: false</code> and an <code>error</code> message.</p>
        <table>
          <thead><tr><th>HTTP Status</th><th>Error Message</th><th>What to do</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>400</td><td>Missing required fields</td><td>Check that all required parameters are included in the request body</td></tr>
            <tr><td>400</td><td>Insufficient wallet balance</td><td>Fund your Yenllet wallet via card or bank transfer</td></tr>
            <tr><td>400</td><td>Invalid PIN</td><td>Use the correct 4-digit transaction PIN from your dashboard</td></tr>
            <tr><td>401</td><td>Missing API key</td><td>Add <code>x-api-key</code> header to your request</td></tr>
            <tr><td>401</td><td>Invalid or inactive API key</td><td>Generate a new API key from your dashboard</td></tr>
            <tr><td>403</td><td>Account is banned</td><td>Contact Yenllet support</td></tr>
            <tr><td>403</td><td>Reseller subscription required</td><td>Subscribe to the Reseller Program first</td></tr>
            <tr><td>502</td><td>Service provider error</td><td>The network provider (ClubKonnect) failed. Funds are auto-refunded. Retry the transaction.</td></tr>
            <tr><td>500</td><td>Server error</td><td>Try again. If persistent, contact support.</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="alert alert-success">
          <strong>Auto-Refund:</strong> If a transaction fails due to a provider error (502), the deducted amount is automatically refunded to your Yenllet wallet. No manual refund request needed.
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Webhooks -->

        <h2><i class="bi bi-question-circle-fill"></i> FAQ</h2>
        <h3>Do I need to verify BVN to use the API?</h3>
        <p>No. BVN/NIN verification is only required to generate a virtual bank account number. The API works with just an API key and transaction PIN.</p>

        <h3>How do I fund my wallet for API usage?</h3>
        <p>Log in to your Yenllet dashboard and fund your wallet via:</p>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>Debit card</strong> (Visa, Mastercard, Verve) — minimum ₦100</li>
          <li><strong>Bank transfer</strong> to your dedicated Sterling Bank virtual account (requires BVN verification)</li>
          <li><strong>USSD</strong> — select Flutterwave USSD option</li>
        </ul>

        <h3>What happens if a transaction fails?</h3>
        <p>If the provider (ClubKonnect) returns a failure, the deducted amount is <strong>automatically refunded</strong> to your Yenllet wallet within seconds. You'll receive a <code>502</code> error response with the provider's error message.</p>

        <h3>Can I use the same API key for multiple applications?</h3>
        <p>Yes. You can use the same API key across multiple applications. However, for security, we recommend generating separate keys for each application (especially for resellers).</p>

        <h3>Is there a test/sandbox mode?</h3>
        <p>Currently, Yenllet API is in production mode only. All transactions are real. We recommend testing with small amounts (₦100) before deploying to production.</p>

        <h3>How do I get the exact plan names for data purchases?</h3>
        <p>Call <code>GET /api/v1/plans</code> to get all available plans with their exact names. Use the <code>plan</code> field value in your <code>POST /api/v1/data</code> request.</p>

        <h3>Can I integrate Yenllet into my existing website?</h3>
        <p>Yes! The Yenllet API is designed for exactly this. Build a VTU website, a bills payment portal, or add airtime/data purchase to your existing platform using our REST API.</p>

        <h3>Who built Yenllet?</h3>
        <p>Yenllet was founded by <strong>Orjiekwe Princewill Chigozie</strong> and is a <strong>Gustmii company</strong>. It's built on Flutterwave (payments), ClubKonnect (VTU), CheckMyNinBvn (identity verification), and Resend (email receipts).</p>

  <script>
    function openTab(evt, tabName) {
      var i, tabcontent, tablinks;
      tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-content");
      for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
        tabcontent[i].style.display = "none";
        tabcontent[i].classList.remove("active");
      }
      tablinks = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-btn");
      for (i = 0; i < tablinks.length; i++) {
        tablinks[i].classList.remove("active");
      }
      document.getElementById(tabName).style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById(tabName).classList.add("active");
      evt.currentTarget.classList.add("active");
    }

    function copyCode(btn) {
      var pre = btn.parentElement.querySelector('pre');
      var text = pre.textContent;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> Copied';
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        setTimeout(function() {
          btn.innerHTML = 'Copy';
          btn.classList.remove('copied');
        }, 2000);
      });
    }

    // Smooth scroll for sidebar links
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar a').forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    async function loadBusiness() {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const userId = params.get('user');
      
      if (!userId) {
        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/business-page/${userId}`);
        const data = await res.json();

        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';

        if (!data.success || !data.business) {
          document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        document.getElementById('businessContent').style.display = 'block';

        let biz = data.business;
        if (typeof biz === 'string') {
          try { biz = JSON.parse(biz); } catch { biz = {}; }
        }

        document.getElementById('bizName').textContent = biz.businessName || data.fullname || 'Giprince Business';
        document.getElementById('bizDesc').textContent = biz.description || 'Giprince Services Provider';

        if (data.profilePic) {
          document.getElementById('bizAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${data.profilePic}" alt="${biz.businessName || 'Business'}">`;
        }

        const services = (biz.services || 'Airtime, Data, TV, Electricity').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s);
        document.getElementById('bizServices').innerHTML = services.map(s => `<span class="service-tag">${s}</span>`).join('');

        if (biz.whatsapp) {
          let waNum = biz.whatsapp.replace(/\D/g, '');
          if (waNum.startsWith('234')) waNum = waNum.slice(3);
          if (waNum.startsWith('0')) waNum = waNum.slice(1);
          const btn = document.getElementById('whatsappBtn');
          btn.onclick = () => window.open(`https://wa.me/234${waNum}`, '_blank');
          btn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
    loadBusiness();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  // ✅ API base URL — empty string means same-origin (works on Vercel/Render).
  // Required because Firebase, chat, saved-recipients and push-toggle code
  // all use `fetch(API + '/api/...')`. Without this declaration, those
  // calls throw "API is not defined" the moment they're triggered.
  const API = '';
  let currentUser = null, currentPin = '', pinAction = '', airtimeProvider = '', dataProvider = '', tvProvider = '', currentRating = 0, currentReceipt = null, useCashbackFlag = false, allPricing = [], isEmbeddedFromGustmii = false;
  function getToken() { return localStorage.getItem('token'); }
  async function handleGustmiiSSO() { const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search); const gustmiiToken = urlParams.get('gustmii_token'); if (!gustmiiToken) return false; document.getElementById('ssoLoadingScreen').style.display = 'flex'; document.getElementById('appBody').style.overflow = 'hidden'; try { localStorage.setItem('gustmii_token', gustmiiToken); const response = await fetch('/api/auth/gustmii-sso', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ gustmii_token: gustmiiToken }) }); const data = await response.json(); if (response.ok && data.success && data.yenllet_token) { localStorage.setItem('token', data.yenllet_token); localStorage.setItem('yenllet_user', JSON.stringify(data.user)); sessionStorage.setItem('embedded_from_gustmii', 'true'); isEmbeddedFromGustmii = true; window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname); document.getElementById('ssoLoadingScreen').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('appBody').style.overflow = ''; document.getElementById('gustmiiBanner').style.display = 'flex'; showToast('Welcome to Yenllet! Connected via Gustmii', 'success'); return true; } else { showSSOError(data.error || 'Could not connect to Yenllet'); return false; } } catch (err) { console.error('SSO error:', err); showSSOError('Network error. Please try again.'); return false; } }
  function showSSOError(message) { document.getElementById('ssoLoadingScreen').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('appBody').style.overflow = ''; document.body.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e293b);color:white;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;padding:20px;text-align:center;"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="font-size:56px;color:#ef4444;margin-bottom:20px;"></i><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;">Connection Failed</h2><p style="margin:0 0 24px;color:#94a3b8;font-size:14px;">${message}</p><a href="/login.html" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed);color:white;padding:12px 28px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">Go to Yenllet Login</a></div>`; }
  function closeYenlletAndReturnToGustmii() { sessionStorage.removeItem('embedded_from_gustmii'); if (window.parent !== window) { window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'close_yenllet_embed' }, '*'); } else { window.location.href = 'https://gustmii.name.ng/dashboard.html'; } }
  function toggleGustmiiEmbed() { const overlay = document.getElementById('gustmiiEmbedOverlay'); const iframe = document.getElementById('gustmiiIframe'); if (!overlay.classList.contains('active')) { const yenlletToken = getToken(); iframe.src = `https://gustmii.name.ng/dashboard.html?yenllet_token=${encodeURIComponent(yenlletToken)}`; } else { iframe.src = 'about:blank'; } overlay.classList.toggle('active'); }
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => { if (event.data && event.data.type === 'close_yenllet_embed') { const overlay = document.getElementById('gustmiiEmbedOverlay'); const iframe = document.getElementById('gustmiiIframe'); if (iframe) iframe.src = 'about:blank'; if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active'); } });
  function toggleTheme() { const next = document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'; document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', next); localStorage.setItem('theme', next); document.getElementById('themeIcon').className = next === 'dark' ? 'bi bi-sun-fill' : 'bi bi-moon-fill'; }
  function switchView(view) { document.querySelectorAll('[id$="View"]').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none'); document.getElementById(view + 'View').style.display = 'block'; document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active')); const navEl = document.querySelector(`[data-view="${view}"]`); if (navEl) navEl.classList.add('active'); if (view === 'analytics') loadAnalytics('month'); if (view === 'referral') loadReferralData(); if (view === 'profile') loadLoyaltyAndStreak(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); }
  function openModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; if (id === 'transferModal') loadSavedRecipients('transfer'); if (id === 'airtimeModal') loadSavedRecipients('airtime'); if (id === 'dataModal') loadSavedRecipients('data'); if (id === 'notifModal') loadNotifPrefs(); if (id === 'autoBuyModal') { loadSchedules(); updateAutoBuyFrequency(); } if (id === 'leaderboardModal') loadLeaderboard(); }
  function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; if (id === 'pinModal') { currentPin = ''; updatePinDisplay(); } }
  async function api(endpoint, options = {}) { showLoading(true); try { const token = getToken(); const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token && { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }), ...options.headers }; const storedGustmiiToken = localStorage.getItem('gustmii_token'); if (storedGustmiiToken) headers['x-gustmii-token'] = storedGustmiiToken; const res = await fetch(endpoint, { ...options, headers }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Request failed'); return data; } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, 'error'); throw err; } finally { showLoading(false); } }
  async function loadUserData() { try { const data = await api('/api/profile'); currentUser = data.profile; document.getElementById('walletBalance').textContent = '₦' + parseFloat(data.profile.wallet_balance || 0).toLocaleString('en-NG', {minimumFractionDigits:2}); const cashback = parseFloat(data.profile.cashback_balance || 0); if (cashback > 0) { document.getElementById('cashbackPill').style.display = 'inline-block'; document.getElementById('cashbackPill').innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-gift-fill"></i> Cashback: ₦${cashback.toLocaleString()}`; document.getElementById('quickCashback').textContent = '₦' + cashback.toLocaleString(); } else { document.getElementById('quickCashback').textContent = '₦0'; } document.getElementById('profileName').textContent = data.profile.fullname; document.getElementById('profileEmail').textContent = data.profile.email; /* ✅ KYC STATUS DISPLAY FIX: Previously, this only checked kyc_status === 'approved'. But a user who generated their account via NIN (where CheckMyNinBvn verification is pending review) has kyc_status = 'pending' even though they DO have an account_number. Showing "Not verified" to a user with an active account is confusing. NEW LOGIC: 1. If user has account_number → "Verified" (green check) — they have a working account, can receive money. 2. Else if kyc_status === 'approved' (BVN verified by Flutterwave) → "Verified" (still can generate account). 3. Else if kyc_status === 'pending' → "Pending verification" (yellow) — admin is reviewing their BVN/NIN. 4. Else → "Not verified" (gray). */ const hasAccount = !!data.profile.account_number; const isApproved = data.profile.kyc_status === 'approved'; const isPending = data.profile.kyc_status === 'pending'; if (hasAccount) { document.getElementById('kycStatus').innerHTML = 'Verified <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--success)"></i>'; } else if (isApproved) { document.getElementById('kycStatus').innerHTML = 'Verified <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--success)"></i>'; } else if (isPending) { document.getElementById('kycStatus').innerHTML = 'Pending verification <i class="bi bi-hourglass-split" style="color:var(--warning)"></i>'; } else { document.getElementById('kycStatus').innerHTML = 'Not verified <i class="bi bi-x-circle" style="color:var(--gray-400)"></i>'; } document.getElementById('pinStatus').textContent = data.profile.has_pin ? 'PIN is set' : 'Set your PIN'; if (data.profile.profile_pic) document.getElementById('profileAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${data.profile.profile_pic}" alt="Profile">`; if (data.profile.api_key) { document.getElementById('apiStatus').textContent = 'API Key is active'; document.getElementById('apiKeyInput').value = data.profile.api_key; } else { document.getElementById('apiStatus').textContent = 'Generate API Key'; document.getElementById('apiKeyInput').value = ''; } const accountEl = document.getElementById('accountNumber'), bankEl = document.getElementById('bankName'), kycBtn = document.getElementById('kycBtn'); if (data.profile.account_number) { accountEl.textContent = data.profile.account_number; bankEl.textContent = data.profile.bank_name || 'Yenllet Bank'; document.getElementById('copyAccountBtn').style.display = 'flex'; kycBtn.style.display = 'none'; } else if (data.profile.kyc_status === 'approved' && data.profile.kyc_bvn) { accountEl.textContent = 'Tap button to generate'; bankEl.textContent = 'Yenllet Bank'; kycBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-bank2"></i> Generate Account Number'; kycBtn.style.display = 'block'; } else { accountEl.textContent = 'Generate yours'; bankEl.textContent = 'Virtual Account'; kycBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-bank2"></i> Generate Account Number'; kycBtn.style.display = 'block'; } if (data.profile.business_page) { document.getElementById('bizStatus').textContent = 'Business page created'; loadBusinessPage(); } if (data.profile.gustmii_linked || isEmbeddedFromGustmii) { document.getElementById('gustmiiBanner').style.display = 'flex'; if (isEmbeddedFromGustmii) { const li = document.getElementById('logoutMenuItem'); if (li) li.style.display = 'none'; } } const sub = data.profile.reseller_subscription; const resellerStatus = document.getElementById('resellerStatus'); if (sub && sub.isActive) { resellerStatus.innerHTML = `<span class="reseller-badge active"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i> Active Reseller (${sub.discount_percent}% off)</span>`; } else if (sub && sub.isExpired) { resellerStatus.innerHTML = `<span class="reseller-badge expired"><i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill"></i> Expired</span>`; } else { resellerStatus.textContent = 'Become a Reseller'; } try { loadNotifPrefsFromProfile(data.profile); } catch(e) {} } catch (err) { console.error('loadUserData error:', err); } }

  async function handleAccountBtn() {
    // If user already has an account number, do nothing
    if (currentUser.account_number) return;
    // If user already has BVN verified, generate account immediately
    if (currentUser.kyc_status === 'approved' && currentUser.kyc_bvn) {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/profile/generate-account', { method: 'POST' });
        showToast(data.message, 'success');
        loadUserData();
      } catch (err) {}
      return;
    }
    // Otherwise, open the BVN → Account Number modal
    openModal('kycModal');
  }

  function updateIdHint() {
    const type = document.getElementById('generateIdType').value;
    const label = document.getElementById('generateIdLabel');
    const hint = document.getElementById('generateIdHint');
    const input = document.getElementById('generateBvn');
    if (type === 'nin') {
      label.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i>National Identification Number (NIN)';
      input.placeholder = '11-digit NIN';
      hint.innerHTML = 'Dial *346# on your phone to get your NIN, or check your NIN slip. Your NIN must match the name on your Yenllet account.';
    } else {
      label.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i>Bank Verification Number (BVN)';
      input.placeholder = '11-digit BVN';
      hint.innerHTML = 'Dial *565*0# on your phone to get your BVN. Your BVN must match the name on your Yenllet account.';
    }
    input.value = '';
  }

  async function generateAccountFromBvn() {
    const idType = document.getElementById('generateIdType').value;
    const idNumber = document.getElementById('generateBvn').value.trim();
    const label = idType === 'nin' ? 'NIN' : 'BVN';
    if (!idNumber) return showToast(`Enter your 11-digit ${label}`, 'error');
    if (idNumber.length !== 11) return showToast(`${label} must be exactly 11 digits`, 'error');
    if (!/^\d{11}$/.test(idNumber)) return showToast(`${label} must contain only digits`, 'error');
    try {
      const body = {};
      if (idType === 'nin') { body.nin = idNumber; } else { body.bvn = idNumber; }
      const data = await api('/api/profile/generate-account-from-bvn', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      });
      showToast(data.message || 'Account generated!', 'success');
      closeModal('kycModal');
      loadUserData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Account generation failed:', err);
    }
  }
  async function uploadProfilePic(event) { const file = event.target.files[0]; if (!file) return; if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return showToast('Image too large (max 5MB)', 'error'); const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = async (e) => { try { await api('/api/profile/picture', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ profilePic: e.target.result }) }); document.getElementById('profileAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${e.target.result}" alt="Profile">`; showToast('Profile picture updated!', 'success'); } catch (err) {} }; reader.readAsDataURL(file); }
