  // ===================== LOYALTY TIERS + STREAK REWARDS + QR TRANSFERS =====================

  // ✅ Tier colour map — used by the Loyalty Tier badge to colour the icon + progress bar.
  const TIER_COLOR_MAP = { Bronze: '#92400e', Silver: '#6b7280', Gold: '#d97706', Platinum: '#2563eb' };
  const TIER_GRADIENT_MAP = {
    Bronze:   'linear-gradient(90deg,#92400e,#d97706)',
    Silver:   'linear-gradient(90deg,#6b7280,#9ca3af)',
    Gold:     'linear-gradient(90deg,#d97706,#fbbf24)',
    Platinum: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)'
  };

  // ✅ Loads both /api/loyalty/status and /api/streak/status and updates the
  // two badges in the profile section. Called from switchView('profile').
  async function loadLoyaltyAndStreak() {
    if (!getToken()) return;
    try { await loadLoyaltyStatus(); } catch (e) { console.warn('loyalty status failed:', e.message); }
    try { await loadStreakStatus(); } catch (e) { console.warn('streak status failed:', e.message); }
  }

  async function loadLoyaltyStatus() {
    const data = await api('/api/loyalty/status');
    const L = data.loyalty || {};
    const wrap = document.getElementById('loyaltyStreakBadges');
    const badge = document.getElementById('loyaltyTierBadge');
    if (!badge) return;
    const tier = L.tier || 'Bronze';
    const color = TIER_COLOR_MAP[tier] || TIER_COLOR_MAP.Bronze;
    const gradient = TIER_GRADIENT_MAP[tier] || TIER_GRADIENT_MAP.Bronze;

    document.getElementById('loyaltyTierName').textContent = tier;
    document.getElementById('loyaltyTierIcon').style.background = color;
    document.getElementById('loyaltySpend').textContent = '₦' + parseFloat(L.spend || 0).toLocaleString();
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('loyaltyProgressBar');
    progressBar.style.width = (L.progress_pct || 0) + '%';
    progressBar.style.background = gradient;

    const progressText = document.getElementById('loyaltyProgressText');
    if (!L.enabled) {
      progressText.textContent = 'Loyalty program is currently disabled.';
    } else if (L.next_tier && L.next_tier_min_spend !== null) {
      const amt = Math.max(0, L.amount_to_next || 0).toLocaleString();
      progressText.textContent = `Spend ₦${amt} more to reach ${L.next_tier}`;
    } else {
      progressText.textContent = '🏆 You are at the highest tier!';
    }
    // Show the badge container if either loyalty or streak is showing.
    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'grid';
    badge.style.display = 'block';
  }

  async function loadStreakStatus() {
    const data = await api('/api/streak/status');
    const S = data.streak || {};
    const wrap = document.getElementById('loyaltyStreakBadges');
    const badge = document.getElementById('streakBadge');
    if (!badge) return;

      const bonus = parseFloat(S.next_reward.bonus || 0).toLocaleString();
      progressText.textContent = `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} to ₦${bonus} bonus`;
    } else {

    badge.style.display = 'block';
  }

  // ===================== MY QR CODE (show + share) =====================
  let myQrData = null; // cached { qr_content, user }

  // ✅ Loads the user's QR data + renders the QR onto #myQrCanvas using qrcode.js.
  // Called from openModal('myQrCodeModal') — but openModal is the generic function,
  // so we add a small hook here. The menu item calls openModal directly; we render
  // the QR lazily the first time the modal opens.
  let _qrLibReady = false;
  let _qrLibLoading = false;
  function ensureQrLibLoaded() {
    if (_qrLibReady || _qrLibLoading) return Promise.resolve(_qrLibReady);
    _qrLibLoading = true;
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const check = () => {
        if (typeof QRCode !== 'undefined' && QRCode.toCanvas) {
          _qrLibReady = true; _qrLibLoading = false; resolve(true);
        } else if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
          // Library might have failed — try re-injecting the script tag
          if (!document.getElementById('qrLibScript')) {
            const s = document.createElement('script');
            s.id = 'qrLibScript';
            s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode@1.5.3/build/qrcode.min.js';
            s.onload = () => { _qrLibReady = true; _qrLibLoading = false; resolve(true); };
            s.onerror = () => { _qrLibLoading = false; resolve(false); };
            document.head.appendChild(s);
          }
        }
        if (!_qrLibReady) setTimeout(check, 200);
      };
      check();
    });
  }
  // ✅ Preload the QR library as soon as the dashboard finishes loading
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { ensureQrLibLoaded(); });

  async function renderMyQrCode() {
    try {
      // ✅ Ensure the QR library is loaded BEFORE trying to render
      const ready = await ensureQrLibLoaded();
      if (!ready) { showToast('Could not load QR library. Check your internet connection.', 'error'); return; }

      if (!myQrData) {
        const data = await api('/api/qr/my-code');
        myQrData = data;
      }
      const canvas = document.getElementById('myQrCanvas');
      const text = myQrData.qr_content;
      // ✅ Use Promise wrapper around the callback-style API so we can await it
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        QRCode.toCanvas(canvas, text, { width: 220, margin: 1, color: { dark: '#0f172a', light: '#ffffff' } }, (err) => {
          if (err) reject(err); else resolve();
        });
      });
      document.getElementById('myQrFullname').textContent = myQrData.user.fullname || '---';
      document.getElementById('myQrAccount').textContent = myQrData.user.account_number || '---';
      document.getElementById('myQrPhone').textContent = myQrData.user.phone || '---';
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('renderMyQrCode failed:', err);
      showToast('Could not load your QR. Please try again.', 'error');
    }
  }

  // ✅ Share the QR — uses Web Share API with files (PNG) if available, otherwise
  // downloads the PNG. Mobile-first (this is the primary use case).
  async function shareMyQr() {
    try {
      if (!myQrData) { showToast('Loading your QR — please wait', 'error'); return; }
      const canvas = document.getElementById('myQrCanvas');
      canvas.toBlob(async (blob) => {
        const file = new File([blob], 'yenllet-qr.png', { type: 'image/png' });
        const shareData = {
          title: 'My Yenllet QR Code',
          text: `Send money to ${myQrData.user.fullname} on Yenllet — scan this QR with the Yenllet app!`,
          files: [file]
        };
        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
          await navigator.share(shareData);
        } else if (navigator.share) {
          // Web Share without files — share the text only
          await navigator.share({ title: shareData.title, text: shareData.text });
          showToast('Tip: screenshot your QR to share it as an image', 'success');
        } else {
          // Fallback: download the PNG
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url; a.download = 'yenllet-qr.png';
          document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          showToast('QR downloaded — share it from your files', 'success');
        }
      }, 'image/png');
    } catch (err) { showToast('Share failed: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
  }

  // ✅ Download QR as PNG (fallback for desktops / non-Web-Share browsers).
  function downloadMyQr() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('myQrCanvas');
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url; a.download = 'yenllet-qr.png';
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      showToast('QR image downloaded', 'success');
    }, 'image/png');
  }

  // Override openModal to render the QR when myQrCodeModal opens.
  const _originalOpenModal = openModal;
  openModal = function(id) {
    _originalOpenModal(id);
    if (id === 'myQrCodeModal') renderMyQrCode();
    if (id === 'scanQrModal') startQrScanner();
  };

  // ===================== SCAN QR TO PAY =====================
  let qrScanStream = null;
  let qrScanRaf = null;
  let qrScannedUserId = null; // set when a valid Yenllet QR is decoded

  // ✅ Open the device camera (rear-facing) and continuously decode frames with
  // jsQR until we get a valid Yenllet QR ({"yenllet_pay": true, "user_id": N}).
  async function startQrScanner() {
    const video = document.getElementById('scanQrVideo');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('scanQrStatus');
    const cameraView = document.getElementById('scanQrCameraView');
    const confirmView = document.getElementById('scanQrConfirmView');
    if (!video) return;
    cameraView.style.display = 'block';
    confirmView.style.display = 'none';
    statusEl.textContent = 'Requesting camera access…';
    // Reset any prior state
    qrScannedUserId = null;
    if (qrScanStream) { try { qrScanStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch {} qrScanStream = null; }
    if (qrScanRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(qrScanRaf); qrScanRaf = null; }
    try {
      qrScanStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' }, audio: false });
      video.srcObject = qrScanStream;
      await video.play();
      statusEl.textContent = 'Aim your camera at a Yenllet QR code…';
      const canvas = document.getElementById('scanQrCanvas');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
      const tick = () => {
        if (!qrScanStream) return; // scanner was stopped
        if (video.readyState === video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA) {
          const w = video.videoWidth || 300;
          const h = video.videoHeight || 300;
          canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, w, h);
          const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
          const code = (typeof jsQR !== 'undefined') ? jsQR(imageData.data, w, h, { inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert' }) : null;
          if (code && code.data) {
            handleQrScanResult(code.data);
            return; // stop the loop
          }
        }
        qrScanRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      qrScanRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Camera access failed:', err);
      statusEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--danger);"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i> Camera access was denied or is not available. ' + (err.message || '') + '</span><br><small>Tip: use Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android. Make sure you opened the page over HTTPS (camera requires HTTPS).</small>';
    }
  }

  // ✅ Parse the scanned QR text. Only accepts Yenllet QRs ({"yenllet_pay": true, "user_id": N}).
  // On success: stops the camera, looks up the recipient's name, and shows the confirm UI.
  async function handleQrScanResult(qrText) {
    let parsed = null;
    try { parsed = JSON.parse(qrText); } catch { parsed = null; }
    if (!parsed || parsed.yenllet_pay !== true || !parsed.user_id) {
      document.getElementById('scanQrStatus').innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--danger);"><i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill"></i> Not a valid Yenllet QR code. Try again.</span>';
      // Resume scanning after a short pause
      setTimeout(() => { if (qrScanStream) { document.getElementById('scanQrStatus').textContent = 'Aim your camera at a Yenllet QR code…'; qrScanRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickScanner); } }, 1200);
      return;
    }
    qrScannedUserId = parseInt(parsed.user_id);
    stopQrScanner();
    document.getElementById('scanQrStatus').textContent = 'QR scanned — confirming recipient…';
    document.getElementById('scanQrCameraView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('scanQrConfirmView').style.display = 'block';
    // Look up recipient details (we only trust user_id from the QR — server validates again).
    try {
      // The /api/qr/my-code endpoint only returns the caller's own data, so we
      // can't look up another user's full profile. We display what the QR gave
      // us and let the server validate on transfer. For better UX we still try.
      document.getElementById('qrRecipientName').textContent = 'User #' + qrScannedUserId;
      document.getElementById('qrRecipientAccount').textContent = '(verified on transfer)';
    } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
    document.getElementById('qrTransferAmount').value = '';
    document.getElementById('qrTransferRemark').value = '';
    document.getElementById('qrTransferPin').value = '';
    document.getElementById('qrTransferAmount').focus();
  }

  // Loop continuation helper (used after a "not a Yenllet QR" retry).
  function tickScanner() {
    const video = document.getElementById('scanQrVideo');
    const canvas = document.getElementById('scanQrCanvas');
    if (!video || !canvas || !qrScanStream) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    if (video.readyState === video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA) {
      const w = video.videoWidth || 300;
      const h = video.videoHeight || 300;
      canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, w, h);
      const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
      const code = (typeof jsQR !== 'undefined') ? jsQR(imageData.data, w, h, { inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert' }) : null;
      if (code && code.data) { handleQrScanResult(code.data); return; }
    }
    qrScanRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickScanner);
  }

  // ✅ Stop the camera stream + cancel the requestAnimationFrame loop.
  function stopQrScanner() {
    if (qrScanRaf) { try { cancelAnimationFrame(qrScanRaf); } catch {} qrScanRaf = null; }
    if (qrScanStream) { try { qrScanStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch {} qrScanStream = null; }
    const video = document.getElementById('scanQrVideo');
    if (video) video.srcObject = null;
  }

  // ✅ Public opener (called from the "Scan QR to Pay" profile menu item).
  function openScanQrModal() { openModal('scanQrModal'); }

  // ✅ Reset the Scan QR modal back to the camera view (after a successful or
  // cancelled transfer). Lets the user scan another QR immediately.
  function resetScanQrToCamera() {
    qrScannedUserId = null;
    document.getElementById('scanQrConfirmView').style.display = 'none';
    startQrScanner();
  }

  // ✅ Close handler for the Scan QR modal — must stop the camera to release it.
  function closeScanQrModal() {
    stopQrScanner();
    closeModal('scanQrModal');
  }

  // ✅ Submit the QR transfer — calls POST /api/transfer/qr with the scanned
  // user_id + amount + PIN + remark. Server validates everything.
  async function submitQrTransfer() {
    if (!qrScannedUserId) return showToast('No QR scanned — please scan again', 'error');
    const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('qrTransferAmount').value);
    const pin = document.getElementById('qrTransferPin').value.trim();
    const remark = document.getElementById('qrTransferRemark').value.trim();
    if (!amount || amount < 50) return showToast('Enter a valid amount (min ₦50)', 'error');
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(pin)) return showToast('Enter your 4-digit PIN', 'error');
    try {
      const result = await api('/api/transfer/qr', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({
        scanned_user_id: qrScannedUserId,
        amount,
        pin,
        remark
      }) });
      showToast(result.message || 'Transfer successful!', 'success');
      closeScanQrModal();
      loadUserData();
      if (typeof loadTransactions === 'function') loadTransactions();
    } catch (err) { showToast('Transfer failed: ' + (err.message || ''), 'error'); }
  }

  // ✅ Also stop the camera if the user navigates away or refreshes.
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', stopQrScanner);
</script>

<script>
  // Update toggle slider visual state based on checkbox
  function updateToggleSlider(checkboxId, sliderId, isChecked) {
    const slider = document.getElementById(sliderId);
    const checkbox = document.getElementById(checkboxId);
    if (!slider || !checkbox) return;
    checkbox.checked = isChecked;
    if (isChecked) {
      slider.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)';
      slider.innerHTML = '<span style="position:absolute;top:3px;right:3px;width:20px;height:20px;background:white;border-radius:50%;transition:0.3s;"></span>';
    } else {
      slider.style.background = '#cbd5e1';
      slider.innerHTML = '<span style="position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;background:white;border-radius:50%;transition:0.3s;"></span>';
    }
  }
  // Wire up the sliders on initial render
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  loadDepositFeeNote();
    updateToggleSlider('pushToggle', 'pushToggleSlider', false);
    updateToggleSlider('emailToggle', 'emailToggleSlider', false);
  });

  // Load user's push/email notification preferences from /api/profile
  async function loadNotifPrefs() {
    try {
      const data = await api('/api/profile');
      loadNotifPrefsFromProfile(data.profile);
    } catch(e) { console.error('loadNotifPrefs error:', e); }
  }

  // Apply push/email preferences and vendor menu state from a profile object
  // (used both by loadNotifPrefs() and by loadUserData() to avoid duplicate API calls)
  function loadNotifPrefsFromProfile(profile) {
    if (!profile) return;
    const pushEnabled = profile.push_enabled !== false;
    const emailEnabled = profile.email_notifications !== false;
    updateToggleSlider('pushToggle', 'pushToggleSlider', pushEnabled);
    updateToggleSlider('emailToggle', 'emailToggleSlider', emailEnabled);
    const pushDesc = document.getElementById('pushNotifDesc');
    const emailDesc = document.getElementById('emailNotifDesc');
    if (pushDesc) pushDesc.textContent = pushEnabled ? 'Enabled — alerts are active' : 'Disabled — no alerts will be shown';
    if (emailDesc) emailDesc.textContent = emailEnabled ? 'Enabled — receipts will be sent' : 'Disabled — no emails will be sent';

    // Update the profile menu notification status text
    const notifStatusEl = document.getElementById('notifStatus');
    if (notifStatusEl) {
      const statuses = [];
      if (pushEnabled) statuses.push('Push ON'); else statuses.push('Push OFF');
      if (emailEnabled) statuses.push('Email ON'); else statuses.push('Email OFF');
      notifStatusEl.textContent = statuses.join(' • ');
    }

    // Update vendor menu item based on vendor_status
    const vs = profile.vendor_status || 'none';
    const vendorMenuItem = document.getElementById('vendorMenuItem');
    const vendorStatusEl = document.getElementById('vendorStatus');
    if (vendorMenuItem && vendorStatusEl) {
      const titleEl = vendorMenuItem.querySelector('.profile-menu-title');
      if (vs === 'approved') {
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Vendor Dashboard';
        const iconEl = vendorMenuItem.querySelector('i.bi');
        if (iconEl) iconEl.className = 'bi bi-shop-window';
        vendorStatusEl.textContent = '✓ Approved — view earnings & chats';
        vendorMenuItem.onclick = openVendorDashboard;
      } else if (vs === 'pending') {
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Vendor Application';
        vendorStatusEl.textContent = '⏳ Pending review by admin';
        vendorMenuItem.onclick = () => { showToast('Your vendor application is being reviewed.', 'success'); };
      } else if (vs === 'rejected') {
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Become a Vendor';
        vendorStatusEl.textContent = '❌ Rejected — try again';
      } else {
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Become a Vendor';
        vendorStatusEl.textContent = 'Earn commission on referrals';
      }
    }
  }

  // ✅ Fetch the deposit-fee note from the public endpoint and render it on the
  // dashboard (account-info card + fund modal). The note tells users that bank
  // transfers to their Flutterwave virtual account incur a small processing fee,
  // and the webhook credits them with the NET amount (after Flutterwave's fee).
  async function loadDepositFeeNote() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/public/deposit-fee-note');
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const note = await res.json();
      if (!note || note.enabled === false) return;
      // Render the home-view account-info card version
      const homeNote = document.getElementById('depositFeeNote');
      if (homeNote) {
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('depositFeeNoteTitle');
        const bodyEl = document.getElementById('depositFeeNoteBody');
        const exampleEl = document.getElementById('depositFeeNoteExample');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = note.title || 'Flutterwave Processing Fee';
        if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = note.body || '';
        if (exampleEl) {
          if (note.example) { exampleEl.textContent = note.example; exampleEl.style.display = 'block'; }
          else { exampleEl.style.display = 'none'; }
        }
        homeNote.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
      // Render the fund modal compact version
      const modalNote = document.getElementById('fundModalFeeNote');
      if (modalNote) {
        const mTitle = document.getElementById('fundModalFeeNoteTitle');
        const mBody = document.getElementById('fundModalFeeNoteBody');
        const mExample = document.getElementById('fundModalFeeNoteExample');
        if (mTitle) mTitle.textContent = note.title || 'Flutterwave Processing Fee';
        if (mBody) mBody.textContent = note.body || '';
        if (mExample) {
          if (note.example) { mExample.textContent = note.example; mExample.style.display = 'block'; }
          else { mExample.style.display = 'none'; }
        }
        modalNote.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not load deposit fee note:', e.message);
    }
  }
</script>

// public/firebase-messaging-sw.js — Yenllet
// ✅ Uses Gustmii's Firebase project (same API keys) — tokens are isolated per domain
// so there's NO clash between Gustmii and Yenllet notifications.
importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-app-compat.js");
importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-messaging-compat.js");

firebase.initializeApp({
    apiKey: "AIzaSyC55H9A30BBMYlXZNxMQLYzndVwa--njHM",
    authDomain: "gustmii.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "gustmii",
    storageBucket: "gustmii.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "264078463676",
    appId: "1:264078463676:web:61e455ae7333c61f1a76b9",
    measurementId: "G-M604Y353FB"
});

const messaging = firebase.messaging();

messaging.onBackgroundMessage((payload) => {
    console.log('Yenllet background message received:', payload);

    // ✅ Use Yenllet logo (not Gustmii's) for push notification icons
    if (payload.data && !payload.notification) {
        const title = payload.data.title || "Yenllet Notification";
        const options = {
            body: payload.data.body || "",
            icon: 'https://res.cloudinary.com/x9cnhu3z/image/upload/v1792062220/Yenllet_Blue_Ribbon_Logo_ltmv0i.png',
            data: { click_action: payload.data.click_action || '/dashboard.html' }
        };
        return self.registration.showNotification(title, options);
    }
});

// ✅ Handle notification click — open Yenllet dashboard
self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
    event.notification.close();
    const targetUrl = event.notification.data?.click_action || '/dashboard.html';

    event.waitUntil(
        clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((windowClients) => {
            for (let i = 0; i < windowClients.length; i++) {
                const client = windowClients[i];
                if (client.url.includes(targetUrl) && 'focus' in client) {
                    return client.focus();
                }
            }
            if (clients.openWindow) {
                return clients.openWindow(targetUrl);
            }
        })
    );
});

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
      if (navLinks) {
        navLinks.classList.toggle('active');
      }
    }

    let deferredPrompt;
    const installBtn = document.getElementById('pwa-install-btn');

    // Always show install button (it will trigger instructions if not auto-installable)
    if (installBtn) {
      installBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      deferredPrompt = e;
      installBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    });

    installBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (deferredPrompt) {
        deferredPrompt.prompt();
        const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
        deferredPrompt = null;
      } else {
        const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !window.MSStream;
        if (isIOS) {
          alert('To install the app: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of Safari, then select "Add to Home Screen".');
        } else {
          alert('To install: Open Chrome menu (three dots) and select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".');
        }
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
      installBtn.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Register service worker
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')
          .then((reg) => {
            console.log('Service Worker registered:', reg.scope);
            // Check for updates every 60s
            setInterval(() => reg.update(), 60000);
          })
          .catch((err) => console.error('Service Worker registration failed:', err));
      });
    }

    async function loadLiveStats() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/stats');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          animateStat('statUsers', data.stats.totalUsers, '+');
          animateStat('statTxns', data.stats.totalTransactions, '+');
          animateStat('statUptime', data.stats.uptime, '%');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        animateStat('statUsers', 5000, '+');
        animateStat('statTxns', 15000, '+');
        animateStat('statUptime', 99.9, '%');
      }
    }

    function animateStat(id, target, suffix) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      let current = 0;
      const steps = 50;
      const increment = target / steps;
      let stepCount = 0;
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        stepCount++;
        current += increment;
        if (stepCount >= steps) {
          current = target;
          clearInterval(interval);
        }
        const displayValue = target % 1 !== 0 ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.floor(current).toLocaleString();
        el.textContent = displayValue + suffix;
      }, 30);
    }

    // ✅ Load official social media links from admin (Settings → Social Media Links)
    // Renders icons in the footer. If admin hasn't set any links yet, hides the row.
    async function loadSocialLinks() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/social-links');
        const data = await res.json();
        const social = data.social || {};
        const el = document.getElementById('footerSocial');
        if (!el) return;

        const icons = [
          { key: 'facebook',  icon: 'bi-facebook',   label: 'Facebook',  color: '#1877f2' },
          { key: 'twitter',   icon: 'bi-twitter-x',  label: 'Twitter / X' },
          { key: 'tiktok',    icon: 'bi-tiktok',     label: 'TikTok' },
          { key: 'instagram', icon: 'bi-instagram',  label: 'Instagram', color: '#E4405F' },
          { key: 'linkedin',  icon: 'bi-linkedin',   label: 'LinkedIn',  color: '#0a66c2' },
          { key: 'youtube',   icon: 'bi-youtube',    label: 'YouTube',   color: '#FF0000' }
        ];

        const visible = icons.filter(i => social[i.key] && String(social[i.key]).trim());
        if (visible.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<span class="footer-social-empty">Follow us on social media — links coming soon.</span>';
          return;
        }

        el.innerHTML = visible.map(i => {
          const url = String(social[i.key]).trim();
          const safeUrl = url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://') ? url : 'https://' + url;
          return `<a href="${safeUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="footer-social-link" title="Yenllet on ${i.label}" aria-label="Yenllet on ${i.label}" style="${i.color ? `--icon-color:${i.color};` : ''}">
            <i class="bi ${i.icon}"></i>
          </a>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (err) {
        // Silent fail — keep the "Loading…" placeholder so the page doesn't break
        console.warn('Social links failed to load:', err);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadLiveStats();
      loadSocialLinks();
    });
  </script>
</body>

            navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')

                .catch((err) => console.error('PWA registration failed:', err));

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';

    function togglePassword() {
      const input = document.getElementById('password');
      const icon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
      }
    }

    // ✅ Fetch support contact info on page load — show phone number in the
    // always-visible support strip below the login form.
    async function loadSupportContact() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/public/support-contact');
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success && data.support && data.support.phone) {
          document.getElementById('supportPhoneText').textContent = data.support.phone;
          document.getElementById('supportPhoneLink').href = data.support.whatsapp_link || ('tel:' + data.support.phone);
          document.getElementById('supportStrip').style.display = 'block';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Silent failure — the strip just stays hidden
      }
    }

    function showBannedModal(support, banReason) {
      const phone = support?.phone || '09030943391';
      const whatsappLink = support?.whatsapp_link || ('https://wa.me/2349030943391?text=' + encodeURIComponent('Hello Yenllet support, my account was banned and I want to appeal.'));
      const callLink = support?.call_link || ('tel:' + phone);
      const email = support?.email || '';

      document.getElementById('bannedPhoneDisplay').textContent = phone;
      document.getElementById('bannedCallBtn').href = callLink;
      document.getElementById('bannedWhatsappBtn').href = whatsappLink;

      if (banReason) {
        document.getElementById('bannedReasonText').textContent = banReason;
        document.getElementById('bannedReasonBox').style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('bannedReasonBox').style.display = 'none';
      }

      if (email) {
        document.getElementById('bannedEmailBtn').href = 'mailto:' + email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent('Yenllet Account Ban Appeal');
        document.getElementById('bannedEmailText').textContent = email;
        document.getElementById('bannedEmailBtn').style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('bannedEmailBtn').style.display = 'none';
      }

      document.getElementById('bannedOverlay').classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeBannedModal() {
      document.getElementById('bannedOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    }

    async function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;

      if (!email || !password) {
        showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });

        const text = await res.text();
        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Server returned HTML instead of JSON:', text);
            throw new Error('Server is taking too long to respond or crashed. Please try again.');
        }

        if (!res.ok) {
          // ✅ Banned user — server returns { banned: true, support: {...}, ban_reason }
          if (data.banned) {
            showBannedModal(data.support, data.ban_reason);
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Account banned.');
          }
          throw new Error(data.error || 'Login failed');
        }

        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
        if (document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked) {
          localStorage.setItem('rememberEmail', email);
        }
        showToast('Welcome back! Redirecting...', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/dashboard.html', 1200);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const remembered = localStorage.getItem('rememberEmail');
      if (remembered) {
        document.getElementById('email').value = remembered;
        document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked = true;
      }
      // ✅ Load support contact info on page load
      loadSupportContact();
    });
  </script>
</body>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const ref = urlParams.get('ref');
      if (ref) {
        document.getElementById('referralCode').value = ref;
        document.getElementById('referrerCode').textContent = ref;
        document.getElementById('referralBadge').style.display = 'inline-flex';
        document.getElementById('referralGroup').style.display = 'block';
      }
    });

    function togglePassword(inputId, iconId) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = document.getElementById(iconId);
      if (input.type === 'password') { input.type = 'text'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye'; } 
      else { input.type = 'password'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash'; }
    }

    function checkPasswordStrength() {
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
      const bar = document.getElementById('strengthBar');
      const barInner = document.getElementById('strengthBarInner');
      const text = document.getElementById('strengthText');
      if (password.length === 0) { bar.classList.remove('show'); text.classList.remove('show'); return; }
      bar.classList.add('show'); text.classList.add('show');
      let strength = 0;
      if (password.length >= 6) strength++;
      if (password.length >= 8) strength++;
      if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength++;
      if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength++;
      if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) strength++;
      barInner.className = 'password-strength-bar';
      text.className = 'password-strength-text show';
      if (strength <= 2) { barInner.classList.add('weak'); text.classList.add('weak'); text.textContent = 'Weak password'; } 
      else if (strength <= 3) { barInner.classList.add('medium'); text.classList.add('medium'); text.textContent = 'Medium strength'; } 
      else { barInner.classList.add('strong'); text.classList.add('strong'); text.textContent = 'Strong password'; }
    }

    async function handleRegister(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('registerBtn');
      const fullname = document.getElementById('fullname').value.trim();
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const phone = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
      const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
      const referralCode = document.getElementById('referralCode').value.trim();
      const agreeRules = document.getElementById('agree_rules').checked;

      if (!fullname || !email || !phone || !password) { showToast('Please fill in all required fields', 'error'); return; }
      if (password !== confirmPassword) { showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error'); return; }
      if (password.length < 6) { showToast('Password must be at least 6 characters', 'error'); return; }
      if (phone.length < 10) { showToast('Please enter a valid phone number', 'error'); return; }
      if (!agreeRules) { showToast('You must agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy', 'error'); return; }

      btn.classList.add('loading'); btn.disabled = true;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/register', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ fullname, email, phone, password, referralCode }) });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Registration failed');
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
        showToast('Account created successfully! Redirecting...', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/dashboard.html', 1500);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error'); btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally { btn.classList.remove('loading'); btn.disabled = false; }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type; toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')
                .then((reg) => console.log('PWA active on this view:', reg.scope))
                .catch((err) => console.error('PWA registration failed:', err));
        });
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';
    let resendTimer = null;
    let countdown = 60;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const token = urlParams.get('token');
      if (token) {
        document.getElementById('step1').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step3').classList.remove('hidden');
        window.resetToken = token;
      }
    });

    function togglePassword(inputId, iconId) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = document.getElementById(iconId);
      if (input.type === 'password') { input.type = 'text'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye'; }
      else { input.type = 'password'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash'; }
    }

    function showDebug(message) {
      const el = document.getElementById('debugInfo');
      el.textContent = message;
      el.classList.add('show');
    }

    // ✅ FIXED: handleForgot now checks res.ok and shows real server errors
    async function handleForgot(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();

      if (!email) { showToast('Please enter your email address', 'error'); return; }
      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) { showToast('Please enter a valid email address', 'error'); return; }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('emailIcon').classList.add('flying');

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/forgot-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email })
        });

        // ✅ CRITICAL: Check res.ok BEFORE showing success message
        let data = {};
        try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) { data = {}; }

        if (!res.ok) {
          // Server returned an error — show it to the user
          const errorMsg = data.error || data.message || `Server returned status ${res.status}`;
          showToast('Error: ' + errorMsg, 'error');
          btn.classList.remove('loading');
          btn.disabled = false;
          document.getElementById('emailIcon').classList.remove('flying');
          btn.classList.add('shake');
          setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
          showDebug('Server response: ' + res.status + ' ' + res.statusText + '\nBody: ' + JSON.stringify(data));
          return;
        }

        // ✅ Server returned 200 — proceed to step 2
        document.getElementById('sentEmail').textContent = email;
        document.getElementById('step1').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step2').classList.remove('hidden');
        startResendTimer();
        // ✅ NOTE: The server intentionally returns the same "success" message even for non-existent emails
        // (to prevent email enumeration). The user will see the success screen but no email will arrive
        // if their email isn't registered.
        showToast('Reset link sent to your email (if it exists in our system)', 'success');
        showDebug('Reset link requested for: ' + email + '\n' +
          'Server response: ' + JSON.stringify(data) + '\n\n' +
          'If no email arrives within 5 minutes:\n' +
          '1. Check spam/junk folder\n' +
          '2. Verify the email is registered on Yenllet\n' +
          '3. Check Vercel logs for [EMAIL SENDING]/[EMAIL SENT]/[EMAIL FAILED] messages\n' +
          '4. Ensure RESEND_API_KEY env var is set AND you redeployed after adding it');
      } catch (err) {
        // Network error (couldn't reach server)
        showToast('Network error: ' + err.message + '. Check your internet connection.', 'error');
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
        document.getElementById('emailIcon').classList.remove('flying');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
        showDebug('Network error: ' + err.message + '\nStack: ' + err.stack);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function startResendTimer() {
      const link = document.getElementById('resendLink');
      const timerText = document.getElementById('timerText');
      countdown = 60;
      link.classList.add('disabled');
      if (resendTimer) clearInterval(resendTimer);
      resendTimer = setInterval(() => {
        countdown--;
        timerText.textContent = ` (${countdown}s)`;
        if (countdown <= 0) {
          clearInterval(resendTimer);
          link.classList.remove('disabled');
          timerText.textContent = '';
        }
      }, 1000);
    }

    async function handleResend() {
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;
      const link = document.getElementById('resendLink');
      if (link.classList.contains('disabled')) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/forgot-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email })
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          showToast('Resend failed: ' + (data.error || res.status), 'error');
          return;
        }
        showToast('Reset link resent!', 'success');
        startResendTimer();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed to resend. Please try again.', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ✅ FIXED: handleReset also checks res.ok properly
    async function handleReset(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
      const newPassword = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
      const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;

      if (!newPassword || !confirmPassword) { showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error'); return; }
      if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) { showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error'); return; }
      if (newPassword.length < 6) { showToast('Password must be at least 6 characters', 'error'); return; }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/reset-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ token: window.resetToken, newPassword })
        });
        let data = {};
        try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) { data = {}; }

        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `Reset failed (status ${res.status})`);

        document.getElementById('step3').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step4').classList.remove('hidden');
        showToast('Password reset successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')
          .then((reg) => console.log('PWA active on this view:', reg.scope))
          .catch((err) => console.error('PWA registration failed:', err));
      });
    }
  </script>
</body>

// Yenllet PWA Service Worker - v2
// Bumping version forces ALL old caches (vtu-giprince-cache-v4 etc.) to be deleted
// so users get the new splash-first behavior on next visit.
//
// ✅ v2 CHANGE: Added Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push event handlers so
// push notifications work. The previous version was caching-only and threw
// "Failed to execute 'subscribe' on 'PushManager': Subscription failed -
// no active Service Worker" when the user tried to toggle push ON.
const CACHE_NAME = 'yenllet-cache-v3';
const ASSETS_TO_CACHE = [
  '/',
  '/index.html',
  '/splash.html',
  '/login.html',
  '/register.html',
  '/dashboard.html',
  '/forgot-password.html',
  '/terms.html',
  '/privacy.html',
  '/manifest.json',
  '/service-worker.js',
  '/Yenllet.png',
  '/Yenllet1.png'
];

// ✅ Import Firebase SDK so this SW can handle push events.
// Uses Gustmii's Firebase project (tokens isolated per domain — no clash).
importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-app-compat.js");
importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-messaging-compat.js");

firebase.initializeApp({
  apiKey: "AIzaSyC55H9A30BBMYlXZNxMQLYzndVwa--njHM",
  authDomain: "gustmii.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId: "gustmii",
  storageBucket: "gustmii.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "264078463676",
  appId: "1:264078463676:web:61e455ae7333c61f1a76b9",
  measurementId: "G-M604Y353FB"
});

const messaging = firebase.messaging();

// ✅ Background message handler (for data-only messages from server)
messaging.onBackgroundMessage((payload) => {
  console.log('[SW] Yenllet background message received:', payload);
  const title = (payload.notification && payload.notification.title) || (payload.data && payload.data.title) || 'Yenllet';
  const body = (payload.notification && payload.notification.body) || (payload.data && payload.data.body) || '';
  const clickAction = (payload.data && payload.data.click_action) || '/dashboard.html';
  const options = {
    body: body,
    icon: 'https://res.cloudinary.com/x9cnhu3z/image/upload/v1792062220/Yenllet_Blue_Ribbon_Logo_ltmv0i.png',
    badge: 'https://res.cloudinary.com/x9cnhu3z/image/upload/v1792062220/Yenllet_Blue_Ribbon_Logo_ltmv0i.png',
    data: { click_action: clickAction },
    tag: 'yenllet-push',
    renotify: true,
    requireInteraction: false
  };
  return self.registration.showNotification(title, options);
});

// ✅ Handle notification click — open Yenllet dashboard
self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW] Notification clicked:', event.notification);
  event.notification.close();
  const targetUrl = (event.notification.data && event.notification.data.click_action) || '/dashboard.html';
  event.waitUntil(
    clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((windowClients) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < windowClients.length; i++) {
        const client = windowClients[i];
        if (client.url.includes(targetUrl) && 'focus' in client) {
          return client.focus();
        }
      }
      if (clients.openWindow) {
        return clients.openWindow(targetUrl);
      }
    })
  );
});

// ✅ Handle push events directly (fallback if Firebase SDK fails to load)
self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW] Push event received:', event);
  let payload = {};
  try { payload = event.data ? event.data.json() : {}; } catch (e) {
    try { payload = { notification: { title: 'Yenllet', body: event.data ? event.data.text() : '' } }; } catch (e2) { payload = {}; }
  }
  const title = (payload.notification && payload.notification.title) || (payload.data && payload.data.title) || 'Yenllet';
  const body = (payload.notification && payload.notification.body) || (payload.data && payload.data.body) || '';
  const clickAction = (payload.data && payload.data.click_action) || '/dashboard.html';
  const options = {
    body: body,
    icon: 'https://res.cloudinary.com/x9cnhu3z/image/upload/v1792062220/Yenllet_Blue_Ribbon_Logo_ltmv0i.png',
    data: { click_action: clickAction },
    tag: 'yenllet-push'
  };
  event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(title, options));
});

// Install: pre-cache vital assets
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
      return Promise.allSettled(
        ASSETS_TO_CACHE.map(url => cache.add(url))
      );
    })
  );
  self.skipWaiting(); // activate new SW immediately
});

// Activate: delete ALL old caches (including the legacy giprince one)
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames.map((cache) => {
          if (cache !== CACHE_NAME) {
            console.log('[SW] Deleting old cache:', cache);
            return caches.delete(cache);
          }
        })
      );
    }).then(() => self.clients.claim()) // take control of all open tabs immediately
  );
});

// Fetch handler: network-first, fall back to cache
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const requestUrl = new URL(event.request.url);

  // Only handle same-origin GET requests
  if (requestUrl.origin !== self.location.origin || event.request.method !== 'GET') {
    return;
  }

  // IMPORTANT: When user opens the PWA from home screen and the start_url is "/",
  // serve splash.html instead of index.html so the splash screen shows first.
  if (event.request.mode === 'navigate' &&
      (requestUrl.pathname === '/' || requestUrl.pathname === '/index.html')) {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(event.request)
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.status === 200) {
            const responseClone = response.clone();
            caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
              cache.put(event.request, responseClone);
            });
          }
          return response;
        })
        .catch(() => {
          return caches.match('/splash.html').then((splash) => {
            return splash || caches.match(event.request);
          });
        })
    );
    return;
  }

  // Default: network-first, fall back to cache
  event.respondWith(
    fetch(event.request)
      .then((response) => {
        if (response.status === 200) {
          const responseClone = response.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
            cache.put(event.request, responseClone);
          });
        }
        return response;
      })
      .catch(() => {
        return caches.match(event.request).then((cachedResponse) => {
          if (cachedResponse) return cachedResponse;
          if (event.request.mode === 'navigate') {
            return caches.match('/splash.html');
          }
        });
      })
  );
});

const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
if (!token) { alert('Please login first, then come back to apply as a vendor.'); window.location.href = 'login.html'; }

document.getElementById('vendorForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  const alertBox = document.getElementById('alertBox');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise"></i> Submitting...';
  alertBox.className = 'alert';

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/vendor/register', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        businessName: document.getElementById('businessName').value,
        whatsapp: document.getElementById('whatsapp').value,
        experience: document.getElementById('experience').value,
        promotionStrategy: document.getElementById('promotionStrategy').value
      })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      alertBox.className = 'alert success';
      alertBox.innerHTML = `✅ ${data.message}<br><br><strong>Your referral code: ${data.referralCode}</strong><br>Share this code with customers. Once approved, you'll earn commissions on their purchases.`;
      document.getElementById('vendorForm').style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      alertBox.className = 'alert error';
      alertBox.textContent = data.error || 'Submission failed';
    }
  } catch (err) {
    alertBox.className = 'alert error';
    alertBox.textContent = 'Network error. Please try again.';
  }
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-send"></i> Submit Application';
});
</script>

<script>
const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
if (!token) { window.location.href = 'login.html'; }
const API = window.location.origin;
let vendorData = null;
let currentChatUserId = null;
let currentChatMessages = [];

function showToast(msg) { const t = document.getElementById('toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3000); }
function switchTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector(`[onclick="switchTab('${tab}')"]`).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).classList.add('active');
}

async function loadVendorDashboard() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/vendor/dashboard', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) { showToast(data.error || 'Access denied'); setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'dashboard.html', 2000); return; }

    vendorData = data;
    document.getElementById('loadingMsg').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('vendorContent').style.display = 'block';

    // Stats
    document.getElementById('statReferrals').textContent = data.stats.totalReferrals;
    document.getElementById('statEarnings').textContent = '₦' + data.stats.totalEarnings.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('statAvailable').textContent = '₦' + data.stats.availableEarnings.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('statWallet').textContent = '₦' + data.vendor.walletBalance.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('statChats').textContent = data.stats.unreadChats;

    // ✅ Update withdrawal form with admin-set minimum
    const minWd = (data.vendor && data.vendor.minWithdrawal) || 100;
    const withdrawInput = document.getElementById('withdrawAmount');
    const withdrawNote = document.getElementById('withdrawalMinNote');
    if (withdrawInput) { withdrawInput.min = minWd; withdrawInput.placeholder = 'Amount (min ₦' + minWd.toLocaleString() + ')'; }
    if (withdrawNote) { withdrawNote.textContent = 'Minimum withdrawal: ₦' + minWd.toLocaleString(); }

    // Referral code
    document.getElementById('referralCode').textContent = data.vendor.referralCode;
    document.getElementById('referralLink').textContent = window.location.origin + '/register.html?ref=' + data.vendor.referralCode;

    // Referrals table
    const tbody = document.getElementById('referralsTable');
    if (data.referrals.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:40px;">No referrals yet. Share your code to get started!</td></tr>';
    } else {
      tbody.innerHTML = data.referrals.map(r => `
        <tr><td>${r.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td>${r.phone || 'N/A'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(r.total_purchases||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td style="color:var(--success);font-weight:600;">₦${parseFloat(r.vendor_earnings||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${r.user_joined ? new Date(r.user_joined).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A'}</td></tr>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Withdrawal history
    renderWithdrawals(data.withdrawals || []);

    // Load chat inbox
    loadChatInbox();

    // Load weekly target
    loadWeeklyTarget();
  } catch (err) { showToast('Network error'); setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'dashboard.html', 2000); }
}

// ==================== WEEKLY TARGET ====================
async function loadWeeklyTarget() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/vendor/weekly-target', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.success || !data.enabled) { document.getElementById('weeklyTargetCard').style.display = 'none'; return; }

    document.getElementById('weeklyTargetCard').style.display = 'block';
    const t = data.target;
    const s = t.settings;

    document.getElementById('wtReferrals').textContent = t.referrals_made;
    document.getElementById('wtReferralsNeeded').textContent = s.referrals_needed;
    document.getElementById('wtActive').textContent = t.active_users;
    document.getElementById('wtActiveNeeded').textContent = s.active_users_needed;
    document.getElementById('wtBonus').textContent = parseFloat(s.bonus_amount).toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById('wtWeekEnd').textContent = new Date(t.week_end).toLocaleDateString();

    const refPct = Math.min(100, (t.referrals_made / s.referrals_needed) * 100);
    const actPct = Math.min(100, (t.active_users / s.active_users_needed) * 100);
    document.getElementById('wtReferralsBar').style.width = refPct + '%';
    document.getElementById('wtActiveBar').style.width = actPct + '%';

    const btn = document.getElementById('wtClaimBtn');
    if (t.is_target_met && !t.bonus_claimed) {
      btn.textContent = '🎉 Claim ₦' + parseFloat(s.bonus_amount).toLocaleString() + ' Bonus!';
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,var(--success),#059669)';
    } else if (t.bonus_claimed) {
      btn.textContent = '✅ Bonus Already Claimed';
      btn.disabled = true;
    } else {
      btn.textContent = '🎯 Target Not Met Yet';
      btn.disabled = true;
    }
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('weeklyTargetCard').style.display = 'none'; }
}

async function claimWeeklyBonus() {
  if (!confirm('Claim your weekly target bonus? It will be credited to your Yenllet wallet.')) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/vendor/weekly-target/claim', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { showToast(data.message || 'Bonus claimed!'); loadVendorDashboard(); }
    else showToast(data.error || 'Failed', 'error');
  } catch (err) { showToast('Network error', 'error'); }
}

// ==================== WITHDRAWAL ====================
async function requestWithdrawal() {
  const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('withdrawAmount').value);
  // ✅ Use admin-set minimum (default ₦100 if not configured yet)
  const minWithdrawal = (vendorData && vendorData.vendor && vendorData.vendor.minWithdrawal) || 100;
  if (!amount || amount < minWithdrawal) return showToast('Minimum withdrawal is ₦' + minWithdrawal.toLocaleString());
  if (!confirm('Request withdrawal of ₦' + amount.toLocaleString() + ' to your Yenllet wallet?\n\nAdmin will review and approve this request. The funds will appear in your wallet after approval.')) return;
  try {
    document.getElementById('withdrawBtn').disabled = true;
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/vendor/withdraw', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }, body: JSON.stringify({ amount }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { showToast(data.message); document.getElementById('withdrawAmount').value = ''; loadVendorDashboard(); }
    else showToast(data.error || 'Failed');
  } catch (err) { showToast('Network error'); }
  finally { document.getElementById('withdrawBtn').disabled = false; }
}

function renderWithdrawals(withdrawals) {
  const el = document.getElementById('withdrawalHistory');
  if (!withdrawals || withdrawals.length === 0) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;font-size:13px;">No withdrawal requests yet.</p>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;">Withdrawal History:</div>' + withdrawals.map(w => `
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--gray-100);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">
      <div><span class="badge badge-${w.status}">${w.status.toUpperCase()}</span> <strong>₦${parseFloat(w.amount).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500);">${new Date(w.requested_at).toLocaleDateString()} ${w.processed_at ? '→ ' + new Date(w.processed_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}</div>
    </div>
    ${w.admin_note && w.status === 'rejected' ? '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--danger);margin-left:12px;margin-bottom:6px;">Reason: ' + w.admin_note + '</div>' : ''}
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== CHAT ====================
async function loadChatInbox() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/chat/inbox', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } });
    const data = await res.json();
    const chatList = document.getElementById('chatList');
    if (!data.success || data.conversations.length === 0) { chatList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><i class="bi bi-inbox"></i><p>No customer messages yet.</p></div>'; return; }
    chatList.innerHTML = data.conversations.map(c => `
      <div class="chat-item ${!c.is_read ? 'unread' : ''}" onclick="openChatModal(${c.user_id}, '${(c.fullname || 'User').replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;"><span class="name">${c.fullname || 'Unknown'}</span><span class="time">${new Date(c.last_time).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        <div class="last-msg">${c.last_sender === 'user' ? '' : 'You: '}${c.last_message}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('chatList').innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><p>Failed to load chats.</p></div>'; }
}

function openChatModal(userId, userName) {
  currentChatUserId = userId;
  document.getElementById('chatUserName').textContent = userName;
  document.getElementById('chatModalMessages').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">Loading messages...</div>';
  document.getElementById('chatOverlay').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('chatModalInput').value = '';
  loadChatMessages(userId);
}
function closeChatModal() { document.getElementById('chatOverlay').classList.remove('active'); currentChatUserId = null; currentChatMessages = []; loadChatInbox(); }

async function loadChatMessages(userId) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/chat/inbox', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } });
    const data = await res.json();
    const messagesEl = document.getElementById('chatModalMessages');
    if (!data.success) { messagesEl.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">Failed to load.</div>'; return; }
    const conv = data.conversations.find(c => c.user_id === userId);
    if (!conv || !conv.messages || conv.messages.length === 0) { messagesEl.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">No messages yet.</div>'; return; }
    currentChatMessages = conv.messages;
    renderChatMessages();
  } catch (err) { document.getElementById('chatModalMessages').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">Failed.</div>'; }
}

function renderChatMessages() {
  const messagesEl = document.getElementById('chatModalMessages');
  if (currentChatMessages.length === 0) { messagesEl.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">No messages.</div>'; return; }
  messagesEl.innerHTML = currentChatMessages.map(m => {
    const isVendor = m.sender_type === 'vendor';
    const cls = isVendor ? 'vendor' : (m.is_faq ? 'faq' : 'user');
    const time = new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    return `<div class="chat-msg ${cls}">${m.is_faq ? '<i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> ' : ''}${escapeHtml(m.message)}<div class="time">${time}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
  messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
}

function escapeHtml(text) { if (!text) return ''; const div = document.createElement('div'); div.textContent = text; return div.innerHTML; }

async function sendVendorReply() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatModalInput');
  const message = input.value.trim();
  if (!message || !currentChatUserId) return;
  const firstMsg = currentChatMessages.find(m => m.uid);
  if (!firstMsg || !firstMsg.uid) { showToast('Cannot find original message. Refresh and try again.'); return; }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/chat/reply', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }, body: JSON.stringify({ chatUid: firstMsg.uid, message }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok && data.success) {
      currentChatMessages.push({ message, sender_type: 'vendor', is_faq: false, created_at: new Date().toISOString(), uid: 'local_' + Date.now() });
      renderChatMessages(); input.value = ''; showToast('Reply sent!');
    } else showToast(data.error || 'Failed');
  } catch (err) { showToast('Network error'); }
}

function copyReferral() { const link = document.getElementById('referralLink').textContent; navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(() => showToast('✅ Link copied!')).catch(() => showToast('Copy failed. Long-press the link.')); }

document.getElementById('chatOverlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === document.getElementById('chatOverlay')) closeChatModal(); });

// ==================== LEADERBOARD ====================
async function loadLeaderboard() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(API + '/api/leaderboard');
    const data = await res.json();
    const el = document.getElementById('leaderboardList');
    if (!data.success || !data.leaderboard || data.leaderboard.length === 0) {
      el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:40px;"><i class="bi bi-trophy" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;"></i>No leaderboard data yet for ' + (data.month || 'this month') + '.</p>';
      return;
    }
    const medals = ['🥇', '🥈', '🥉'];
    el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-500);margin-bottom:12px;text-align:center;">' + (data.month || 'This Month') + '</div>' + data.leaderboard.map((v, i) => `
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:${i < 3 ? '#fef3c7' : 'var(--gray-100)'};border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px;">
        <div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800;width:40px;text-align:center;color:${i < 3 ? '#d97706' : 'var(--gray-400)'};">${i < 3 ? medals[i] : (i + 1)}</div>
        ${v.profile_pic ? `<img src="${v.profile_pic}" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : `<div style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:white;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;">${(v.fullname || '?')[0]}</div>`}
        <div style="flex:1;">
          <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:15px;">${v.fullname || 'Unknown'}</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500);">${v.referral_count} referrals • ₦${parseFloat(v.total_earnings || 0).toLocaleString()} earned</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('leaderboardList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-400);padding:20px;">Failed to load leaderboard.</p>';
  }
}

// Load leaderboard when the tab is opened
const originalSwitchTab = switchTab;
switchTab = function(tab) {
  originalSwitchTab(tab);
  if (tab === 'leaderboard') loadLeaderboard();
};

loadVendorDashboard();

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';

    // 3D Tilt effect
    const card = document.getElementById('loginCard');
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
      const rotateX = (y / rect.height) * -8;
      const rotateY = (x / rect.width) * 8;
      card.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      card.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)';
    });

    // Generate floating particles
    function createParticles() {
      const container = document.getElementById('particles');
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const p = document.createElement('div');
        p.className = 'particle';
        p.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
        p.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 10 + 10) + 's';
        p.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 10) + 's';
        p.style.width = (Math.random() * 4 + 2) + 'px';
        p.style.height = p.style.width;
        container.appendChild(p);
      }
    }
    createParticles();

    // Toggle password visibility
    function togglePassword() {
      const input = document.getElementById('adminPassword');
      const icon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
      }
    }

    // Toast
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      const icons = { success: 'bi-check-circle-fill', error: 'bi-x-circle-fill', warning: 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill' };
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="toast-icon"><i class="bi ${icons[type] || icons.success}"></i></div>
        <span style="color: var(--gray-700);">${message}</span>
      `;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 4000);
    }

    // Login handler
    async function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('adminEmail').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('adminPassword').value;

      if (!email || !password) {
        showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
        return false;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Authenticating...';

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/admin/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        if (data.success) {
          localStorage.setItem('adminToken', data.token);
          if (document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked) {
            localStorage.setItem('adminEmail', email);
          }
          showToast('Welcome back, Admin!', 'success');
          setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = 'admin.html';
          }, 800);
        } else {
          showToast(data.error || 'Invalid credentials', 'error');
          btn.classList.remove('loading');
          btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-right"></i> Sign In Securely';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Connection failed. Please try again.', 'error');
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-right"></i> Sign In Securely';
      }
      return false;
    }

    // Pre-fill remembered email
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('adminEmail');
      if (saved) document.getElementById('adminEmail').value = saved;
    });
  </script>
