  <script>
    // ✅ API base URL — empty string means same-origin (works on Vercel/Render).
    // Required for the vendor/FAQ/push functions that use `fetch(API + '/api/...')`.
    const API = '';
    let adminToken = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
    let allPricing = [];
    let allUsers = [];
    let allTransactions = [];
    let allAds = [];
    let allReviews = [];
    let selectedUserId = null;
    let walletActionType = 'credit';
    let currentPricingFilter = 'airtime';

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      if (!adminToken) { window.location.href = 'admin-login.html'; return; }
      loadDashboardData();
      loadSettings();
    });

    async function api(endpoint, options = {}) {
      showLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, { ...options, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken, ...options.headers } });
        // ✅ Detect HTML responses (404 page from Vercel) and show a clear error
        // instead of cryptic 'Unexpected token <' from res.json() failing.
        const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
        if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          if (res.status === 404) {
            throw new Error('Endpoint not found (' + endpoint + '). Deploy the latest server.js — the route is missing on the live server.');
          }
          throw new Error('Server returned non-JSON response (HTTP ' + res.status + '). The server.js on Vercel is out of date — please redeploy.');
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Request failed');
        return data;
      } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, 'error'); throw err; }
      finally { showLoading(false); }
    }

    function switchTab(tab) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[id^="tab-"]').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
      document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).style.display = 'block';
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${tab}"]`).classList.add('active');
      if (tab === 'users') loadUsers();
      if (tab === 'transactions') loadAllTransactions();
      if (tab === 'pricing') loadPricing();
      if (tab === 'resellers') loadResellers();
      if (tab === 'vendors') loadVendors();
      if (tab === 'vendor-targets') loadVendorTargets();
      if (tab === 'vendor-withdrawals') loadVendorWithdrawals();
      if (tab === 'gift-banners') loadGiftBanners();
      if (tab === 'faq') loadFaqList();
      if (tab === 'ads') loadAds();
      if (tab === 'leaderboard') loadAdminLeaderboard();
      if (tab === 'schedules') loadAllSchedules();
      if (tab === 'reviews') loadReviews();
    }

    async function loadDashboardData() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/dashboard');
        document.getElementById('statUsers').textContent = data.stats.totalUsers;
        document.getElementById('statTransactions').textContent = data.stats.totalTransactions;
        document.getElementById('statRevenue').textContent = '₦' + (data.stats.totalRevenue || 0).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('statBanned').textContent = data.stats.bannedUsers || 0;
        const txnData = await api('/api/admin/transactions');
        allTransactions = txnData.transactions || [];
        document.getElementById('recentTxnTable').innerHTML = allTransactions.slice(0, 10).map(t => `<tr><td>#${t.id}</td><td>${t.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-info">${t.type}</span></td><td>${t.service || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(t.total||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${t.status==='success'?'success':t.status==='pending'?'warning':'danger'}">${t.status}</span></td><td>${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-receipt"></i><p>No transactions</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadUsers() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/users');
        allUsers = data.users || [];
        document.getElementById('usersTable').innerHTML = allUsers.map(u => `<tr><td>${u.fullname}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${u.email}</small></td><td>${u.phone || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(u.wallet_balance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(u.cashback_balance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${u.kyc_status==='approved'?'success':'warning'}">${u.kyc_status}</span></td><td><span class="badge badge-${u.is_banned?'danger':'success'}">${u.is_banned?'Banned':'Active'}</span></td><td><button class="action-btn edit" onclick="openWalletModal(${u.id})"><i class="bi bi-wallet2"></i></button><button class="action-btn email" onclick="toggleEmail(${u.id})" title="Toggle Email Notifications"><i class="bi ${u.email_visible ? 'bi-envelope-open-fill' : 'bi-envelope-slash-fill'}"></i></button>${u.is_banned ? `<button class="action-btn approve" onclick="unbanUser(${u.id})"><i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i></button>` : `<button class="action-btn danger" onclick="banUser(${u.id})"><i class="bi bi-slash-circle"></i></button>`}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-people"></i><p>No users</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function toggleEmail(id) {
      try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/toggle-email`, { method: 'POST' }); showToast('Email preference updated', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadAllTransactions() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/transactions');
        allTransactions = data.transactions || [];
        document.getElementById('allTxnTable').innerHTML = allTransactions.map(t => `<tr><td>#${t.id}</td><td>${t.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-info">${t.type}</span></td><td>${t.service || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(t.total||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${t.status==='success'?'success':t.status==='pending'?'warning':'danger'}">${t.status}</span></td><td>${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-receipt"></i><p>No transactions</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadPricing() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/pricing');
        allPricing = data.pricing || [];
        filterPricing(currentPricingFilter, null);
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    let currentDataNetwork = 'all';
    let currentDataSubCat = 'all';

    function filterPricing(service, btn) {
      currentPricingFilter = service;
      document.querySelectorAll('#tab-pricing > .card-modern > .tabs-modern > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      const subTabsEl = document.getElementById('dataSubTabs');
      subTabsEl.style.display = (service === 'data') ? 'block' : 'none';
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function filterDataCategory(network, btn) {
      currentDataNetwork = network;
      document.querySelectorAll('#dataSubTabs > div:first-child > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function filterDataSubCat(cat, btn) {
      currentDataSubCat = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll('#dataSubTabs > div:last-child > .tab-modern').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      renderPricingTable();
    }

    function renderPricingTable() {
      let filtered = allPricing.filter(p => p.service === currentPricingFilter);
      if (currentPricingFilter === 'data') {
        if (currentDataNetwork !== 'all') filtered = filtered.filter(p => p.provider === currentDataNetwork);
        if (currentDataSubCat !== 'all') filtered = filtered.filter(p => (p.category || 'general') === currentDataSubCat);
      }
      document.getElementById('pricingTable').innerHTML = filtered.map(p => {
        const profit = parseFloat(p.selling_price||0) - parseFloat(p.amount||0);
        const profitColor = profit > 0 ? 'color:var(--success)' : 'color:var(--danger)';
        return `<tr><td><span class="badge badge-info">${p.service}</span></td><td><strong>${p.provider}</strong></td><td>${p.plan || '-'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-secondary">${p.category || '-'}</span></td><td>${p.validity || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(p.amount||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><strong style="color:var(--primary)">₦${parseFloat(p.selling_price||0).toLocaleString()}</strong></td><td style="${profitColor}"><strong>+₦${profit.toLocaleString()}</strong></td><td>${p.cashback_percent || 0}%</td><td><span class="badge badge-${p.is_active?'success':'secondary'}">${p.is_active?'Active':'Inactive'}</span></td><td><button class="action-btn edit" onclick="editPricing(${p.id})"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deletePricing(${p.id})"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button></td></tr>`;
      }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="11"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-tags"></i><p>No pricing found</p></div></td></tr>';
    }

    function openPricingModal() {
      document.getElementById('pricingModalTitle').textContent = 'Add Pricing';
      document.getElementById('priceId').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceService').value = currentPricingFilter;
      document.getElementById('priceProvider').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pricePlan').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceValidity').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceCategory').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceAmount').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = '';
      document.getElementById('priceCashback').value = '0';
      document.getElementById('priceActive').value = 'true';
      toggleAirtimePricing();
      document.getElementById('pricingModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function editPricing(id) {
      const p = allPricing.find(x => x.id === id);
      if (!p) return;
      document.getElementById('pricingModalTitle').textContent = 'Edit Pricing';
      document.getElementById('priceId').value = p.id;
      document.getElementById('priceService').value = p.service;
      document.getElementById('priceProvider').value = p.provider || '';
      document.getElementById('pricePlan').value = p.plan || '';
      document.getElementById('priceValidity').value = p.validity || '';
      document.getElementById('priceCategory').value = p.category || '';
      document.getElementById('priceAmount').value = p.amount;
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = p.selling_price;
      document.getElementById('priceCashback').value = p.cashback_percent || 0;
      document.getElementById('priceActive').value = p.is_active ? 'true' : 'false';
      toggleAirtimePricing();
      document.getElementById('pricingModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    function toggleAirtimePricing() {
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      const isAirtime = service === 'airtime';
      document.getElementById('priceSelling').disabled = isAirtime;
      if (isAirtime) syncAirtimeSellingPrice();
    }

    function syncAirtimeSellingPrice() {
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      if (service === 'airtime') {
        document.getElementById('priceSelling').value = document.getElementById('priceAmount').value;
      }
    }

    async function savePricing() {
      const id = document.getElementById('priceId').value;
      const service = document.getElementById('priceService').value;
      const body = {
        service: service,
        provider: document.getElementById('priceProvider').value,
        plan: document.getElementById('pricePlan').value || null,
        validity: document.getElementById('priceValidity').value || null,
        category: document.getElementById('priceCategory').value || 'general',
        amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceAmount').value),
        sellingPrice: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceSelling').value),
        cashbackPercent: parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceCashback').value),
        isActive: document.getElementById('priceActive').value === 'true'
      };
      if (id) body.id = parseInt(id);
      if (!body.provider || isNaN(body.amount)) return showToast('Fill required fields', 'error');
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/pricing', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
        showToast('Pricing saved successfully', 'success');
        closeModal('pricingModal');
        loadPricing();
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function deletePricing(id) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this pricing?')) return;
      try { await api(`/api/admin/pricing/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); showToast('Pricing deleted', 'success'); loadPricing(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadResellers() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/resellers');
        const resellers = data.resellers || [];
        document.getElementById('resellersTable').innerHTML = resellers.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.fullname || '-'}</td><td>${r.email || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(r.monthly_fee||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${r.discount_percent || 0}%</td><td>${r.expires_at ? new Date(r.expires_at).toLocaleDateString() : '-'}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${r.status==='active'?'success':r.status==='expired'?'danger':'secondary'}">${r.status}</span></td><td><button class="action-btn approve" onclick="toggleReseller(${r.id}, 'active')" title="Activate"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="toggleReseller(${r.id}, 'expired')" title="Expire"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-shop"></i><p>No resellers yet</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function toggleReseller(id, status) {
      try { await api(`/api/admin/resellers/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ status }) }); showToast(`Reseller ${status}`, 'success'); loadResellers(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadAds() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/ads');
        allAds = data.ads || [];
        document.getElementById('adsTable').innerHTML = allAds.map(a => {
          let actions = '';
          if (a.status === 'pending') {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn approve" onclick="approveAd(${a.id})" title="Approve"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="rejectAd(${a.id})" title="Reject"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>`;
          } else if (a.status === 'approved') {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn stop" onclick="stopAd(${a.id})" title="Stop Running Ad"><i class="bi bi-pause-circle"></i></button><button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deleteAd(${a.id})" title="Delete"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>`;
          } else {
            actions = `<button class="action-btn danger" onclick="deleteAd(${a.id})" title="Delete"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>`;
          }
          return `<tr><td>#${a.id}</td><td>${a.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td>${a.title}</td><td>${a.topic || '-'}</td><td>₦${parseFloat(a.total_amount||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class="badge badge-${a.status==='approved'?'success':a.status==='stopped'?'warning':a.status==='rejected'?'danger':'secondary'}">${a.status}</span></td><td>${actions}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-badge-ad"></i><p>No ads</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function approveAd(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/approve`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad approved', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function rejectAd(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/reject`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad rejected', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function stopAd(id) { if (!confirm('Stop this running ad? Users will no longer see it.')) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}/stop`, { method: 'PUT' }); showToast('Ad stopped', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function deleteAd(id) { if (!confirm('Permanently delete this ad?')) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/ads/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); showToast('Ad deleted', 'success'); loadAds(); } catch (err) {} }

    async function loadReviews() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/reviews');
        allReviews = data.reviews || [];
        document.getElementById('reviewsTable').innerHTML = allReviews.map(r => `<tr><td>#${r.id}</td><td>${r.fullname || 'Unknown'}</td><td>${'★'.repeat(r.rating)}${'☆'.repeat(5-r.rating)}</td><td>${r.comment || '-'}</td><td>${new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="5"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-star"></i><p>No reviews</p></div></td></tr>';
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function sendBroadcast() {
      const type = document.getElementById('broadcastType').value;
      const title = document.getElementById('broadcastTitle').value;
      const message = document.getElementById('broadcastMessage').value;
      if (!title || !message) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');
      try { await api('/api/admin/broadcast', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ type, title, message, target: 'all' }) }); showToast('Broadcast sent', 'success'); document.getElementById('broadcastTitle').value = ''; document.getElementById('broadcastMessage').value = ''; } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function loadSettings() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/settings');
        const settings = {};
        data.settings.forEach(s => settings[s.key] = s.value);

        if (settings.welcome_bonus) {
          document.getElementById('wbEnabled').value = settings.welcome_bonus.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('wbAmount').value = settings.welcome_bonus.amount;
        }
        if (settings.referral_reward) {
          document.getElementById('rrEnabled').value = settings.referral_reward.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('rrAmount').value = settings.referral_reward.amount;
        }
        if (settings.spin_settings) {
          document.getElementById('spEnabled').value = settings.spin_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          const rewards = settings.spin_settings.rewards;
          const moneyR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'money') || {};
          const cashR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'cashback') || {};
          const dataR = rewards.find(r => r.type === 'data') || {};
          document.getElementById('spMoney').value = moneyR.value || 0;
          document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value = moneyR.chance || 0;
          document.getElementById('spCashback').value = cashR.value || 0;
          document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value = cashR.chance || 0;
          document.getElementById('spData').value = dataR.value || '';
          document.getElementById('spDataChance').value = dataR.chance || 0;
        }
        if (settings.withdrawal_settings) {
          document.getElementById('minWithdrawal').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.min;
          document.getElementById('maxWithdrawal').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.max;
          document.getElementById('withdrawalFee').value = settings.withdrawal_settings.fee;
        }
        if (settings.kyc_settings) {
          document.getElementById('kycEnabled').value = settings.kyc_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('kycFee').value = settings.kyc_settings.fee || 0;
        }
        if (settings.charge_fee_settings) {
          document.getElementById('cfEnabled').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
          document.getElementById('cfType').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.type || 'percentage';
          document.getElementById('cfValue').value = settings.charge_fee_settings.value || 0;
        }
        if (settings.reseller_settings) {
          document.getElementById('rsMonthlyFee').value = settings.reseller_settings.monthly_fee || 5000;
          document.getElementById('rsDiscount').value = settings.reseller_settings.discount_percent || 10;
          document.getElementById('rsEnabled').value = settings.reseller_settings.enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
        }
        if (settings.vendor_settings) {
          const vs = settings.vendor_settings;
          if (document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent')) {
            document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent').value = vs.vendor_discount_percent || 5;
            document.getElementById('vendorCashbackPercent').value = vs.vendor_cashback_percent || 2;
            document.getElementById('vendorEnabled').value = vs.vendor_enabled ? 'true' : 'false';
            document.getElementById('vendorPortalOpen').value = vs.vendor_portal_open !== false ? 'true' : 'false';
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function saveSetting(key) {
      let value = {};
      if (key === 'welcome_bonus') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('wbEnabled').value === 'true', amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('wbAmount').value) };
      } else if (key === 'referral_reward') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('rrEnabled').value === 'true', amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rrAmount').value) };
      } else if (key === 'spin_settings') {
        const noneChance = 100 - (parseInt(document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value) + parseInt(document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value) + parseInt(document.getElementById('spDataChance').value));
        value = {
          enabled: document.getElementById('spEnabled').value === 'true',
          rewards: [
            { type: 'money', value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('spMoney').value), chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spMoneyChance').value) },
            { type: 'cashback', value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('spCashback').value), chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spCashbackChance').value) },
            { type: 'data', value: document.getElementById('spData').value, chance: parseInt(document.getElementById('spDataChance').value) },
            { type: 'none', value: 0, chance: noneChance > 0 ? noneChance : 0 }
          ]
        };
      } else if (key === 'withdrawal_settings') {
        value = { min: parseFloat(document.getElementById('minWithdrawal').value), max: parseFloat(document.getElementById('maxWithdrawal').value), fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('withdrawalFee').value) };
      } else if (key === 'kyc_settings') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('kycEnabled').value === 'true', fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('kycFee').value) };
      } else if (key === 'charge_fee_settings') {
        value = { enabled: document.getElementById('cfEnabled').value === 'true', type: document.getElementById('cfType').value, value: parseFloat(document.getElementById('cfValue').value) };
      } else if (key === 'reseller_settings') {
        value = { monthly_fee: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rsMonthlyFee').value), discount_percent: parseFloat(document.getElementById('rsDiscount').value), enabled: document.getElementById('rsEnabled').value === 'true' };
      }

      try {
        await api('/api/admin/settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ key, value }) });
        showToast('Settings saved successfully', 'success');
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    function openWalletModal(userId) {
      selectedUserId = userId;
      walletActionType = 'credit';
      document.getElementById('walletAmount').value = '';
      document.getElementById('walletReason').value = '';
      document.getElementById('creditBtn').style.opacity = '1';
      document.getElementById('debitBtn').style.opacity = '0.5';
      document.getElementById('walletModal').classList.add('active');
    }
    function setWalletAction(type) { walletActionType = type; document.getElementById('creditBtn').style.opacity = type === 'credit' ? '1' : '0.5'; document.getElementById('debitBtn').style.opacity = type === 'debit' ? '1' : '0.5'; }
    async function executeWalletAction() {
      const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('walletAmount').value);
      const reason = document.getElementById('walletReason').value;
      if (!amount || amount <= 0) return showToast('Enter valid amount', 'error');
      try { const endpoint = walletActionType === 'credit' ? '/api/admin/wallet/credit' : '/api/admin/wallet/debit'; await api(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ userId: selectedUserId, amount, reason }) }); showToast(`Wallet ${walletActionType}ed`, 'success'); closeModal('walletModal'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    async function syncClubKonnect() {
    if (!confirm('This will fetch the LATEST plans and prices directly from ClubKonnect API.\n\n- New plans will be added with 15% markup\n- Existing plans: base price updated, YOUR selling price preserved\n\nContinue?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Syncing from ClubKonnect... (10-20 seconds)', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/sync-clubkonnect', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Sync complete!', 'success');
      loadPricing();
      setTimeout(() => { filterPricing('data', null); }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Sync failed: ' + (err.message || 'Check ClubKonnect API credentials'), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function seedPlans() {
    if (!confirm('This will insert all 122 ClubKonnect data plans (MTN, Glo, Airtel, 9mobile) with categories.\n\nThis may take 10-20 seconds. Continue?')) return;
    try {
      showToast('Seeding 122 plans... please wait (10-20 seconds)', 'success');
      showLoading(true);
      const data = await api('/api/admin/seed-plans', { method: 'POST' });
      showLoading(false);
      showToast(data.message || 'Plans seeded successfully!', 'success');
      loadPricing();
      setTimeout(() => { filterPricing('data', null); }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      showLoading(false);
      showToast('Seed failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function banUser(id) { const reason = prompt('Ban reason:'); if (!reason) return; try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/ban`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason }) }); showToast('User banned', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {} }
    async function unbanUser(id) { try { await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}/unban`, { method: 'POST' }); showToast('User unbanned', 'success'); loadUsers(); } catch (err) {} }

    function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); }
    function showToast(msg, type = 'success') { const toast = document.getElementById('toast'); toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type==='success'?'check-circle-fill':'x-circle-fill'}"></i> ${msg}`; toast.className = 'toast-modern ' + type + ' show'; setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500); }
    function showLoading(show) { document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.toggle('active', show); }
    function adminLogout() { localStorage.removeItem('adminToken'); window.location.href = 'admin-login.html'; }

    async function loadVendors() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/vendors');
        const el = document.getElementById('vendorList');
        if (!data.success || !data.vendors.length) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-person-badge" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No vendor applications yet. When users apply from their dashboard, they will appear here for approval.</p>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = data.vendors.map(v => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${v.fullname}</div>
                ${v.vendor_business_name ? `<div style="font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px;">${v.vendor_business_name}</div>` : ''}
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:6px;"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> ${v.email}</div>
                ${v.phone ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px;"><i class="bi bi-telephone"></i> ${v.phone}</div>` : ''}
                ${v.vendor_whatsapp ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px;"><i class="bi bi-whatsapp"></i> ${v.vendor_whatsapp}</div>` : ''}
                ${v.vendor_experience ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:6px;"><i class="bi bi-briefcase"></i> ${v.vendor_experience}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;">
                <span style="padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${v.vendor_status==='approved'?'#d1fae5':v.vendor_status==='pending'?'#fef3c7':'#fee2e2'};color:${v.vendor_status==='approved'?'#059669':v.vendor_status==='pending'?'#d97706':'#dc2626'};">${v.vendor_status.toUpperCase()}</span>
                ${v.vendor_status==='pending' ? `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;"><button onclick="approveVendor(${v.id})" style="background:#10b981;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> Approve</button><button onclick="rejectVendor(${v.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i> Reject</button></div>` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
            ${v.referral_count > 0 ? `<div style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed #e5e7eb;font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;"><i class="bi bi-people"></i> Referrals: <strong>${v.referral_count}</strong> &nbsp;•&nbsp; <i class="bi bi-cash-stack"></i> Earnings: <strong>₦${Number(v.total_earnings||0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>` : ''}
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to load vendors: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    }

    // ==================== FAQ MANAGEMENT ====================
    async function loadFaqList() {
      try {
        // ✅ Render the quick-add chips first so they're visible immediately
        renderQuickFaqButtons();
        const res = await fetch('/api/faq');
        const data = await res.json();
        const el = document.getElementById('faqList');
        if (!data.success || !data.questions.length) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No FAQ questions yet. Add some above — they will appear in the user dashboard chat widget.</p>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = data.questions.map(q => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;">
              <div style="flex:1;">
                <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" style="color:var(--primary);margin-right:6px;"></i>${q.question}</div>
                <div style="font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5;">${q.answer}</div>
              </div>
              <button onclick="deleteFaq('${q.uid}')" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i> Delete</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to load FAQ: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    async function addFaq() {
      const question = document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value.trim();
      const answer = document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value.trim();
      if (!question || !answer) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/faq', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ question, answer }) });
        showToast('FAQ added! It will appear in user dashboards.', 'success');
        document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value = '';
        document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value = '';
        loadFaqList();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to add FAQ', 'error'); }
    }

    async function deleteFaq(uid) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this FAQ question?')) return;
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/faq/' + uid, { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast('FAQ deleted', 'success');
        loadFaqList();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to delete FAQ', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== COMMON YENLLET FAQ TEMPLATES ====================

    // ✅ Render the quick-add chips on FAQ tab open
    function renderQuickFaqButtons() {
      const container = document.getElementById('quickFaqButtons');
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = '';
      COMMON_FAQS.forEach((faq, idx) => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);background:white;color:var(--gray-700);border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;';
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-plus-circle" style="margin-right:4px;color:var(--primary);"></i>' + (faq.q.length > 50 ? faq.q.substring(0, 50) + '...' : faq.q);
        btn.onmouseenter = () => { btn.style.background = 'var(--primary-light)'; btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--primary)'; btn.style.color = 'var(--primary)'; };
        btn.onmouseleave = () => { btn.style.background = 'white'; btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--gray-200)'; btn.style.color = 'var(--gray-700)'; };
        btn.onclick = () => {
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value = faq.q;
          document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value = faq.a;
          // Scroll the form into view
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          document.getElementById('faqQuestion').focus();
          showToast('Loaded! Review and tap "Add FAQ" below to save.', 'success');
        };
        container.appendChild(btn);
      });
    }

    function clearFaqForm() {
      document.getElementById('faqQuestion').value = '';
      document.getElementById('faqAnswer').value = '';
      document.getElementById('faqQuestion').focus();
    }

    // ✅ Bulk insert all 12 common FAQs at once. Skips duplicates (matches by question text).
    async function addAllCommonFaqs() {
      if (!confirm('This will save all 12 common Yenllet FAQs to your database. Continue?')) return;
      let added = 0, failed = 0;
      showLoading(true);
      // Fetch existing FAQs first so we don't double-insert
      let existing = [];
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/faq');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) existing = data.questions.map(q => q.question.trim().toLowerCase());
      } catch(e) {}

      for (const faq of COMMON_FAQS) {
        if (existing.includes(faq.q.trim().toLowerCase())) continue; // skip duplicates
        try {
          await api('/api/admin/faq', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ question: faq.q, answer: faq.a }) });
          added++;
          // Tiny delay so we don't hammer the database
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150));
        } catch(e) {
          failed++;
        }
      }
      showLoading(false);
      if (added > 0) showToast(`Added ${added} FAQs successfully!${failed > 0 ? ' (' + failed + ' failed)' : ''}`, 'success');
      else if (failed === 0 && added === 0) showToast('All 12 FAQs already exist — nothing to add.', 'success');
      else showToast(`Failed to add FAQs. Is server.js deployed?`, 'error');
      loadFaqList();
    }

    // ==================== PUSH NOTIFICATION SENDER ====================
    async function sendPushToAll() {
      const title = document.getElementById('pushTitle').value.trim();
      const body = document.getElementById('pushBody').value.trim();
      if (!title || !body) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');
      if (!confirm('Send push notification to ALL users with push_enabled=true?\n\nThis cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/push-notification', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ title, body }) });
        const count = data.stats?.successCount || 0;
        const failed = data.stats?.failureCount || 0;
        showToast(`Push sent to ${count} device${count===1?'':'s'}${failed>0?` (${failed} failed)`:''}!`, count > 0 ? 'success' : 'error');
        if (count > 0) {
          document.getElementById('pushTitle').value = '';
          document.getElementById('pushBody').value = '';
        }
      } catch(e) { showToast('Push failed: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR SETTINGS ====================
    // ✅ FIX: vendorEnabled and vendorPortalOpen are <select> elements, not checkboxes.
    // Use .value === 'true' instead of .checked (which is always undefined on selects)
    async function saveVendorSettings() {
      const discount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('vendorDiscountPercent').value) || 0;
      const cashback = parseFloat(document.getElementById('vendorCashbackPercent').value) || 0;
      const enabled = document.getElementById('vendorEnabled').value === 'true';
      const portalOpen = document.getElementById('vendorPortalOpen').value === 'true';
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/vendor-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({
          vendorDiscountPercent: discount,
          vendorCashbackPercent: cashback,
          vendorEnabled: enabled,
          vendorPortalOpen: portalOpen
        }) });
        showToast('Vendor settings saved! New vendors will use these rates.', 'success');
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to save vendor settings', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR WEEKLY TARGETS ====================
    async function loadVendorTargets() {
      // ✅ Try to load settings; if endpoint is missing (404), fall back to defaults
      // so the form is still usable. This prevents the whole tab from breaking
      // when the user hasn't deployed the latest server.js yet.
      let s = { enabled: false, bonus_amount: 1000, referrals_needed: 10, active_users_needed: 5, transactions_per_user: 1, reset_day: 1 };
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-settings');
        if (data && data.settings) s = data.settings;
      } catch (e) {
        // Endpoint not deployed yet — show a warning toast, but continue with defaults
        showToast('Vendor target settings endpoint not deployed. Update server.js to enable loading/saving.', 'error');
      }
      try {
        if (document.getElementById('vtEnabled')) {
          document.getElementById('vtEnabled').value = (s.enabled !== false).toString();
          document.getElementById('vtBonus').value = s.bonus_amount || 1000;
          document.getElementById('vtReferrals').value = s.referrals_needed || 10;
          document.getElementById('vtActiveUsers').value = s.active_users_needed || 5;
          document.getElementById('vtTxnsPerUser').value = s.transactions_per_user || 1;
          document.getElementById('vtResetDay').value = String(s.reset_day || 1);
          const days = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
          document.getElementById('vtResetDayDisplay').textContent = days[s.reset_day || 1];
        }
      } catch(e) { console.warn('vendor-target-settings load failed:', e.message); }

      try {
        const progData = await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-progress');
        const el = document.getElementById('vendorTargetList');
        const list = progData.progress || [];
        if (list.length === 0) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;"><i class="bi bi-people" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No active vendors yet.</p>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(v => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
              <strong>${v.fullname}</strong>
              ${v.claimed_this_week ? '<span class="badge badge-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i> Claimed</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-warning">In Progress</span>'}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);">Referrals: <strong>${v.referral_count}/${v.referrals_needed}</strong> &nbsp;•&nbsp; Active Users: <strong>${v.active_users_count}/${v.active_users_needed}</strong></div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('vendorTargetList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Progress endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function saveVendorTargetSettings() {
      const payload = {
        enabled: document.getElementById('vtEnabled').value === 'true',
        bonus_amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('vtBonus').value) || 0,
        referrals_needed: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtReferrals').value) || 0,
        active_users_needed: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtActiveUsers').value) || 0,
        transactions_per_user: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtTxnsPerUser').value) || 1,
        reset_day: parseInt(document.getElementById('vtResetDay').value)
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/vendor-target-settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Vendor target settings saved!', 'success');
        loadVendorTargets();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to save target settings', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== VENDOR WITHDRAWALS ====================
    async function loadVendorWithdrawals() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals');
        const list = data.withdrawals || [];
        const stats = data.stats || { pending: 0, approved: 0, rejected: 0 };
        document.getElementById('wdPending').textContent = stats.pending || 0;
        document.getElementById('wdApproved').textContent = stats.approved || 0;
        document.getElementById('wdRejected').textContent = stats.rejected || 0;
        const el = document.getElementById('withdrawalList');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No withdrawal requests yet. When vendors request a withdrawal from their dashboard, it will appear here for approval.</p>';
          return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(w => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${w.vendor_name || 'Unknown Vendor'}</div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;"><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> ${w.vendor_email || '-'}</div>
                <div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">Amount: <strong style="color:var(--primary);">₦${parseFloat(w.amount||0).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">Requested: ${new Date(w.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                ${w.reason ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">Note: ${w.reason}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;">
                <span style="padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${w.status==='approved'?'#d1fae5':w.status==='pending'?'#fef3c7':'#fee2e2'};color:${w.status==='approved'?'#059669':w.status==='pending'?'#d97706':'#dc2626'};">${w.status.toUpperCase()}</span>
                ${w.status==='pending' ? `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;"><button onclick="approveVendorWithdrawal(${w.id})" style="background:#10b981;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> Approve → Wallet</button><button onclick="rejectVendorWithdrawal(${w.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i> Reject</button></div>` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('withdrawalList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Withdrawal endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function approveVendorWithdrawal(id) {
      if (!confirm('Approve this withdrawal? The amount will be credited to the vendor\'s Yenllet wallet immediately. This cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        const data = await api(`/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals/${id}/approve`, { method: 'POST' });
        showToast(data.message || 'Withdrawal approved — wallet credited', 'success');
        loadVendorWithdrawals();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to approve: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    async function rejectVendorWithdrawal(id) {
      const reason = prompt('Reason for rejection (optional):');
      if (reason === null) return;
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/vendor-withdrawals/${id}/reject`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason || 'Rejected by admin' }) });
        showToast('Withdrawal rejected', 'success');
        loadVendorWithdrawals();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to reject', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== GIFT BANNERS ====================
    function openGiftBannerModal() {
      // Clear form
      ['giftBannerFile','gbImageUrl','gbTitle','gbDescription','gbLinkTarget','gbStartDate','gbEndDate'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = '';
      });
      const cashEl = document.getElementById('gbCashback'); if (cashEl) cashEl.value = 500;
      const maxEl = document.getElementById('gbMaxClaims'); if (maxEl) maxEl.value = 100;
      const linkEl = document.getElementById('gbLinkType'); if (linkEl) linkEl.value = 'none';
      const restEl = document.getElementById('gbRestrictedService'); if (restEl) restEl.value = '';
      document.getElementById('giftBannerModal').classList.add('active');
    }

    async function createGiftBanner() {
      const title = document.getElementById('gbTitle').value.trim();
      if (!title) return showToast('Banner title is required', 'error');
      const cashback = parseFloat(document.getElementById('gbCashback').value) || 0;
      if (cashback < 50) return showToast('Cashback reward must be at least ₦50', 'error');
      let imageUrl = document.getElementById('gbImageUrl').value.trim();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('giftBannerFile');
      if (!imageUrl && fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        // Read file as base64 data URL
        imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result);
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read file'));
          reader.readAsDataURL(fileInput.files[0]);
        });
      }
      // ✅ Field names MUST match server.js /api/admin/gift-banners endpoint
      // Server expects: title, description, bannerImage, linkType, linkUrl,
      // internalSection, cashbackAmount, restrictedService, maxClaims, endDate
      const linkType = document.getElementById('gbLinkType').value;
      const linkTarget = document.getElementById('gbLinkTarget').value.trim();
      const payload = {
        title,
        description: document.getElementById('gbDescription').value.trim(),
        bannerImage: imageUrl,                                          // was image_url
        cashbackAmount: cashback,                                       // was cashback_amount
        maxClaims: parseInt(document.getElementById('gbMaxClaims').value) || 100,  // was max_claims
        linkType: linkType,                                             // was link_type
        linkUrl: linkType === 'url' ? linkTarget : null,                // was link_target
        internalSection: linkType === 'service' ? linkTarget : null,    // server uses internalSection for service links
        restrictedService: document.getElementById('gbRestrictedService').value || null,  // was restricted_service
        endDate: document.getElementById('gbEndDate').value || null     // was end_date (server doesn't use start_date - defaults to NOW())
      };
      try {
        await api('/api/admin/gift-banners', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        showToast('Gift banner created! It is now live for users.', 'success');
        closeModal('giftBannerModal');
        loadGiftBanners();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to create banner: ' + (e.message || ''), 'error'); }
    }

    async function loadGiftBanners() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/gift-banners');
        const list = data.banners || [];
        const el = document.getElementById('giftBannerList');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-megaphone" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No gift banners yet. Click "Create Gift Banner" above to set one up.</p>';
          return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = list.map(b => `
          <div style="background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;">
              ${b.banner_image ? `<img src="${b.banner_image}" alt="${b.title}" style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;">` : '<div style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dbeafe,#e0e7ff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="bi bi-megaphone" style="font-size:30px;color:var(--primary);"></i></div>'}
              <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;">${b.title}</div>
                ${b.description ? `<div style="font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:4px;">${b.description}</div>` : ''}
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);margin-top:8px;">
                  Cashback: <strong style="color:var(--success);">₦${parseFloat(b.cashback_amount||0).toLocaleString()}</strong>
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp; Claims: <strong>${b.claims_count||0}/${b.max_claims||'∞'}</strong>
                  &nbsp;•&nbsp; <span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:${b.is_active?'#d1fae5':'#f1f5f9'};color:${b.is_active?'#059669':'#64748b'};">${b.is_active?'ACTIVE':'INACTIVE'}</span>
                </div>
                ${b.restricted_service ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#92400e;margin-top:4px;"><i class="bi bi-lock-fill"></i> Requires: ${b.restricted_service}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;">
                <button onclick="toggleGiftBanner(${b.id}, ${!b.is_active})" style="background:${b.is_active?'#f59e0b':'#10b981'};color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">${b.is_active?'Deactivate':'Activate'}</button>
                <button onclick="deleteGiftBanner(${b.id})" style="background:#ef4444;color:white;border:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('giftBannerList').innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:30px;">Gift banner endpoint not available yet.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function toggleGiftBanner(id, makeActive) {
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/gift-banners/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: makeActive }) });
        showToast('Banner ' + (makeActive ? 'activated' : 'deactivated'), 'success');
        loadGiftBanners();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to toggle banner', 'error'); }
    }

    async function deleteGiftBanner(id) {
      if (!confirm('Delete this gift banner? This cannot be undone.')) return;
      try {
        await api(`/api/admin/gift-banners/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        showToast('Gift banner deleted', 'success');
        loadGiftBanners();
      } catch(e) { showToast('Failed to delete banner', 'error'); }
    }

    // ==================== LEADERBOARD (admin view) ====================
    async function loadAdminLeaderboard() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/leaderboard');
        const el = document.getElementById('leaderboardList');
        if (data.month) document.getElementById('leaderboardMonth').textContent = data.month;
        const list = data.leaderboard || [];
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--gray-500);padding:40px 20px;"><i class="bi bi-trophy" style="font-size:40px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.3;"></i>No vendor activity yet this month. As vendors refer users, they will appear here.</p>';
          return;
        }
        const medals = ['🥇','🥈','🥉'];
        el.innerHTML = list.map((v, i) => `
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:14px;background:${i < 3 ? '#fef3c7' : '#f9fafb'};border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800;width:40px;text-align:center;">${i < 3 ? medals[i] : (i+1)}</div>
            <div style="flex:1;">
              <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;">${v.fullname || 'Unknown Vendor'}</div>
              <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-600);margin-top:2px;">${v.referral_count} referrals • ₦${parseFloat(v.total_earnings||0).toLocaleString()} earned</div>
            </div>

    // ==================== ALL SCHEDULES (admin oversight) ====================
    async function loadAllSchedules() {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/admin/schedules');
        const list = data.schedules || [];
        const stats = data.stats || { active: 0, paused: 0, dueThisWeek: 0 };
        document.getElementById('schedActive').textContent = stats.active || 0;
        document.getElementById('schedPaused').textContent = stats.paused || 0;
        document.getElementById('schedDueThisWeek').textContent = stats.dueThisWeek || 0;
        const tbody = document.getElementById('schedulesTable');
        if (list.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i><p>No schedules created by users yet</p></div></td></tr>';
          return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(s => `
          <tr>
            <td>${s.user_name || 'Unknown'}<br><small style="color:var(--gray-400)">${s.user_email || ''}</small></td>
            <td><span class="badge badge-info">${s.service}</span></td>
            <td>${s.provider || '-'}</td>
            <td>${s.recipient}</td>
            <td>${s.frequency}</td>
            <td>${new Date(s.next_run_date).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${s.is_active ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-secondary'}">${s.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Paused'}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `).join('');
      } catch(e) {
        document.getElementById('schedulesTable').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle"></i><p>Schedules endpoint not available yet</p></div></td></tr>';
      }
    }

  </script>

  <script>
    async function loadBusiness() {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const userId = params.get('user');
      
      if (!userId) {
        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/business-page/${userId}`);
        const data = await res.json();

        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';

        if (!data.success || !data.business) {
          document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        document.getElementById('businessContent').style.display = 'block';

        // Parse business data (it may be stored as JSON string or object)
        let biz = data.business;
        if (typeof biz === 'string') {
          try { biz = JSON.parse(biz); } catch { biz = {}; }
        }

        document.getElementById('bizName').textContent = biz.businessName || data.fullname || 'Giprince Business';
        document.getElementById('bizDesc').textContent = biz.description || 'Giprince Services Provider';

        // Profile pic
        if (data.profilePic) {
          document.getElementById('bizAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${data.profilePic}" alt="${biz.businessName || 'Business'}">`;
        }

        // Services
        const services = (biz.services || 'Airtime, Data, TV, Electricity').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s);
        document.getElementById('bizServices').innerHTML = services.map(s => `<span class="service-tag">${s}</span>`).join('');

        // WhatsApp
        if (biz.whatsapp) {
          let waNum = biz.whatsapp.replace(/\D/g, '');
          if (waNum.startsWith('234')) waNum = waNum.slice(3);
          if (waNum.startsWith('0')) waNum = waNum.slice(1);
          const btn = document.getElementById('whatsappBtn');
          btn.onclick = () => window.open(`https://wa.me/234${waNum}`, '_blank');
          btn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        document.getElementById('loadingState').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
    loadBusiness();
  </script>

<script>
  let currentUser = null;
  let currentPin = '';
  let pinAction = '';
  let airtimeProvider = '';
  let dataProvider = '';
  let tvProvider = '';
  let currentRating = 0;
  let currentReceipt = null;
  let useCashbackFlag = false;
  let allPricing = []; // Global variable to hold admin pricing
  const TOKEN = localStorage.getItem('token');

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    if (!TOKEN) { window.location.href = '/login.html'; return; }
    document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light');
    updateThemeIcon(localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light');
    loadUserData();
    loadTransactions();
    loadNotifications();
    loadAds();
    loadPricingData(); // Fetch admin prices on load
  });

  async function loadPricingData() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/pricing');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) allPricing = data.pricing;
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    const next = document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
    updateThemeIcon(next);
  }
  function updateThemeIcon(theme) { document.getElementById('themeIcon').className = theme === 'dark' ? 'bi bi-sun-fill' : 'bi bi-moon-fill'; }

  function switchView(view) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[id$="View"]').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById(view + 'View').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelector(`[data-view="${view}"]`).classList.add('active');
    if (view === 'analytics') loadAnalytics('month');
    if (view === 'referral') loadReferralData();
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }

  function openModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
  function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; if (id === 'pinModal') { currentPin = ''; updatePinDisplay(); } }

  async function api(endpoint, options = {}) {
    showLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { ...options, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + TOKEN, ...options.headers } });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Request failed');
      return data;
    } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, 'error'); throw err; }
    finally { showLoading(false); }
  }

  async function loadUserData() {
    try {
      const data = await api('/api/profile');
      currentUser = data.profile;
      document.getElementById('walletBalance').textContent = '₦' + parseFloat(data.profile.wallet_balance || 0).toLocaleString('en-NG', {minimumFractionDigits:2});
      
      const cashback = parseFloat(data.profile.cashback_balance || 0);
      if (cashback > 0) {
        document.getElementById('cashbackPill').style.display = 'inline-block';
        document.getElementById('cashbackPill').innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-gift-fill"></i> Cashback: ₦${cashback.toLocaleString()}`;
        document.getElementById('quickCashback').textContent = '₦' + cashback.toLocaleString();
      } else {
        document.getElementById('quickCashback').textContent = '₦0';
      }

      document.getElementById('profileName').textContent = data.profile.fullname;
      document.getElementById('profileEmail').textContent = data.profile.email;
      document.getElementById('kycStatus').innerHTML = data.profile.kyc_status === 'approved' ? 'Verified <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--success)"></i>' : 'Not verified';
      document.getElementById('pinStatus').textContent = data.profile.has_pin ? 'PIN is set' : 'Set your PIN';
      if (data.profile.profile_pic) document.getElementById('profileAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${data.profile.profile_pic}" alt="Profile">`;
      
      const accountEl = document.getElementById('accountNumber');
      const bankEl = document.getElementById('bankName');
      const kycBtn = document.getElementById('kycBtn');
      
      if (data.profile.account_number) {
        accountEl.textContent = data.profile.account_number;
        bankEl.textContent = data.profile.bank_name || 'Giprince Bank';
        document.getElementById('copyAccountBtn').style.display = 'flex';
        kycBtn.style.display = 'none';
      } else if (data.profile.kyc_status === 'approved') {
        accountEl.textContent = 'Tap button to generate';
        bankEl.textContent = 'Giprince Bank';
        kycBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-bank2"></i> Generate Account Number';
        kycBtn.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        accountEl.textContent = 'Submit KYC to generate';
        bankEl.textContent = 'No Account Active';
        kycBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> Submit KYC';
        kycBtn.style.display = 'block';
      }

      if (data.profile.business_page) { document.getElementById('bizStatus').textContent = 'Business page created'; loadBusinessPage(); }
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  async function handleAccountBtn() {
    if (currentUser.kyc_status !== 'approved') {
      openModal('kycModal');
    } else {
      try {
        const data = await api('/api/profile/generate-account', { method: 'POST' });
        showToast(data.message, 'success');
        loadUserData();
      } catch (err) {}
    }
  }

  async function uploadProfilePic(event) {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return showToast('Image too large (max 5MB)', 'error');
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (e) => {
      try {
        await api('/api/profile/picture', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ profilePic: e.target.result }) });
        document.getElementById('profileAvatar').innerHTML = `<img src="${e.target.result}" alt="Profile">`;
        showToast('Profile picture updated!', 'success');
      } catch (err) {}
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function openService(service) { openModal(service + 'Modal'); }

  // DYNAMIC PRICING SELECTION - DISPLAYS VALIDITY
  function selectProvider(provider, type) {
    if (type === 'airtime') { 
      airtimeProvider = provider; 
      document.querySelectorAll('#airtimeModal .provider-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected')); 
    } else if (type === 'data') { 
      dataProvider = provider; 
      document.querySelectorAll('#dataModal .provider-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      populateDynamicPlans('data', provider, 'dataPlan'); 
    } else if (type === 'tv') { 
      tvProvider = provider; 
      document.querySelectorAll('#tvModal .provider-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      populateDynamicPlans('tv', provider, 'tvPlan'); 
    }
    const target = document.querySelector(`#${type}Modal [data-provider="${provider}"]`);
    if (target) target.classList.add('selected');
  }

  function populateDynamicPlans(service, provider, selectId) {
    const select = document.getElementById(selectId);
    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Select Plan</option>';
    
    // Match provider case-insensitively
    const plans = allPricing.filter(p => p.service === service && p.provider.toUpperCase() === provider.toUpperCase());
    
    if (plans.length === 0) {
      select.innerHTML = '<option value="">No plans available</option>';
      return;
    }

    plans.forEach(p => {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = p.plan;
      // Include validity if available (e.g. "30 Days", "1 Month")
      const validityText = p.validity ? ` (${p.validity})` : '';
      opt.textContent = `${p.plan}${validityText} - ₦${parseFloat(p.selling_price).toLocaleString()}`;
      select.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function buyAirtime() { if (!airtimeProvider) return showToast('Select provider', 'error'); if (!document.getElementById('airtimePhone').value || !document.getElementById('airtimeAmount').value) return showToast('Fill fields', 'error'); pinAction = 'airtime'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }
  function buyData() { if (!dataProvider) return showToast('Select provider', 'error'); if (!document.getElementById('dataPhone').value || !document.getElementById('dataPlan').value) return showToast('Fill fields', 'error'); pinAction = 'data'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }
  function subscribeTV() { if (!tvProvider) return showToast('Select provider', 'error'); if (!document.getElementById('tvCardNumber').value || !document.getElementById('tvPlan').value) return showToast('Fill fields', 'error'); pinAction = 'tv'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }
  function payElectricity() { if (!document.getElementById('elecProvider').value || !document.getElementById('meterNumber').value || !document.getElementById('elecAmount').value) return showToast('Fill fields', 'error'); pinAction = 'electricity'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }
  function buyEducationPin() { if (!document.getElementById('examType').value) return showToast('Select exam', 'error'); pinAction = 'education'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }
  function fundBet() { if (!document.getElementById('betProvider').value || !document.getElementById('betUserId').value || !document.getElementById('betAmount').value) return showToast('Fill fields', 'error'); pinAction = 'bet'; checkCashbackAndOpenPin(); }

  function checkCashbackAndOpenPin() {
    const cashback = parseFloat(currentUser?.cashback_balance || 0);
    if (cashback > 0) {
      document.getElementById('cashbackModalAmount').textContent = '₦' + cashback.toLocaleString();
      openModal('cashbackModal');
    } else {
      openPinModal(pinAction);
    }
  }

  function proceedWithPurchase(useCashback) {
    useCashbackFlag = useCashback;
    closeModal('cashbackModal');
    openPinModal(pinAction);
  }

  function enterPin(num) { if (currentPin.length < 4) { currentPin += num; updatePinDisplay(); if (currentPin.length === 4) setTimeout(submitPin, 300); } }
  function clearPin() { currentPin = currentPin.slice(0, -1); updatePinDisplay(); }
  function updatePinDisplay() { document.querySelectorAll('#pinDisplay .pin-dot').forEach((dot, i) => dot.classList.toggle('filled', i < currentPin.length)); }

  async function submitPin() {
    if (currentPin.length !== 4) return showToast('Enter 4-digit PIN', 'error');
    const savedPin = currentPin;
    closeModal('pinModal');

    try {
      let result;
      const uc = useCashbackFlag;
      
      if (pinAction === 'airtime') {
        result = await api('/api/airtime/purchase', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ provider: airtimeProvider, phone: document.getElementById('airtimePhone').value.trim(), amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('airtimeAmount').value), pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'data') {
        result = await api('/api/data/purchase', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ provider: dataProvider, phone: document.getElementById('dataPhone').value.trim(), plan: document.getElementById('dataPlan').value, amount: 0, pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'tv') {
        result = await api('/api/tv/purchase', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ provider: tvProvider, smartCardNumber: document.getElementById('tvCardNumber').value.trim(), plan: document.getElementById('tvPlan').value, amount: 0, pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'electricity') {
        result = await api('/api/electricity/purchase', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ provider: document.getElementById('elecProvider').value, meterNumber: document.getElementById('meterNumber').value.trim(), meterType: document.getElementById('meterType').value, amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('elecAmount').value), pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'education') {
        result = await api('/api/education/purchase', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ examType: document.getElementById('examType').value, quantity: parseInt(document.getElementById('pinQuantity').value) || 1, amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('pinAmount').value) || 0, pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'bet') {
        result = await api('/api/bet/fund', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ provider: document.getElementById('betProvider').value, userId: document.getElementById('betUserId').value.trim(), amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('betAmount').value), pin: savedPin, useCashback: uc }) });
      } else if (pinAction === 'transfer') {
        result = await api('/api/transfer', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ recipient: document.getElementById('transferRecipient').value.trim(), amount: parseFloat(document.getElementById('transferAmount').value), remark: document.getElementById('transferRemark').value, pin: savedPin }) });
      }

      if (result && result.success) {
        showToast(result.message || 'Success', 'success');
        if (result.pins) showToast('Your pins: ' + result.pins.join(', '), 'success');
        loadUserData(); loadTransactions();
        ['airtimeModal','dataModal','tvModal','electricityModal','educationModal','betModal','transferModal'].forEach(m => { const el = document.getElementById(m); if (el) closeModal(m); });
        useCashbackFlag = false;
      }
    } catch (err) { console.error('Purchase error:', err); }
    currentPin = '';
  }

  function openPinModal(action) { pinAction = action; openModal('pinModal'); }

  function openSetPinModal() {
    const hasPin = currentUser && currentUser.has_pin;
    document.getElementById('setPinTitle').textContent = hasPin ? 'Change Transaction PIN' : 'Set Transaction PIN';
    document.getElementById('currentPinGroup').style.display = hasPin ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('currentPinInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('newPin').value = '';
    document.getElementById('confirmPin').value = '';
    openModal('setPinModal');
  }

  async function setTransactionPin() {
    const newPin = document.getElementById('newPin').value;
    const confirmPinVal = document.getElementById('confirmPin').value;
    const currentPinVal = document.getElementById('currentPinInput').value;
    if (newPin.length !== 4) return showToast('PIN must be 4 digits', 'error');
    if (newPin !== confirmPinVal) return showToast('PINs do not match', 'error');
    const body = { pin: newPin };
    if (currentUser && currentUser.has_pin) {
      if (!currentPinVal) return showToast('Enter your current PIN', 'error');
      body.currentPin = currentPinVal;
    }
    try {
      await api('/api/profile/pin', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      showToast('PIN saved successfully!', 'success');
      closeModal('setPinModal');
      loadUserData();
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  async function changePassword() {
    const current = document.getElementById('currentPassword').value;
    const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
    const confirm = document.getElementById('confirmNewPassword').value;
    if (!current || !newPwd) return showToast('Fill all fields', 'error');
    if (newPwd !== confirm) return showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error');
    if (newPwd.length < 6) return showToast('Password too short', 'error');
    try {
      await api('/api/profile/password', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ currentPassword: current, newPassword: newPwd }) });
      showToast('Password changed', 'success');
      closeModal('passwordModal');
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  async function submitKyc() {

            <div style="flex:1;"><div style="font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text);">${ad.title}</div><div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-secondary);">${ad.topic || ''}</div></div>
            <span style="font-size:9px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--warning), #f97316); color:white; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px; font-weight:700;">AD</span>
          </div>`).join('');
