  async function loadTransactions() {
    try {
      const data = await api('/api/transactions');
      document.getElementById('quickTxnCount').textContent = data.transactions.length;
      renderTransactions(data.transactions.slice(0, 5), 'recentTransactions');
      renderTransactions(data.transactions, 'allTransactions');
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  function renderTransactions(txns, containerId) {
    const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!txns || txns.length === 0) { container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:var(--text-secondary);"><i class="bi bi-receipt" style="font-size:40px; opacity:0.3;"></i><br><br>No transactions yet</div>'; return; }
    container.innerHTML = txns.map(t => {
      const isCredit = ['fund', 'credit', 'referral'].includes(t.type);
      const icon = t.type === 'purchase' ? 'bi-cart-fill' : t.type === 'fund' ? 'bi-wallet-fill' : t.type === 'transfer' ? 'bi-arrow-left-right' : t.type === 'credit' ? 'bi-arrow-down-circle-fill' : 'bi-receipt';
      return `<div class="txn-item" onclick="showReceipt(${t.id})">
        <div class="txn-icon ${t.status === 'success' ? 'success' : t.status === 'pending' ? 'pending' : 'failed'}"><i class="bi ${icon}"></i></div>
        <div class="txn-info"><div class="txn-title">${t.service || t.type}</div><div class="txn-meta">${new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()} • ${t.status}</div></div>
        <div class="txn-amount ${isCredit ? 'credit' : 'debit'}">${isCredit ? '+' : '-'}₦${parseFloat(t.total || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  async function showReceipt(txnId) {
    try {
      const data = await api(`/api/transactions/${txnId}/receipt`);
      if (!data.success) return;
      const r = data.receipt;
      currentReceipt = r;
      document.getElementById('receiptBody').innerHTML = `
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Transaction ID</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.transaction_id || r.reference || '-'}</span></div>
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Date</span><span class="receipt-value">${new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Type</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.type}</span></div>
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Service</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.service || '-'}</span></div>
        ${r.provider ? `<div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Provider</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.provider}</span></div>` : ''}
        ${r.plan ? `<div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Plan</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.plan}</span></div>` : ''}
        ${r.recipient ? `<div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Recipient</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.recipient}</span></div>` : ''}
        ${r.remark ? `<div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Remark</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.remark}</span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Amount</span><span class="receipt-value">₦${parseFloat(r.amount || 0).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        ${parseFloat(r.cashback || 0) > 0 ? `<div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Cashback Earned</span><span class="receipt-value" style="color:var(--success)">+₦${parseFloat(r.cashback).toLocaleString()}</span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Status</span><span class="receipt-value" style="color:${r.status === 'success' ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)'}">${r.status.toUpperCase()}</span></div>
        <div class="receipt-row"><span class="receipt-label">Customer</span><span class="receipt-value">${r.fullname || '-'}</span></div>
        <div class="receipt-total"><span>Total</span><span>₦${parseFloat(r.total || 0).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
      `;
      openModal('receiptModal');
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  function downloadReceipt() { window.print(); }
  async function shareReceipt() {
    if (!currentReceipt) return;
    const r = currentReceipt;
    const text = `Giprince Receipt\nTransaction ID: ${r.transaction_id || r.reference}\nService: ${r.service}\nAmount: ₦${parseFloat(r.total || 0).toLocaleString()}\nStatus: ${r.status}\nDate: ${new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString()}`;
    if (navigator.share) {
      try { await navigator.share({ title: 'Giprince Receipt', text }); } catch {}
    } else {
      copyToClipboard(text);
      showToast('Receipt copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    }
  }

      document.getElementById('txnCount').textContent = count;
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  async function playSpin() {
    const phone = document.getElementById('spinPhone').value;

      document.getElementById('spinWheel').style.transition = 'transform 1s ease-out';

  async function loadNotifications() {
    try {
      const data = await api('/api/notifications');
      document.getElementById('notifBadge').textContent = data.unreadCount;
      document.getElementById('notifBadge').style.display = data.unreadCount > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
      const list = document.getElementById('notifList');
      if (data.notifications.length === 0) { list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:var(--text-secondary);"><i class="bi bi-bell" style="font-size:40px; opacity:0.3;"></i><br><br>No notifications</div>'; return; }
      list.innerHTML = data.notifications.map(n => `<div style="background:var(--input-bg); border-radius:8px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:8px; cursor:pointer; border-left:3px solid ${n.is_read ? 'transparent' : 'var(--primary)'};" onclick="markRead(${n.id})"><div style="font-size:13px; font-weight:700;">${n.title}</div><div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:4px;">${n.message}</div><div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); margin-top:6px;">${new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div></div>`).join('');
    } catch (err) {}
  }
  function openNotifications() { document.getElementById('notifPanel').style.transform = 'translateX(0)'; }

  function setRating(rating) {
    currentRating = rating;
    document.querySelectorAll('#starRating i').forEach((star, i) => { star.className = i < rating ? 'bi bi-star-fill' : 'bi bi-star'; star.style.color = i < rating ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--gray-300)'; });
  }
  async function submitReview() {

  async function enrollAgent() { try { await api('/api/agent/enroll', { method: 'POST' }); showToast('Agent enrollment successful!', 'success'); closeModal('agentModal'); } catch (err) {} }

  function copyToClipboard(text) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => { const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); }); showToast('Copied to clipboard!', 'success'); }
  function showToast(message, type = 'success') { const toast = document.getElementById('toast'); const icon = type === 'success' ? 'bi-check-circle-fill' : type === 'error' ? 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill' : 'bi-info-circle-fill'; toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${icon}"></i> ${message}`; toast.className = 'toast ' + type; toast.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500); }
  function showLoading(show) { document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.toggle('active', show); }
  function logout() { localStorage.removeItem('token'); window.location.href = '/login.html'; }

  document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(overlay => { overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active'); }); });

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';
    let resendTimer = null;
    let countdown = 60;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const token = urlParams.get('token');
      if (token) {
        document.getElementById('step1').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step3').classList.remove('hidden');
        window.resetToken = token;
      }
    });

    function togglePassword(inputId, iconId) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = document.getElementById(iconId);
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
      }
    }

    async function handleForgot(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();

      if (!email) {
        showToast('Please enter your email address', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;

      // Animate envelope flying away
      document.getElementById('emailIcon').classList.add('flying');

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/forgot-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email })
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        // Always show success (security through obscurity)
        document.getElementById('sentEmail').textContent = email;
        document.getElementById('step1').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step2').classList.remove('hidden');
        startResendTimer();
        showToast('Reset link sent to your email', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function startResendTimer() {
      const link = document.getElementById('resendLink');
      const timerText = document.getElementById('timerText');
      countdown = 60;
      link.classList.add('disabled');

      if (resendTimer) clearInterval(resendTimer);
      resendTimer = setInterval(() => {
        countdown--;
        timerText.textContent = ` (${countdown}s)`;
        if (countdown <= 0) {
          clearInterval(resendTimer);
          link.classList.remove('disabled');
          timerText.textContent = '';
        }
      }, 1000);
    }

    async function handleResend() {
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      if (!email) return;

      const link = document.getElementById('resendLink');
      if (link.classList.contains('disabled')) return;

      try {
        await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/forgot-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email })
        });
        showToast('Reset link resent!', 'success');
        startResendTimer();
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Failed to resend. Please try again.', 'error');
      }
    }

    async function handleReset(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
      const newPassword = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
      const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;

      if (!newPassword || !confirmPassword) {
        showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
        showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (newPassword.length < 6) {
        showToast('Password must be at least 6 characters', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/reset-password', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ token: window.resetToken, newPassword })
        });
        const data = await res.json();

        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Reset failed');

        document.getElementById('step3').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('step4').classList.remove('hidden');
        showToast('Password reset successfully!', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // Universal PWA Service Worker Registration
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')
                .then((reg) => console.log('PWA active on this view:', reg.scope))
                .catch((err) => console.error('PWA registration failed:', err));
        });
    }
</script>

    // ==================== LIVE STATS ====================
    async function loadLiveStats() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/stats');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          animateStat('statUsers', data.stats.totalUsers, '+');
          animateStat('statTxns', data.stats.totalTransactions, '+');
          animateStat('statUptime', data.stats.uptime, '%');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        animateStat('statUsers', 5000, '+');
        animateStat('statTxns', 15000, '+');
        animateStat('statUptime', 99.9, '%');
      }
    }

    function animateStat(id, target, suffix) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      let current = 0;
      const steps = 50; 
      const increment = target / steps;
      let stepCount = 0;
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        stepCount++;
        current += increment;
        if (stepCount >= steps) {
          current = target;
          clearInterval(interval);
        }
        const displayValue = target % 1 !== 0 ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.floor(current).toLocaleString();
        el.textContent = displayValue + suffix;
      }, 30);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadLiveStats);
  </script>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = '';

    function togglePassword() {
      const input = document.getElementById('password');
      const icon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
      }
    }

    async function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;

      if (!email || !password) {
        showToast('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.classList.add('loading');
      btn.disabled = true;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });

        // Safely parse JSON. If Vercel sends HTML, catch it and show a readable error.
        const text = await res.text();
        let data;
        try {
            data = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Server returned HTML instead of JSON:', text);
            throw new Error('Server is taking too long to respond or crashed. Please try again.');
        }

        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Login failed');

        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
        if (document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked) {
          localStorage.setItem('rememberEmail', email);
        }
        showToast('Welcome back! Redirecting...', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/dashboard.html', 1200);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error');
        btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally {
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }

    // Auto-fill remembered email
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const remembered = localStorage.getItem('rememberEmail');
      if (remembered) {
        document.getElementById('email').value = remembered;
        document.getElementById('rememberMe').checked = true;
      }
    });
  </script>

    const API_BASE = '';
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const ref = urlParams.get('ref');
      if (ref) {
        document.getElementById('referralCode').value = ref;
        document.getElementById('referrerCode').textContent = ref;
        document.getElementById('referralBadge').style.display = 'inline-flex';
        document.getElementById('referralGroup').style.display = 'block';
      }

    function togglePassword(inputId, iconId) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = document.getElementById(iconId);
      if (input.type === 'password') { input.type = 'text'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye'; } 
      else { input.type = 'password'; icon.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash'; }
    }

    function checkPasswordStrength() {
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
      const bar = document.getElementById('strengthBar');
      const barInner = document.getElementById('strengthBarInner');
      const text = document.getElementById('strengthText');
      if (password.length === 0) { bar.classList.remove('show'); text.classList.remove('show'); return; }
      bar.classList.add('show'); text.classList.add('show');
      let strength = 0;
      if (password.length >= 6) strength++;
      if (password.length >= 8) strength++;
      if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength++;
      if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength++;
      if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) strength++;
      barInner.className = 'password-strength-bar';
      text.className = 'password-strength-text show';
      if (strength <= 2) { barInner.classList.add('weak'); text.classList.add('weak'); text.textContent = 'Weak password'; } 
      else if (strength <= 3) { barInner.classList.add('medium'); text.classList.add('medium'); text.textContent = 'Medium strength'; } 
      else { barInner.classList.add('strong'); text.classList.add('strong'); text.textContent = 'Strong password'; }
    }

    async function handleRegister(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('registerBtn');
      const fullname = document.getElementById('fullname').value.trim();
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const phone = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
      const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
      const referralCode = document.getElementById('referralCode').value.trim();
      const agreeRules = document.getElementById('agree_rules').checked;

      if (!fullname || !email || !phone || !password) { showToast('Please fill in all required fields', 'error'); return; }
      if (password !== confirmPassword) { showToast('Passwords do not match', 'error'); return; }
      if (password.length < 6) { showToast('Password must be at least 6 characters', 'error'); return; }
      if (phone.length < 10) { showToast('Please enter a valid phone number', 'error'); return; }
      if (!agreeRules) { showToast('You must agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy', 'error'); return; }

      btn.classList.add('loading'); btn.disabled = true;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/api/auth/register', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ fullname, email, phone, password, referralCode }) });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Registration failed');
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
        showToast('Account created successfully! Redirecting...', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/dashboard.html', 1500);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message, 'error'); btn.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
      } finally { btn.classList.remove('loading'); btn.disabled = false; }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-${type === 'success' ? 'check-circle-fill' : 'exclamation-circle-fill'}"></i> ${message}`;
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type; toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }
  </script>

const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'yenllet_secret_key';

// ===================== AUTH MIDDLEWARE =====================
const authenticate = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  try { req.user = jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET); next(); }
  catch { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' }); }
};

const authenticateAdmin = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET);
    if (!decoded.isAdmin) return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Admin access required' });
    req.user = decoded; next();
  } catch { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' }); }
};

// ✅ NEW: Reseller API Key authentication (separate from JWT)
const authenticateResellerApiKey = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const apiKey = req.headers['x-api-key'] || req.headers['api-key'] || req.query.api_key;
    if (!apiKey) return res.status(401).json({ success: false, error: 'API key required. Pass it via x-api-key header.' });

    const keyRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT rak.*, rs.status as sub_status, rs.expires_at, rs.discount_percent,
             u.wallet_balance, u.is_banned, u.fullname, u.email, u.id as user_id
      FROM reseller_api_keys rak
      JOIN users u ON rak.user_id = u.id
      LEFT JOIN reseller_subscriptions rs ON rs.user_id = u.id AND rs.status = 'active'
      WHERE rak.api_key = $1 AND rak.is_active = true
    `, [apiKey]);

    if (keyRes.rows.length === 0) return res.status(401).json({ success: false, error: 'Invalid or inactive API key' });

    const data = keyRes.rows[0];
    if (data.is_banned) return res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: 'Reseller account is banned' });

    // Check if subscription is still active
    const isSubscriptionActive = data.sub_status === 'active' && data.expires_at && new Date(data.expires_at) > new Date();

    req.reseller = {
      userId: data.user_id,
      apiKeyId: data.id,
      fullname: data.fullname,
      email: data.email,
      walletBalance: parseFloat(data.wallet_balance || 0),
      isSubscriptionActive,
      discountPercent: isSubscriptionActive ? parseFloat(data.discount_percent || 0) : 0,
      subscriptionExpiresAt: data.expires_at
    };

    // Update last_used + total_requests (fire and forget)
    pool.query('UPDATE reseller_api_keys SET last_used = NOW(), total_requests = total_requests + 1 WHERE id = $1', [data.id]).catch(() => {});

    next();
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: 'API key authentication failed' });
  }
};

// ✅ Get admin settings (cached per request)

// ✅ Get support contact info (phone, whatsapp, email, hours).
// Used by /api/auth/login and /api/auth/gustmii-sso to attach support info
// to the "banned" error response so banned users see a real phone number
// they can call or WhatsApp, instead of just "Contact support."
const getSupportContact = async () => {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query("SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'support_contact'");
    if (result.rows.length === 0) return { phone: '09030943391', whatsapp: '09030943391', email: '', hours: '24/7' };
    const raw = result.rows[0].value;
    const parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    return {
      phone: parsed.phone || '09030943391',
      whatsapp: parsed.whatsapp || parsed.phone || '09030943391',
      email: parsed.email || '',
      hours: parsed.hours || '24/7'
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { phone: '09030943391', whatsapp: '09030943391', email: '', hours: '24/7' };
  }
};

// ✅ Get the deposit-fee note that the dashboard shows next to the account number.
// This explains to users that bank transfers to their dedicated Flutterwave virtual
// account incur a small Flutterwave processing fee (the actual fee Flutterwave
// charges per transaction — NOT a fee Yenllet sets). The webhook credits the user
// with the NET amount (after Flutterwave's fee), so the note helps avoid
// "I sent ₦100 but only got ₦97" confusion.
const getDepositFeeNote = async () => {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query("SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'deposit_fee_note'");
    if (result.rows.length === 0) {
      return {
        enabled: true,
        title: 'Flutterwave Processing Fee',
        body: 'Bank transfers to this account number attract a small Flutterwave processing fee (currently around 1.5% per transaction, or a flat fee as set by Flutterwave). When a sender transfers money, the exact amount that lands in your wallet is the NET amount AFTER Flutterwave deducts their fee — not the gross amount sent.',
        example: 'e.g. send ₦100 → you receive around ₦97 (Flutterwave deducts ~₦3 fee)'
      };
    }
    const raw = result.rows[0].value;
    const parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    return {
      enabled: parsed.enabled !== false,
      title: parsed.title || 'Flutterwave Processing Fee',
      body: parsed.body || '',
      example: parsed.example || ''
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { enabled: true, title: 'Flutterwave Processing Fee', body: '', example: '' };
  }
};

// ✅ Normalize Nigerian phone number to international format (no + sign).
// Examples: 09030943391 → 2349030943391, +234 903 094 3391 → 2349030943391
const normalizePhoneInternational = (phone) => {
  if (!phone) return '';
  let p = String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (p.startsWith('234')) return p;
  if (p.startsWith('0')) return '234' + p.slice(1);
  if (p.length === 10) return '234' + p;
  return p;
};

// ✅ Get reseller subscription for a user
const getResellerSubscription = async (userId) => {
  const result = await pool.query(`
    SELECT * FROM reseller_subscriptions
    WHERE user_id = $1 AND status = 'active'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  `, [userId]);
  if (result.rows.length === 0) return null;
  const sub = result.rows[0];
  const isExpired = sub.expires_at && new Date(sub.expires_at) < new Date();
  return {
    ...sub,
    isActive: !isExpired,
    isExpired,
    discountPercent: parseFloat(sub.discount_percent || 0)
  };
};

// ===================== EMAIL =====================
const sendUserEmail = async (userId, subject, textContent, actionUrl = null, actionText = null) => {
  try {
    // ✅ VERBOSE LOGGING — so you can see exactly why emails aren't going out
    if (!process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) {
      console.warn('⚠️  [EMAIL SKIPPED] RESEND_API_KEY env var is not set on the server.');
      console.warn('    On Vercel: Project Settings → Environment Variables → add RESEND_API_KEY, then REDEPLOY.');
      console.warn('    On local: create a .env file in the project root with: RESEND_API_KEY=re_xxxxxxxx');
      console.warn(`    Email that WOULD have been sent → To: userId=${userId}, Subject: "${subject}"`);
      return;
    }
    const userRes = await pool.query('SELECT email, fullname, email_visible FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);
    if (!userRes.rows.length) { console.warn(`⚠️  [EMAIL SKIPPED] User ${userId} not found in database`); return; }
    if (!userRes.rows[0].email_visible) { console.log(`ℹ️  [EMAIL SKIPPED] User ${userId} has email_visible=false (opted out)`); return; }
    const email = userRes.rows[0].email;
    const fullname = userRes.rows[0].fullname;
    console.log(`📧 [EMAIL SENDING] To: ${email} | Subject: ${subject}`);
    const buttonHtml = actionUrl ? `<a href="${actionUrl}" style="display:inline-block;background:#2563eb;color:white;padding:12px 24px;text-decoration:none;border-radius:5px;margin:20px 0;font-weight:bold;">${actionText || 'Click Here'}</a>` : '';
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"></head><body style="font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background-color:#f8f9fa;margin:0;padding:20px;"><div style="max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;background-color:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"><div style="background-color:#1e293b;padding:20px;text-align:center;"><img src="https://res.cloudinary.com/x9cnhu3z/image/upload/v1792062220/Yenllet_Blue_Ribbon_Logo_ltmv0i.png" alt="Yenllet Logo" style="height:50px;"></div><div style="padding:30px;"><h2 style="color:#1f2937;margin-bottom:10px;">${subject}</h2><p style="color:#4b5563;line-height:1.6;">Hi ${fullname},</p><div style="color:#4b5563;line-height:1.6;">${textContent}</div>${buttonHtml}</div><div style="background-color:#f1f5f9;padding:20px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;"><p>&copy; ${new Date().getFullYear()} Yenllet. All rights reserved.</p></div></div></body></html>`;
    const response = await axios.post('https://api.resend.com/emails', { from: 'Yenllet <no-reply@yenllet.name.ng>', to: [email], subject, html }, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RESEND_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
    console.log(`✅ [EMAIL SENT] To: ${email} | Resend ID: ${response.data?.id || 'unknown'}`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('❌ [EMAIL FAILED]', e.response?.data || e.message);
    if (e.response?.status === 401 || e.response?.status === 403) {
      console.error('    → Your RESEND_API_KEY is invalid or expired. Generate a new one at https://resend.com/api-keys');
    } else if (e.response?.status === 422) {
      console.error('    → The email address may be undeliverable, or the "from" domain is not verified.');
      console.error('    → Verify yenllet.name.ng in your Resend dashboard → Domains.');
    }
  }
};

// ===================== GUSTMII HELPERS =====================
async function deductFromGustmiiWallet(amount, gustmiiToken) {
  try {
    await axios.post('https://gustmii.name.ng/api/wallet/cross-app-deduct', { amount, description: 'Yenllet VTU Purchase' }, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${gustmiiToken}` } });
    return true;
  } catch (err) { console.error('Gustmii Wallet Deduction Failed:', err.response?.data || err.message); return false; }
}
async function creditGustmiiWallet(amount, gustmiiToken) {
  try {
    await axios.post('https://gustmii.name.ng/api/wallet/cross-app-credit', { amount, description: 'Yenllet VTU Refund' }, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${gustmiiToken}` } });
    return true;
  } catch (err) { console.error('Gustmii Wallet Credit Failed:', err.response?.data || err.message); return false; }
}
async function verifyGustmiiToken(gustmiiToken) {
  try {
    const gustmiiRes = await axios.get(`${GUSTMII_API}/api/auth/me`, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${gustmiiToken}` } });
    if (!gustmiiRes.data || !gustmiiRes.data.id) return null;
    return gustmiiRes.data;
  } catch (err) { console.error('Gustmii token verification failed:', err.response?.status || err.message); return null; }
}

// ===================== DATABASE INIT =====================
async function initDatabase() {
  try {
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, fullname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        phone VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, profile_pic TEXT, business_link TEXT, business_page JSONB,
        is_admin BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, kyc_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending', kyc_bvn VARCHAR(11), kyc_nin VARCHAR(11),
        kyc_submitted_at TIMESTAMP, kyc_approved_at TIMESTAMP, wallet_balance DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        cashback_balance DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0, account_number VARCHAR(12) UNIQUE, bank_name VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Yenllet Bank',
        pin TEXT, api_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE, referral_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE, referred_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), is_banned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        ban_reason TEXT, email_visible BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, is_agent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, agent_code VARCHAR(20),
        spins_claimed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gustmii_linked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        service VARCHAR(50), amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, total DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        transaction_id VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE, reference VARCHAR(100), recipient VARCHAR(50), provider VARCHAR(50), plan VARCHAR(100),
        remark TEXT, cashback DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0, receipt_data JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        message TEXT, type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'info', is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, image_url TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    // ✅ Add image_url column to existing notifications tables (auto-migrate)
    try { await pool.query('ALTER TABLE notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS image_url TEXT'); } catch (e) {}
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, value JSONB NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pricing (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, service VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, plan VARCHAR(100),
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, selling_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, discount_percent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
        cashback_percent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0, validity VARCHAR(50), category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'general', is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        ck_plan_code VARCHAR(20),
        CONSTRAINT unique_pricing UNIQUE (service, provider, plan)
    )`);
    // ✅ Add ck_plan_code column to existing pricing tables (auto-migrate)
    try { await pool.query('ALTER TABLE pricing ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ck_plan_code VARCHAR(20)'); } catch (e) {}
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ads (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title VARCHAR(255), link TEXT,
        banner_url TEXT, topic VARCHAR(100), price_per_day DECIMAL(10,2), total_days INTEGER, total_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
        start_date DATE, end_date DATE, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending', clicks INTEGER DEFAULT 0, impressions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, rating INTEGER CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),
        comment TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ BVN/NIN BLACKLIST — when admin deletes a user's account because the
    // BVN/NIN is fake or fraudulent, admin can opt to blacklist that ID. Any
    // future account generation attempt with that BVN/NIN will be rejected
    // BEFORE reaching Flutterwave (so Flutterwave won't return the old account).
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS id_blacklist (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        id_value VARCHAR(11) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        id_type VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL CHECK (id_type IN ('BVN','NIN')),
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        blocked_by_admin_id INTEGER,
        blocked_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);
    console.log('✅ id_blacklist table ready');

    // ✅ ORPHANED DEPOSITS — when admin deletes a user's bank account (because
    // the BVN was fake), the OLD Flutterwave virtual account still exists on
    // Flutterwave's side. If anyone sends money to that orphaned account number
    // (e.g., the banned user themselves, or someone who still has the old
    // account number saved), the webhook fires `transfer.completed` but no user
    // in Yenllet's DB owns that account anymore. We log those deposits here so
    // admin can see the trapped funds and manually decide what to do (refund
    // the sender, or keep them in escrow).
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orphaned_deposits (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        bank_name VARCHAR(100),
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        currency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'NGN',
        flutterwave_tx_id VARCHAR(100),
        flutterwave_reference VARCHAR(200),
        sender_name VARCHAR(255),
        sender_account_number VARCHAR(50),
        raw_payload JSONB,
        received_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        reviewed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        admin_note TEXT,
        reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),
        reviewed_at TIMESTAMP
    )`);
    console.log('✅ orphaned_deposits table ready');

    // ✅ DELETED ACCOUNTS REGISTRY — when admin deletes a user's bank account
    // (e.g. because the BVN was fake), we record (account_number → original_user_id)
    // here. Then when an orphaned deposit comes in for that account_number, we can
    // show admin "this money was sent to a banned user's old account" + show the
    // banned user's name + email so admin can decide whether to refund them.
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deleted_accounts (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        account_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        bank_name VARCHAR(100),
        original_user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        original_user_fullname VARCHAR(255),
        original_user_email VARCHAR(255),
        original_user_phone VARCHAR(20),
        bvn_or_nin VARCHAR(11),
        id_type VARCHAR(3),
        deleted_by_admin_id INTEGER,
        deleted_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        UNIQUE(account_number)
    )`);
    console.log('✅ deleted_accounts table ready');

    // ✅ WEBHOOK LOGS — records EVERY incoming webhook request (even rejected
    // ones). This lets admin see if Flutterwave is actually sending webhooks
    // to Yenllet, and if so, what's failing (signature mismatch, wrong event
    // name, unknown account_number, etc.). Without this, the webhook handler
    // silently drops requests and admin has no way to diagnose "I funded my
    // wallet via bank transfer but it didn't reflect" issues.
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_logs (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        received_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        source VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'flutterwave',
        event_name VARCHAR(100),
        signature_header TEXT,
        signature_match BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        router_secret_match BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        processed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        reject_reason TEXT,
        account_number VARCHAR(50),
        amount DECIMAL(12,2),
        tx_ref VARCHAR(200),
        flw_tx_id VARCHAR(100),
        raw_payload JSONB,
        raw_headers JSONB,
        ip_address VARCHAR(50)
    )`);
    console.log('✅ webhook_logs table ready');

    // ✅ NEW: Reseller subscriptions table
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reseller_subscriptions (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active',
        monthly_fee DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 5000,
        discount_percent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 10,
        started_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        expires_at TIMESTAMP,
        last_payment_at TIMESTAMP,
        payment_reference VARCHAR(100),
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ NEW: Reseller API keys (separate from regular user api_key)
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reseller_api_keys (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        api_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        label VARCHAR(100),
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        last_used TIMESTAMP,
        total_requests INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ NEW: Reseller transactions (log of API purchases)
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reseller_transactions (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        reseller_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
        api_key_id INTEGER REFERENCES reseller_api_keys(id),
        type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        service VARCHAR(50),
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        base_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        discount_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        transaction_id VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE,
        recipient VARCHAR(50),
        provider VARCHAR(50),
        plan VARCHAR(100),
        receipt_data JSONB,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // Column migrations
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS api_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE pricing ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'general'`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reset_token TEXT`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reset_expires TIMESTAMP`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gustmii_linked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS push_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email_notifications BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_vendor BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'none'`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_approved_at TIMESTAMP`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_business_name VARCHAR(255)`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_whatsapp VARCHAR(20)`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_experience TEXT`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_promotion TEXT`);

    // ✅ LOYALTY + STREAK COLUMNS — used by the Loyalty Tiers (Feature 1) and
    // Streak Rewards (Feature 2) programs. Auto-migrate here on server boot,
    // AND in the lazy ensureLoyaltyStreakColumns() helper below (called from
    // each user-facing endpoint) so cold-starts on Vercel don't crash if a
    // request arrives before initDatabase() finishes.
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS current_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_purchase_date DATE`);
    await pool.query(`ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_loyalty_bonus_month VARCHAR(7)`);

    // ✅ VENDOR REFERRALS TABLE — tracks who each vendor referred + earnings
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendor_referrals (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        vendor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        referred_user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        referral_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        total_purchases DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        vendor_earnings DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ VENDOR CHAT TABLE — private chat between user and vendor
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendor_chats (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        vendor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        message TEXT NOT NULL,
        sender_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
        is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        is_faq BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ SAVED RECIPIENTS TABLE — phone numbers user saved for quick re-buy
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS saved_recipients (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        name VARCHAR(100),
        network VARCHAR(20),
        service VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'airtime',
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        UNIQUE(user_id, phone, service)
    )`);

    // ✅ FAQ QUESTIONS TABLE — admin sets quick-answer questions
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS faq_questions (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        question TEXT NOT NULL,
        answer TEXT NOT NULL,
        category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'general',
        sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ FCM TOKENS TABLE — for push notifications
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fcm_tokens (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ GIFT BANNERS — admin creates promotional banners with optional cashback gifts
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gift_banners (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        description TEXT,
        banner_image TEXT NOT NULL,
        link_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'internal',
        link_url TEXT,
        internal_section VARCHAR(50),
        cashback_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        restricted_service VARCHAR(50),
        max_claims INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        claims_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        start_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        end_date TIMESTAMP,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ CLAIMED GIFTS — tracks which users claimed which gift banners (prevents double-claiming)
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claimed_gifts (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        gift_banner_id INTEGER REFERENCES gift_banners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        cashback_amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        restricted_service VARCHAR(50),
        is_used BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        claimed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        used_at TIMESTAMP,
        UNIQUE(user_id, gift_banner_id)
    )`);

    // ✅ PROMO CARDS — Admin-created promotional cards shown on the user dashboard
    // (where the cashback pill/Quick Services live). Each card has an image +
    // deep-link target (service + provider + plan). Clicking it opens the right
    // purchase modal with the provider pre-selected. Supports: data, tv,
    // electricity, education, bet, airtime.
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promo_cards (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        subtitle VARCHAR(255),
        image_url TEXT NOT NULL,
        service VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        provider VARCHAR(100),
        plan VARCHAR(255),
        display_text VARCHAR(100),
        sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ VENDOR WEEKLY TARGETS — tracks weekly progress for each approved vendor
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendor_weekly_targets (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        vendor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        week_start DATE NOT NULL,
        week_end DATE NOT NULL,
        referrals_made INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        active_users INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        total_user_transactions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_target_met BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        bonus_claimed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
        bonus_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        UNIQUE(vendor_id, week_start)
    )`);

    // ✅ VENDOR WITHDRAWALS — tracks vendor earnings withdrawal requests to wallet
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendor_withdrawals (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        vendor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        requested_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        processed_at TIMESTAMP,
        admin_note TEXT,
        processed_by VARCHAR(255),
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ Add vendor_earnings_withdrawn column to track total withdrawn
    try { await pool.query('ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vendor_earnings_withdrawn DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0'); } catch (e) {}

    // ✅ SCHEDULED PURCHASES — auto-buy, service subscriptions, transaction scheduling
    // User can toggle ON/OFF (is_active field). Covers: data renewal, TV renewal, electricity scheduling.
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_purchases (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto_buy',
        service VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        provider VARCHAR(50),
        plan VARCHAR(100),
        recipient VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
        frequency VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'monthly',
        next_run_date DATE NOT NULL,
        last_run_date TIMESTAMP,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        pin_required BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ DATA GIFTS — send data as a gift with a custom message
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_gifts (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        sender_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        recipient_phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        recipient_name VARCHAR(100),
        provider VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        plan VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        custom_message TEXT,
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        transaction_id VARCHAR(100),
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ VENDOR STOREFRONTS — vendors get a mini-website (yenllet.name.ng/store/vendor-slug)
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendor_storefronts (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        vendor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE,
        slug VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        business_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
        tagline VARCHAR(255),
        description TEXT,
        logo_url TEXT,
        banner_url TEXT,
        whatsapp VARCHAR(20),
        email VARCHAR(255),
        address TEXT,
        services_offered TEXT,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        views INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ COUPON CODES — admin creates promo codes for marketing campaigns
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coupon_codes (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        description TEXT,
        discount_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'fixed',
        discount_amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        max_uses INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        uses_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
        expires_at TIMESTAMP,
        created_by VARCHAR(255),
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ COUPON REDEMPTIONS — tracks who redeemed which coupon (prevents double use)
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coupon_redemptions (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        coupon_id INTEGER REFERENCES coupon_codes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        amount_credited DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
        redeemed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
        UNIQUE(user_id, coupon_id)
    )`);

    // ✅ BULK AIRTIME LOG — tracks bulk airtime sends
    await pool.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bulk_airtime_logs (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        uid VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,

        numbers_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
        success_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        failed_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
    )`);

    // ✅ Default admin settings (with new reseller settings)

        ('streak_settings', '{"enabled": true, "rewards": [{"days":7,"bonus":50},{"days":30,"bonus":500},{"days":100,"bonus":2000}]}')
      ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING`);
    console.log('✅ Yenllet Database v12 initialized (with reseller tables)');
    // ✅ Auto-clean any TV plan names that still have ClubKonnect prices
    // embedded in them (e.g. 'DStv Padi N4,400' → 'DStv Padi').
    // Idempotent — safe to run on every startup.
    await cleanTvPlanNames();
    // ✅ BACKFILL ck_plan_code for any plans that have NULL values.
    // This is SAFE to run on every startup — it only does UPDATE (no INSERT),
    // so it CANNOT create duplicates. It pattern-matches plan names against
    // the canonical CK codes from CK's docs.
    try {
      await backfillCkPlanCodes();
    } catch (backfillErr) {
      console.error('⚠️ Backfill ck_plan_code failed (non-blocking):', backfillErr.message);
    }
    // ✅ NOTE: seedClubKonnectPlans() was REMOVED from auto-startup.
    // It used INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (service, provider, plan) DO UPDATE,
    // but the UNIQUE constraint matches on EXACT plan name strings. When
    // the admin runs "Dedupe Pricing" and we keep a CK-synced row named
    // "500 MB" (with space) but delete the seed version "500MB" (no space),
    // the next server cold-start would re-INSERT "500MB" as a NEW row →
    // duplicate comes back. To prevent this, seeding is now MANUAL only —
    // admin clicks "Seed Default Plans" in the Pricing tab when they want it.
    // The backfill above ensures ck_plan_code values are always present
    // without needing to re-seed.
  } catch (err) { console.error('❌ Database init error:', err.message); }
}

// ✅ Strip embedded ClubKonnect prices from TV plan names in the database.
// Examples:
//   'DStv Padi N4,400'                                → 'DStv Padi'
//   'DStv Compact Plus + Showmax N32,250'             → 'DStv Compact Plus + Showmax'
//   'Showmax Full - 6 months - N32,400'               → 'Showmax Full - 6 months'
//   'StarTimes Nova (Antenna) - 700 - 1 Week'         → 'StarTimes Nova (Antenna) - 1 Week'
// Preserves selling_price and any admin customizations.
async function cleanTvPlanNames() {
  // ✅ Run each pattern in its own try/catch so a unique-constraint
  // violation on one pattern (e.g. stripping "N4,400" from "DStv Padi N4,400"
  // produces "DStv Padi" which already exists in the DB) doesn't abort the
  // others. Also dedupe BEFORE updating, so collisions are pre-empted.
  const patterns = [
    // Pattern 1: trailing ' N<number>' (e.g. 'DStv Padi N4,400')
    { update: `UPDATE pricing SET plan = regexp_replace(plan, '\\s+N[0-9,]+\\s*$', ''), updated_at = NOW() WHERE service = 'tv' AND plan ~ '\\s+N[0-9,]+\\s*$'`,
      match:  `\\s+N[0-9,]+\\s*$` },
    // Pattern 2: trailing ' - N<number>' (Showmax style)
    { update: `UPDATE pricing SET plan = regexp_replace(plan, '\\s*-\\s*N[0-9,]+\\s*$', ''), updated_at = NOW() WHERE service = 'tv' AND plan ~ '\\s*-\\s*N[0-9,]+\\s*$'`,
      match:  `\\s*-\\s*N[0-9,]+\\s*$` },
    // Pattern 3: middle ' - <number> - <duration>' (StarTimes style)
    { update: `UPDATE pricing SET plan = regexp_replace(plan, '\\s*-\\s*[0-9,]+\\s*-\\s*([0-9]+\\s+(?:Day|Week|Month|Year|days|weeks|months|years)s?)', ' - \\1'), updated_at = NOW() WHERE service = 'tv' AND plan ~ '\\s*-\\s*[0-9,]+\\s*-\\s*[0-9]+\\s+(?:Day|Week|Month|Year)'`,
      match:  `\\s*-\\s*[0-9,]+\\s*-\\s*[0-9]+\\s+(?:Day|Week|Month|Year)` },
  ];
  let cleanedCount = 0;
  for (const { update, match } of patterns) {
    try {
      // Dedupe FIRST — if stripping would create a collision, delete the
      // would-be duplicate (keep the lower-id row).
      await pool.query(`
        DELETE FROM pricing p1
        USING pricing p2
        WHERE p1.service = p2.service
          AND p1.provider = p2.provider
          AND p1.service = 'tv'
          AND p1.id > p2.id
          AND regexp_replace(p1.plan, '${match}', '') = p2.plan
      `);
      const res = await pool.query(update);
      cleanedCount += res.rowCount || 0;
    } catch (err) {
      // Non-blocking — log and move on to the next pattern.
      console.error(`⚠️ cleanTvPlanNames pattern failed:`, err.message);
    }
  }
  // Final dedupe (in case any UPDATE still caused a collision).
  try {
    await pool.query(`
      DELETE FROM pricing p1
      USING pricing p2
      WHERE p1.service = p2.service
        AND p1.provider = p2.provider
        AND p1.plan = p2.plan
        AND p1.id > p2.id
        AND p1.service = 'tv'
    `);
    console.log(`✅ Cleaned ${cleanedCount} TV plan name(s) (stripped embedded prices)`);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('⚠️ cleanTvPlanNames final dedupe failed:', err.message);
  }
}

    ['education','WAEC','WAEC Result Checker Pin',1800,1900.00,'Single Use','Result Checker'],
    ['education','JAMB','JAMB e-PIN',2900,3000.00,'Single Use','e-PIN'],

    // ===================== Betting Wallet Funding =====================
    ['bet','SportyBet','SportyBet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','prd-sporty-bet'],
    ['bet','Nairabet','Nairabet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-nairabet'],
    ['bet','BangBet','BangBet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-bang-bet'],
    ['bet','BetWay','BetWay Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-bet-way'],
    ['bet','BetLand','BetLand Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-bet-land'],
    ['bet','BetKing','BetKing Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-bet-king'],
    ['bet','1xBet','1xBet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-1x-bet'],
    ['bet','NaijaBet','NaijaBet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-naija-bet'],
    ['bet','MerryBet','MerryBet Wallet Funding',1000,1000.00,'Wallet Funding','product-merry-bet'],
  ];

  // ✅ BATCH INSERT — split into groups of 15 plans to avoid connection timeout on Vercel
  const BATCH_SIZE = 15;
  let totalInserted = 0;
  
  for (let i = 0; i < plans.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = plans.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    // ✅ NORMALIZE: every plan tuple must have exactly 8 items so the
    // batch VALUES clause (which always generates 8 placeholders per row)
    // matches flatParams. TV / electricity / education plans only have 7
    // items because they have no ClubKonnect product code — pad them with
    // null. Without this, every all-non-data batch fails with
    // "bind message supplies 105 parameters, but prepared statement
    // requires 120" (15 rows × 7 items = 105 vs 15 rows × 8 placeholders).
    const normalizedBatch = batch.map(p => p.length === 8 ? p : [...p, null]);
    const values = normalizedBatch.map((p, idx) => {
      const base = idx * 8;
      return `($${base + 1}, $${base + 2}, $${base + 3}, $${base + 4}, $${base + 5}, $${base + 6}, $${base + 7}, true, $${base + 8})`;
    }).join(', ');

    const flatParams = normalizedBatch.flat();

    try {
      await pool.query(
        `INSERT INTO pricing (service, provider, plan, amount, selling_price, validity, category, is_active, ck_plan_code)
         VALUES ${values}
         ON CONFLICT (service, provider, plan) DO UPDATE SET
           amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
           validity = EXCLUDED.validity,
           category = EXCLUDED.category,
           is_active = true,
           ck_plan_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ck_plan_code, pricing.ck_plan_code)`,
        flatParams
      );
      totalInserted += batch.length;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`❌ Batch ${Math.floor(i/BATCH_SIZE)+1} failed:`, e.message);
      // Try individual inserts as fallback for this batch
      // (use normalizedBatch — every tuple has 8 items here, so destructuring works)
      for (const [service, provider, plan, amount, sellingPrice, validity, category, ckPlanCode] of normalizedBatch) {
        try {
          await pool.query(
            `INSERT INTO pricing (service, provider, plan, amount, selling_price, validity, category, is_active, ck_plan_code)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, true, $8)
             ON CONFLICT (service, provider, plan) DO UPDATE SET
               amount = EXCLUDED.amount, validity = EXCLUDED.validity, category = EXCLUDED.category, is_active = true, ck_plan_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ck_plan_code, pricing.ck_plan_code)`,
            [service, provider, plan, amount, sellingPrice, validity, category, ckPlanCode]
          );
          totalInserted++;
        } catch (e2) { /* skip individual failures */ }
      }
    }
  }
  console.log(`✅ Seeded/updated ${totalInserted}/${plans.length} ClubKonnect data plans (batch mode)`);
}

// ✅ BACKFILL: pattern-match existing pricing rows by (provider, plan name)
// to populate ck_plan_code for plans that came in via /api/admin/sync-clubkonnect
// (which often fails to extract PRODUCT_CODE from CK's response).
//
// Why we need this:
//   - syncClubKonnect() inserts rows with CK's actual product names like
//     "125MB - 1 day (Awoof Data)" (note: "Awoof Data", not "Awoof")
//   - But CK's response doesn't always include PRODUCT_CODE in a field
//     we know how to read, so ck_plan_code ends up NULL.
//   - Without ck_plan_code, processPurchase sends the human-readable plan
//     name to ClubKonnect, which returns INVALID_DATAPLAN and refunds the
//     user's wallet. Every Glo / Airtel / 9mobile data purchase was failing.
//
// This function rebuilds ck_plan_code by pattern-matching the plan name
// against the canonical codes we already know from CK's docs.
async function backfillCkPlanCodes() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id, provider, plan FROM pricing WHERE service = 'data' AND (ck_plan_code IS NULL OR ck_plan_code = '')"
    );
    if (result.rows.length === 0) {
      console.log('✅ Backfill: no data plans missing ck_plan_code (all good)');
      return { updated: 0, total: 0 };
    }
    let updated = 0;
    for (const row of result.rows) {
      const code = guessCkPlanCodeFromName(row.provider, row.plan);
      if (code) {
        await pool.query('UPDATE pricing SET ck_plan_code = $1 WHERE id = $2', [code, row.id]);
        updated++;
      }
    }
    console.log(`✅ Backfilled ck_plan_code for ${updated}/${result.rows.length} data plans`);
    return { updated, total: result.rows.length };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('⚠️ backfillCkPlanCodes failed:', err.message);
    return { updated: 0, total: 0, error: err.message };
  }
}

// Pattern-match a (provider, planName) tuple to a ClubKonnect PRODUCT_CODE.
// Returns the code as a string, or null if no match.
// Codes are from ClubKonnect's APIDatabundleV1.asp documentation.
function guessCkPlanCodeFromName(provider, planName) {
  const p = (planName || '').toLowerCase();
  const prov = (provider || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!p) return null;

  // Extract data amount (e.g., "125mb", "1gb", "2.5gb", "500mb", "1tb")
  const amtMatch = p.match(/([\d.]+)\s*(mb|gb|tb)/);
  const amount = amtMatch ? amtMatch[1] + amtMatch[2] : null;

  // Extract validity keywords.
  // ✅ Use `days?` (optional plural) because CK's plan names use "1 day", "7 days",
  // "30 days", "60 days", "90 days", "180 days", "365 days". Without the optional
  // `s`, the regex `\b60\s*day\b` failed on "60 days" (no word boundary between
  // "y" and "s" since both are word chars), so MTN's 150GB 2-Month plan was
  // returning null instead of code '35'.
  const is1Day = /(\b1\s*days?\b|\bdaily\b|\b1-day\b)/.test(p);
  const is2Day = /(\b2\s*days?\b|\b2-day\b)/.test(p);
  const is3Day = /(\b3\s*days?\b|\b3-day\b)/.test(p);
  const is7Day = /(\b7\s*days?\b|\b7-day\b|\bweekly\b)/.test(p);
  const is14Day = /(\b14\s*days?\b|\b14-day\b)/.test(p);
  const is30Day = /(\b30\s*days?\b|\b30-day\b|\bmonthly\b)/.test(p);
  const is60Day = /(\b60\s*days?\b|\b60-day\b|\b2\s*month)/.test(p);
  const is90Day = /(\b90\s*days?\b|\b90-day\b|\b3\s*month)/.test(p);
  const is180Day = /(\b180\s*days?\b|\b180-day\b|\b6\s*month)/.test(p);
  const is365Day = /(\b365\s*days?\b|\byearly\b|\b1\s*year\b)/.test(p);
  const isWeekend = /\bweekend\b/.test(p);
  const isNight = /\bnight\b/.test(p);

  // Plan type
  const isAwoof = /\bawoof\b/.test(p);
  const isSme = /\bsme\b/.test(p);
  const isDirect = /\bdirect\b/.test(p);

  // ===== MTN =====
  if (prov === 'mtn') {
    // SME Weekly
    if (isSme && is7Day) {
      if (amount === '500mb') return '2';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '4';
      if (amount === '2gb') return '5';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '6';
    }
    // SME Monthly
    if (isSme && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '500mb') return '9';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '10';
      if (amount === '2gb') return '11';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '12';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '13';
    }
    // Awoof Daily
    if (isAwoof && (is1Day || is2Day)) {
      if (amount === '110mb') return '38';
      if (amount === '230mb') return '39';
      if (amount === '500mb') return '40';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '14';      // 1GB Daily + 1.5mins
      if (amount === '2.5gb') return is2Day ? '16' : '15';
      if (amount === '3.2gb') return '17';
    }
    // Direct Weekly
    if (isDirect && is7Day) {
      if (amount === '500mb') return '18';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '19';
      if (amount === '1.5gb') return '41';
      if (amount === '3.5gb') return '42';
      if (amount === '6gb') return '20';
      if (amount === '11gb') return '21';
      if (amount === '20gb') return '36';
    }
    // Direct Monthly
    if (isDirect && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '2gb' && p.includes('2mins')) return '22';
      if (amount === '2.7gb' && p.includes('2mins')) return '23';
      if (amount === '3.5gb' && p.includes('5mins')) return '24';
      if (amount === '7gb') return '26';
      if (amount === '10gb' && p.includes('10mins')) return '27';
      if (amount === '12.5gb') return '28';
      if (amount === '16.5gb' && p.includes('10mins')) return '29';
      if (amount === '20gb') return '30';
      if (amount === '25gb') return '31';
      if (amount === '36gb') return '32';
      if (amount === '75gb') return '33';
      if (amount === '165gb') return '34';
    }
    if (isDirect && is60Day && amount === '150gb') return '35';
    if (isDirect && is90Day && amount === '480gb') return '37';
  }

  // ===== Glo =====
  if (prov === 'glo') {
    if (isSme && is14Day && amount === '200mb') return '1';
    if (isSme && is7Day && amount === '500mb') return '2';
    if (isSme && is3Day) {
      if (amount === '1gb') return '8';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '9';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '10';
    }
    if (isSme && is7Day) {
      if (amount === '1gb') return '11';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '12';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '13';
    }
    if (isSme && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '1gb') return '3';
      if (amount === '2gb') return '4';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '5';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '6';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '7';
    }
    if (isSme && isNight && is14Day) {
      if (amount === '1gb') return '37';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '38';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '39';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '40';
    }
    if (isAwoof) {
      if (is1Day) {
        if (amount === '125mb') return '14';
        if (amount === '2gb') return '28';
      }
      if (is2Day && amount === '260mb') return '15';
      if (isWeekend) {
        if (amount === '875mb') return '31';
        if (amount === '2.5gb') return '30';
      }
    }
    if (isDirect && is14Day && amount === '1.5gb') return '16';
    if (isDirect && is7Day && amount === '6gb') return '29';
    if (isDirect && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '2.6gb') return '17';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '18';
      if (amount === '6.15gb') return '19';
      if (amount === '7.5gb') return '20';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '21';
      if (amount === '12.5gb') return '22';
      if (amount === '16gb') return '23';
      if (amount === '28gb') return '24';
      if (amount === '38gb') return '25';
      if (amount === '64gb') return '26';
      if (amount === '107gb') return '27';
      if (amount === '165gb') return '32';
      if (amount === '220gb') return '33';
      if (amount === '320gb') return '34';
      if (amount === '380gb') return '35';
      if (amount === '475gb') return '36';
    }
    if (isDirect && is365Day && amount === '1tb') return '41';
  }

  // ===== Airtel =====
  if (prov === 'airtel') {
    if (isAwoof && is1Day && amount === '1gb') return '14';
    if (isAwoof && is2Day) {
      if (amount === '1.5gb') return '15';
      if (amount === '2gb') return '16';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '17';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '18';
    }
    if (isDirect && is7Day) {
      if (amount === '500mb') return '19';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '20';
      if (amount === '1.5gb') return '21';
      if (amount === '3.5gb') return '22';
      if (amount === '6gb') return '23';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '24';
      if (amount === '18gb') return '25';
    }
    if (isDirect && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '2gb') return '26';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '27';
      if (amount === '4gb') return '28';
      if (amount === '8gb') return '29';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '30';
      if (amount === '13gb') return '31';
      if (amount === '18gb') return '32';
      if (amount === '25gb') return '33';
      if (amount === '35gb') return '34';
      if (amount === '60gb') return '35';
      if (amount === '100gb') return '36';
      if (amount === '160gb') return '37';
      if (amount === '210gb') return '38';
    }
    if (isDirect && is90Day) {
      if (amount === '300gb') return '39';
      if (amount === '350gb') return '40';
    }
  }

  // ===== 9mobile =====
  if (prov === '9mobile' || prov === 'etisalat') {
    if (isSme && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '50mb') return '1';
      if (amount === '100mb') return '2';
      if (amount === '300mb') return '3';
      if (amount === '500mb') return '4';
      if (amount === '1gb') return '5';
      if (amount === '2gb') return '6';
      if (amount === '3gb') return '7';
      if (amount === '4gb') return '8';
      if (amount === '5gb') return '9';
      if (amount === '10gb') return '10';
      if (amount === '15gb') return '11';
      if (amount === '20gb') return '12';
      if (amount === '25gb') return '13';
    }
    if (isAwoof && is1Day) {
      if (amount === '100mb') return '14';
      if (amount === '180mb') return '15';
      if (amount === '250mb') return '16';
      if (amount === '450mb') return '17';
    }
    if (isAwoof && is3Day && amount === '650mb') return '18';
    if (isDirect && is7Day) {
      if (amount === '1.75gb') return '19';
    }
    if (isDirect && is14Day && amount === '650mb') return '20';
    if (isDirect && is30Day) {
      if (amount === '1.1gb') return '21';
      if (amount === '1.4gb') return '22';
      if (amount === '2.44gb') return '23';
      if (amount === '3.17gb') return '24';
      if (amount === '3.91gb') return '25';
      if (amount === '5.10gb') return '26';
      if (amount === '6.5gb') return '27';
      if (amount === '16gb') return '28';
      if (amount === '24.3gb') return '29';
      if (amount === '26.5gb') return '30';
    }
    if (isDirect && is60Day && amount === '39gb') return '31';
    // ✅ NEW (added 2026-10-29 after cross-checking with CK's live API):
    // 9mobile now has 3 long-term Direct Data plans (was only 1 before).
    if (isDirect && is90Day && amount === '78gb') return '32';
    if (isDirect && is180Day && amount === '190gb') return '33';
  }

  return null;
}
